CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Pas une bonne expérience pour moi
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
J'ai sauté sur l'occasion quand j'ai vu passer le produit ! J'ai tout un tas d'outils de jardinage et de bricolage, qui trainent au fond du jardin, simplement posés par terre les uns sur les autres...
Je ne pensais pas trouver un système de crochète muraux comme celui-là, et j'ai trouvé l'idée très interessante.

Mais au final, ça ne va pas dans mon cas. J'en ai fixé deux pour tester avant de mettre tous les autres. Et je trouve que le ressort du mécanisme de pince est beaucoup trop fort. Pour pouvoir le desserrer afin de placer un outil, il a fallu que j'y aille à deux mains, et que je force pour ouvrir la pince ... Pffff, c'était pas tellement l'idée pratique que je cherchais...

Ensuite pour enlever l'outil, il a fallu que je tire très fort, et j'ai l'un des deux supports qui s'est décroché. Il est possible que je n'ai pas été assez soigneux lors que de la mise en place des fixations, mais les chevilles me paraissent vraiment petites au regard de ce qu'elles sont censées supporter comme traction.

Donc voilà, ça n'a pas marché pour moi, il va falloir que je trouve quelque chose de plus basique comme des simples crochète pour suspendre, peut-être....

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
📘 Mi experiencia personal
El BELLE VOUS Dispensador de Comida para Gatos y Perros es una solución práctica para la rutina de alimentación de mis gatas Este dispensador de comida y agua funciona mediante un sistema de gravedad, lo que significa que no necesita electricidad ni baterías para funcionar, lo cual es una gran ventaja para simplificar el proceso de alimentación y mantener libre de complicaciones.

✅ Características principales
Tipo: Dispensador automático de comida y agua.
Capacidad: 500 ml
Función: Dispensador por gravedad
Uso: Gatos y perros
Material: Plástico
Color: Marrón

✅ El diseño es bastante sencillo pero efectivo. El dispensador tiene una capacidad de 500 ml, lo cual es ideal para una comida o bebida diaria para mascotas pequeñas o como complemento para mascotas más grandes. La comida o el agua se liberan de manera constante y gradual, lo que evita que se derrame y permite que las mascotas accedan a su comida y agua cuando lo necesiten.

✅ Me ha gustado mucho la facilidad de mantenimiento de este dispensador. El plástico es fácil de limpiar, y el diseño desmontable permite un lavado a fondo para mantener la higiene. Aunque es de plástico, el material parece bastante resistente y duradero, y no ha tenido problemas con el desgaste hasta ahora.

❤️ Lo mejor del producto
Lo que más aprecio del Dispensador BELLE VOUS es su simplicidad y funcionalidad. La ausencia de componentes eléctricos lo hace muy fácil de usar y mantener, y el sistema de gravedad garantiza que siempre haya comida y agua disponibles para mis mascotas. Además, el diseño marrón es discreto.

❌ Puntos a mejorar
La solución para el agua no le ha gustado a mis gatas, que no quiere beber ahí porque hay muy poca agua. Yo mejoraría el diseño para que el espacio para beber. Ese plástico permite muy poca agua en superficie y mis gatas se niegan a beber ahí.

😎 Recomendaciones de uso
Recomiendo el BELLE VOUS Dispensador de Comida para quienes buscan una solución práctica y sin complicaciones para alimentar a sus mascotas. Es ideal para gatos y perros pequeños, o como complemento para alimentos en hogares con varias mascotas. Su diseño simple y fácil de limpiar lo hace adecuado para el uso diario.

✍️ Resumen
El BELLE VOUS Dispensador de Comida para Gatos y Perros es una herramienta útil para asegurar que tus mascotas siempre tengan acceso a comida y agua. Con una capacidad de 500 ml y un sistema de gravedad que no requiere electricidad, es fácil de usar y mantener. Aunque sería beneficioso tener opciones con mayor capacidad, el dispensador cumple bien su función y se integra fácilmente en el hogar.

⭐ Valoración
Le doy al BELLE VOUS Dispensador de Comida para Gatos y Perros una puntuación de 4 estrellas.

EXPLICACIÓN de mi PUNTUACIÓN:
1 estrella -⭐: No me ha gustado nada. Pésimos materiales. Mal funcionamiento. Embalaje deteriorado.
2 estrellas -⭐⭐: No me ha satisfecho. Materiales de poca calidad que reducirán su vida útil. Funcionamiento deficiente, difícil de utilizar y sin instrucciones o de muy difícil comprensión. Embalaje básico de plástico.
3 estrellas -⭐⭐⭐: Está bien. Materiales de calidad media. Funcionamiento normal y manual de instrucciones comprensible, pero no vienen en español. Embalaje adecuado.
4 estrellas -⭐⭐⭐⭐: Me gusta. Buenos materiales. Buen funcionamiento e instrucciones básicas en español. Embalaje cuidado que protege adecuadamente el producto.
5 estrellas - ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐: Me encanta. Materiales de calidad que auguran una larga durabilidad. Funcionamiento sencillo y fácil limpieza. Instrucciones bien detalladas y en español. Embalaje indicativo del contenido y que permite su almacenamiento. Versátil o novedoso.

Ho recentemente testato il modulo MCP2515 CAN Bus Shield SPI compatibile con Arduino e sono rimasto molto soddisfatto della sua performance e facilità d'uso. Questo shield è un'ottima scelta per chi desidera implementare la comunicazione CAN Bus nei propri progetti Arduino.

Installazione e Compatibilità
L’installazione del modulo è stata sorprendentemente semplice. Il shield si adatta perfettamente alla scheda Arduino, senza necessità di saldature o adattatori aggiuntivi. La compatibilità con le schede Arduino più comuni è ottima, e le connessioni SPI si integrano senza problemi. La documentazione fornita è chiara e utile, con esempi di codice che facilitano l’inizio rapido del progetto.

Prestazioni e Funzionalità
Il modulo MCP2515 offre prestazioni eccellenti nella gestione della comunicazione CAN Bus. Supporta la modalità CAN 2.0A e 2.0B, e con una velocità di trasferimento dati fino a 1 Mbps, è adatto per la maggior parte delle applicazioni automobilistiche e industriali. La comunicazione è stabile e affidabile, senza errori di trasmissione evidenti, il che è cruciale per applicazioni che richiedono alta precisione.

Qualità Costruttiva
La qualità costruttiva del modulo è buona. Il PCB è ben progettato e i componenti sono saldati con cura. Le connessioni sono robuste e il modulo è progettato per resistere a un uso intensivo. Le intestazioni e i pin sono ben posizionati e non ci sono segni di debolezze strutturali, suggerendo una costruzione durevole.

Supporto Software
Il supporto software per il MCP2515 è eccellente. La libreria Arduino per MCP2515 è ben documentata e aggiornata, rendendo facile l’implementazione delle funzionalità CAN Bus nei propri progetti. Gli esempi inclusi sono chiari e ben scritti, aiutando anche i principianti a capire rapidamente come utilizzare il modulo.

Conclusione
In sintesi, il modulo MCP2515 CAN Bus Shield SPI compatibile con Arduino è un prodotto altamente raccomandabile per chiunque abbia bisogno di integrare la comunicazione CAN Bus nei propri progetti. Offre un ottimo equilibrio tra facilità d’uso, prestazioni e robustezza. Che tu sia un principiante o un esperto, troverai che questo shield ti aiuterà a ottenere risultati eccellenti nella gestione dei tuoi dati CAN Bus.

Attenti però a non lasciarlo troppo tempo esposto sotto il sole con la zip chiusa: come non fa entrare nulla, non fa uscire nemmeno il calore, meglio lasciare la zip un po' aperta.
Le fond plat procure une bonne stabilité. Les couvercles ferment bien. L'aspect paraît durable. Les rappes incluses ne seront sans doute pas d'un grand usage.

📦 CONTENUTO PACCO:
Al ricevimento del pacco, ho trovato all'interno una confezione contenente il dispositivo Navaris Rompi Vetro Auto Emergenza e un manuale di istruzioni.
📝 DESCRIZIONE DEL PRODOTTO APPENA APERTO:
Dimensioni: 17,9 x 3,1 x 7 cm, dimensioni abbastanza compatte.
Peso: Circa 200 grammi, sorprendentemente leggero.
Colore: Principalmente nero con dettagli in rosso.
Materiali: Prevalentemente plastica, con punta in metallo per la funzione rompi vetro.
Provenienza: Fabbricato in Cina, come indicato sulla confezione.
Forma: Ergonomica, simile a un martello con varie funzionalità integrate.
Funzioni: Rompi vetro, taglia cinture, sirena di emergenza, torcia LED.
Consumi energetici: Basso consumo, alimentato da 3 batterie AAA (non incluse).
Durata batteria: Variabile a seconda dell'uso, ma presumibilmente diverse ore di utilizzo continuo.
Lavaggio: Può essere pulito con un panno umido, ma non è lavabile o impermeabile.
Riciclaggio materiali: La plastica potrebbe essere riciclabile, ma verificare con le autorità locali.
Impermeabilizzazione: Non impermeabile, da tenere al riparo dall'umidità.
🚫 DIFETTI:

La costruzione in plastica dà una sensazione di fragilità, poco rassicurante per un dispositivo di emergenza.
L'uso di batterie AAA anziché una batteria ricaricabile integrata è scomodo.
La qualità complessiva sembra inferiore rispetto a quanto ci si aspetterebbe da un dispositivo di sicurezza.
La torcia LED potrebbe essere più potente.

💭 SENSAZIONI/CONCLUSIONI:
Il Navaris Rompi Vetro Auto Emergenza è un prodotto che mi lascia con sensazioni contrastanti. Da un lato, apprezzo l'idea di avere più funzioni in un unico dispositivo compatto. Dall'altro, la realizzazione pratica lascia a desiderare.
Cosa potrebbe avere di meglio? Una costruzione più robusta, magari in metallo o plastica di alta qualità, una batteria ricaricabile integrata e una torcia LED più potente sarebbero miglioramenti significativi.
Non posso dire di essere del tutto soddisfatto del prodotto. La sensazione al tatto è quella di un oggetto economico, che non ispira fiducia in una situazione di emergenza reale.
Non lo userei come unico dispositivo di sicurezza nella mia auto. Preferirei affidarmi a strumenti più specializzati e di qualità superiore per ciascuna funzione.
Non ho dovuto contattare l'assistenza, ma il prodotto non ha superato le mie aspettative in termini di qualità costruttiva.
Consigli per l'uso: Se decidete di acquistarlo, assicuratevi di testarlo regolarmente e di tenere sempre batterie di ricambio a portata di mano. Considerate di integrarlo con altri dispositivi di sicurezza più robusti.
Il prezzo di 17,99€ mi sembra eccessivo per la qualità offerta. Considererei di investire un po' di più in prodotti separati di maggiore qualità per ciascuna funzione.
In conclusione, mentre l'idea alla base del Navaris Rompi Vetro Auto Emergenza è buona, l'esecuzione lascia a desiderare. È un prodotto che potrebbe essere utile in situazioni di emergenza minori, ma non mi sentirei completamente sicuro ad affidarmi esclusivamente ad esso in caso di emergenza grave. Se state cercando un dispositivo di sicurezza per la vostra auto, vi consiglio di considerare alternative più robuste o di investire in strumenti separati di maggiore qualità per ciascuna funzione.

I bought this cover 2 years ago (Aug 28 2022) and put it from the shipping package into a storage box in my garage. I JUST opened it to use this last weekend.

My bikes were in the back of my new truck and covered with the obsidian cover. I tightened straps, buckles, and bungee’d the bottom of the cover to the strap rings in the bed of my truck. I had an 8 hour round trip drive from WV to KY. Speeds are generally 65-70 when not in construction on my route. I had to stop twice on my way there as the tightening strings did not stay tightened. When I got to my destination, the only issue I saw was a frayed gray holding strap, the obsidian emblem looked like this cover had been in weather for 2 years, and had a tangled tightening string. However, on my way home, things changed. When I got home, this cover was blown apart. A main seam that’s supposedly sewn and heat sealed was separated and frayed, and about 1ft long. A second seam area on a different spot is about 6” of separation and fray. One of the metal rings at the bottom is almost completely separated from the cover. One of the plastic string sliders was broken. I had to cut it to get the string to loosen. This was on ONE trip- 8 hours of driving total! One of buckle straps that was buckled was caught in my cranks and chain ring.

This thing is garbage, and a waste of money if you’re going to travel at all with it. Because I bought this just short of 2 years ago, I think there’s little I can do now but eat the cost. Never again…

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Desk orgniser with handle and adjustable sections
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
This desktop caddy serves more purposes than a traditional desk organiser. Along with compartments for organising stuff, it comes with a handle, making it easy to move around, for example, from my desk to the workshop table. The removable divider is handy—it allows me to customise the space based on my needs. The sleek blue colour and minimalist design fit perfectly with my office decor. The carry handle is incredibly convenient. The handle makes it easy to transport without worrying about items falling out. Made from durable plastic, it feels sturdy and built to last. The caddy is easy to clean with warm soapy water. The stackable feature is great for saving space.

While compact and space-saving, it’s not very large. If you have a lot of items, you might need more than one caddy. It works well for my office supplies, but larger items or a higher volume of small items might not fit as well. The price is not justified with the utility of this caddy, its on higher side.

Overall, it’s stylish, functional, and versatile. While it might not hold a ton of items, it’s perfect for organising smaller necessities. The portability and easy-to-clean features are definite highlights.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Tight fit, not cool, makes the sound bassier
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION: The fluffy cups on the DT 880 headphones use a glue stitch, which often unpeaals itself over time. The replacements by KWMOBILE are good. They are well made and fitted on easily. However, they are different in two ways. They are NOT cool, they are warmer than the fluffy original cups. And secondly the 40 - 60 Hz bass response is boosted by around 5 - 10 dB. You may want bassier, warmer, tighter fitting headphones, I didn't. So once again, buyer beware of the nonsense written by companies to sell you stuff. If they just wrote, hey buy these for a tighter fit and even bigger bass, I wouldn't have bought them, but you might have. As I said, these are good, better made and designed than the Beyerdynamic originals, but the sound and wearing experience will change. Thanks for reading!

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Reliable, durable, and versatile enough to handle various tasks, good length
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
These cords are clearly built to last. The polypropylene material combined with plastic-coated steel hooks gives me confidence that they won't snap or wear out easily. I recently used them to carry a heavy load on my trolly, and they performed very well. The bungee cords are versatile and have proven handy in a variety of other situations, too. Their ability to stretch from 110 cm to 160 cm is impressive, offering a lot of flexibility depending on the size of the load.

The elastic nature of these bungees is a major plus. The range of stretch is more than sufficient, and they maintain a firm hold even when fully extended. The bright colours are not just for show—they genuinely make a difference when you're securing loads in low-light conditions. It’s a small but thoughtful feature that adds to the overall safety when transporting items, especially at night.

While the steel hooks are sturdy, I found that they could be a bit larger. There were a few instances where I struggled to secure the hooks around certain attachment points, like thicker side bars of my trolly. A slightly bigger or more flexible hook design could have made this easier. The tensile strength is good, but when nearing the maximum stretch, the tension does become quite tight, making it a bit challenging to secure heavier loads single-handedly. For those who regularly deal with very heavy or awkward items, you might need an extra set of hands to help with securing them.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: If your wall is suitable, a good kit for hanging 3 picture frames
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
The picture hanging kit arrived in a neat container. The quantity and range of parts means that it is a complete kit, with D rings and tiny screws for the picture frame itself, to wall hooks with appropriate fixing nails and stainless steel wire. There are also some self adhesive protector dots and a small but functional spirit level.

There are sufficient D rings and wall hooks for 3 picture frames and they will hold a 5 kg frame. The wire was in 5 sections. I did not unravel one to check the length but if the advertised 10 ft total is correct they will be 2 ft each. Perhaps not enough for a large picture, but I’m wondering if two lengths might be securely joined by twisting if necessary. Incidentally, the wire has six twisted strands and not 18 as in the sales page image! A close up view of the parts shows that the quality is not wonderful but at least they are fairly well represented on the sales page. Functionally they should be fine.

For hanging 3 pictures, at the current cost of £9.49 that is just over £3.15 per frame, a little more expensive than the cost of using hook and loop fixings that will take this weight, but probably more secure. Of course these will take a more setting up and the type of wall you have will determine whether the nails for the hooks can be successfully hammered in.

Overall, this is a decent picture hanging kit. It doesn’t exactly shout out quality but should do the job. I will give a maybe generous 4 stars in part because the little box is great!

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:

I like that there is a removable slide which makes the whole length usable for longer items. For example, an A5 notepad fits perfectly fine on its long edge in that area if needed.

The caddy has been designed to be stackable, where the handle would then go in the centre of the bottom of another one if needed. And I think that is a great idea, however, for the price currently at £16.49 for a single unit, I think is a touch on the expensive side, and it could work out quite expensive if one were looking to stack them, which would also limit the height of objects in the one bellow it.

It’s 4/5 stars for me, mainly due to the price, and that any stacking will limit items in the caddy bellow to the maximum height of the brim. Still, it is a nice caddy, quality is decent, and I do like it, but the price could be less for what it is.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Very pretty but I wish a couple of these had more bubbles in the glass
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
I love bubble glass and have quite a few pieces of it, so this set of hurricane candle glasses is perfect for me. These are large and I love the size of them; they are not skimpy or wimpy. I also like the graduated sizes and that there are three of them; they are the perfect number and have the perfect size difference to cluster them together. My only criticism is I wish the middle and largest size had more bubbles in the glass. The smallest one has quite a few (though I wouldn't mind a few more) and the largest one has some, but the middle one has only a little bit. I'd love for them not only to match each other better, but to have more bubbles for that wonderful look and the texture it provides. Without the bubbles, these are just plain clear glass hurricanes that can be found anywhere, and the bubbles look so pretty when they catch the candle light, so more bubbles, please!

Having said that, these are handmade so it's not like they are going to be perfectly uniform. They are beautiful and large for great decorating impact. The largest is 11 inches tall, which doesn't sound all that big but when you see them in person, they are substantial. The three different sizes fit graduated candle sizes well; as far as real candles I am missing one size that I need to track down (hence the empty hurricane glass in my photo), but my set of three battery-operated candles fits nicely in these hurricanes as well. I really love how I can dress these up for different holidays and seasons by adding different accessories to them, or I can even use them as flower vases.

Overall, these are beautiful, classic and versatile, and impressively sized. I love the bubbles -- I just wish there was more of them.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: I would not trust them. Poor quality, misleading branding, and difficult warranty process.
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION: I purchased these to transport a ‘75 Chevy square body. The brand name and really large sticker labeled “USA” drew me in. Advertising from the company gives you the feeling they are a true American brand. They are not. Straps and customer service are both Chinese. Two out of the four straps failed on the first attempt to haul the truck (3800 lb vehicle). The first strap tore at the hook. It was new, right out of the bag, not cut. The second strap would ratchet tight, lock in place, then spontaneously pop loose and the strap would slack. If you tensioned the ratchet it would get tight then break over and come loose. I went through the hassle of getting them replaced under warranty which took several days of back and fourth communications, 8 emails and three times sending pictures. In the end, they replaced 2 straps but not the whole kit. I don’t trust the other 2 straps, so I won’t be using them to haul my truck. An atv maybe. I am going back to Vulcan brand. I have used them for years with 0 failures.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: An easy to grow grass my cat loves!
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION: I've been using this seed mix for about 2 years and I love it. So does my cat! I use my own seed starter soil and pot to grow it. It takes about 5 days to grow the grass to 5", a few days longer in cooler weather. The pot of grass lasts about 10 days until it is a ragged mess, so I seed a new pot a few days after I put the newly sprouted grass out. My cat loves this grass! She eats it before meal time. I call it her "salad course". If it gets too long she sometimes throws it up, so I try to keep it trimmed to 4". I love that the product is organic so I don't worry about kitty eating harmful chemicals. I have experienced the mold, but only when I keep the soil too wet. It is important to grow this grass in a container with holes so the excess water can drain out.

Este set de pinceles viene en un estuche bien organizado, en el que es muy fácil escoger el pincel que necesites. Además de que es perfecto para tener dónde guardar los pinceles para que no se estropeen y para poder transportarlos, es un gran detalle que venga con su estuche.
Los pinceles son de una calidad que me ha parecido excelente. Los cabezales son muy resistentes y tras varios usos, el tamaño vuelve a ser el mismo y cuidándolos bien, van a durar mucho tiempo.
Son de gran utilidad para pintar con pinturas acrílicas, puedes hacer cualquier trazo que desees y la suavidad y la comodidad, hacen la experiencia de pintar aún más bonita.
También son muy útiles para acuarelas, pintura al óleo... Y no solo para pintar, también son buenos para las uñas, si necesitas alguno de los finos para hacer pequeños trazos. Para la cerámica también son buenos, en general para lo que necesites porque son muy versátiles.
Tras probarlos con diferentes pinturas y materiales, confirmo que son muy buenos, de calidad y resistentes.
Si eres artista y buscas unos pinceles buenos, estos son ideales. A mí me han servido muy bien y estoy muy contenta con ellos por lo que los recomiendo.
Espero que mi reseña te haya sido de utilidad.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: One of the provided straps refused to hold moderate tension, which is the only job of the device.
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
I was anxious for these straps to reduce the amount of hassle that goes along with ratchets. My friend uses a cam-style pro-taper strap which I was impressed by so I purchased these. The look and feel, visually-apparent build quality, and robust webbing looked great and I was excited to use them.

First use, one of the straps simply would not hold adequate tension to keep my dirt bike upright. I figured maybe the material was slippery since the webbing is just new and lacked friction from wear (which shouldnt be required, anyway but I wanted to give them the benefit of the doubt) so I backed the cam element up with half hitches. This was fine for road use, albeit frustrating. On the trail, the strap had to be retensioned a couple times, which I find is unacceptable.

I consider myself a reasonable consumer with realistic expectations, and ultimately I found the device offered no convenience benefit over my old ratchet straps. I will be trying a peg-based retention system, like MotoCinch or BikeBinderz.

Bungee cords always come in useful for various jobs - mainly restraining or securing items.
I have multiple bungee cords that I have bought over the years but these Belle Vous ones are different in a few ways.
Bungee cords are usually a single cord with a given weight load and non-adjustable length; but these ones are multiple cords next to each other to give a wider spread; the description suggests a 60 kilograms weight load. These cords are also adjustable - they use a loop through a black fastener - which is a bit fiddly to adjust but that means it is less likely to undo itself under load.

I like the purple colour because it stands out in my garage when I am trying to remember where I hung my bungee cords; the description suggests the cords are also reflective - but I've not noticed that yet.

The end hooks are solid metal but nicely coated in plastic to avoid scratching / damaging things.

The elasticity is more than I am used to in a bungee cord but that may be due to the multiple cord design - time will tell if I prefer this design over the usual single cord approach - but in my mind I'm thinking if one cord breaks then thats a fail for the usual bungees but with this multi-cord design if one cord fails it still has a back-up / fail-safe of the other cords taking up the strain - which can only be a good thing in my view.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: TCA Herren Slipstream Gepolsterte Radhose - Bequem und Gut Verarbeitet - 5 Sterne
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Die TCA Herren Slipstream Gepolsterte Radhose ist eine ausgezeichnete Wahl für Radfahrer, die Komfort, Qualität und Funktionalität suchen. Hier ist eine detaillierte Bewertung:

Vorteile:
- Sehr Bequem: Diese Radhose ist unglaublich bequem zu tragen und bietet genau die richtige Menge an Unterstützung und Polsterung für lange Fahrten. Die Passform ist eng anliegend, ohne einzuengen, und daher perfekt für längere Einsätze.
- Gute Verarbeitung: Die Nähte und die gesamte Konstruktion der Hose sind von hoher Qualität. Die Handwerkskunst ist offensichtlich, mit starken, langlebigen Nähten, die auch nach mehreren Wäschen gut halten.
- Gute Polsterung: Die Polsterung ist effektiv und bietet Komfort während der Fahrt, insbesondere auf längeren Strecken. Auch wenn sie nicht perfekt ist, bietet sie ein gutes Gleichgewicht zwischen Dämpfung und Flexibilität, was das Fahrerlebnis verbessert.
- Schnelltrocknend: Der Stoff trocknet schnell und ist atmungsaktiv, was für ein angenehmes Tragegefühl während intensiver Fahrten sorgt. Diese Eigenschaft hilft, Schweiß und Feuchtigkeit abzuleiten, sodass Sie trocken und fokussiert bleiben.
- Funktionelles Design: Das rutschfeste Design sorgt dafür, dass die Hose auch bei intensivem Radfahren an Ort und Stelle bleibt. Zudem ist die Reißverschlusstasche auf der Rückseite ein praktisches Feature, ideal zum sicheren Aufbewahren kleiner Gegenstände wie Schlüssel oder eines Energiegels.

Gesamteindruck:
Die TCA Herren Slipstream Gepolsterte Radhose ist eine solide Wahl für jeden Radfahrer, der Komfort und Qualität sucht. Mit guter Polsterung, langlebiger Verarbeitung und schnelltrocknendem Stoff bietet sie alles, was Sie für eine angenehme Fahrt benötigen. Die kleinen Unvollkommenheiten in der Polsterung mindern das Gesamtbild nicht, was diese Hose zu einer großartigen Option für sowohl Freizeit- als auch ambitionierte Radfahrer macht.

Sehr empfehlenswert für alle, die eine zuverlässige und bequeme Radhose suchen! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: A little flexy at the joint
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
I bought this paddle because it seemed like a pretty solid upgrade from the one that came with my SUP, and because I wanted one that was just a little bit longer for maximum comfort while standing.

I like it for the most part, but when extended out to the "stop" point, it feels like there's a bit of extra weird flex like, like the inner metal tube isn't 100% completely seated in the outer one. It stays together, just feels weird when I put pressure on it, almost like it's about to bend at the joint.

Another small downside: the fasteners that tighten the clamp that holds the shaft in place aren't hand-adjustable, and actually require a screwdriver. You really probably only have to adjust it once, but I forgot to check the tightness of the clamp before I took it out to the lake, and didn't have a screwdriver with me.

Other than those two minor details I do like it though, and it is a pretty solid and not super expensive upgrade to the paddles that come with many SUPs.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
These are really good boxes that do a good job in achieving ideal conditions for pizza dough to prove. I didn’t notice any chemical smell when I opened the boxes, and the boxes / lids were all very well made.
The only adverse comment that I have is that they could do with being a little larger. When we are making pizza, we like to use a pizza dough mix to cut down on the faff involved in getting the right types and proportions of flour, yeast, salt and sugar - it’s just easier. This madea dough ball that fit nicely into the dough box, but after 45 minutes proving, it had pushed the lid off the box. I’d oiled the boxes prior to use, so getting the dough out was really simple. It was then just a case of rolling out the dough, putting it onto the baking tray, adding toppings, and slam it into the woodfire grill - 5 minutes later, a perfect pizza with no mess and no hassle.
I’ve attached photos of the dough ball, the proved dough, and the cooked pizza, just to show how well the boxes work for us (I know, I know - it’s got pineapple on it! That’s the way we like it…).

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Strong, stretchy flat cords with really strong sturdy hooks. Awesome
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
I ordered these bungee cords for my husband to use for holding his ladders securely in place in the garage. Packed as a pair, these purple-coloured waterproof cords are absolutely perfect. Most cords that I’ve seen and used in the past are constructed from a single round elastic cord, with a metal hook at either end. This is usually secured by way of the cord being bend double, to prevent it slipping out of the hook. The cord of this product is very different, and made up from 8 individual thinner cords, woven together to form a single flat cord. This gives it so much extra strength. Being flat allows it to have more surface contact with the item you are securing. Also, the hooks on these cords are substantial and really strong.

One end of the cord has a plastic-coated metal hook, which appears to be bonded in place. The other end of the cord has the same type of hook, but is secured to the cord using a sliding clamp. This allows the cord to be fully adjustable in length. This feature, along with the length that the cords can stretch, make them an ideal addition to any garage, workshop, or car. My husband is really pleased with these ones, so I thoroughly recommend them. They are definitely worth the money.

For years I’ve been using stainless steel insulated tumblers of various sizes. They’re certainly convenient for the car, but even in the office I like them. Not so much that I’m worried about spills, but I like my coffee hot. Still, at times a more normal sized coffee mug is desired, as I don’t always need 20, 30 or 40 oz of coffee sitting at my desk.

This SassyCups 12 oz insulated stainless steel coffee mug is the perfect size for a small cup of coffee. The lid is similar to what I have on some of my larger tumblers and it’s spill proof, at least as long as the cover is slid over the drinking hole. It’s even watertight if you turn it upside down and vigorously shake - admittedly something you’re not likely to do with this. However, I usually use this without the lid on. I can see using the lid if I’m walking around with it, sipping some coffee. However, I likely wouldn’t use this for my commute. The handle prevents it from sitting properly in my car’s cupholders, and I have plenty of larger ones that would work better for the long commute. I could see using this while camping.

Stainless steel interior with the top lip also stainless steel. Body a nice, black power coating with a comfortable handle and a travel inspired slogan and artwork.

Can’t say if it’ll keep drinks hot or cold for four hours, but it certainly works well for the length of time I need it to before finishing my coffee, even without using the lid. However, while I don’t notice any performance differences between this one and another similar 12 oz mug I own, this one is slightly shorter. Same lid size and almost identical circumference around the bottom, just shorter. I suspect that the wall thickness is less as the volume between the two are identical.

I can wholeheartedly recommend this attractive, SassyCups insulated stainless steel coffee mug.

I have looked for the 'right' pillow for years and this has come the closest to being 'it'. Solid foam pillows are too, well, solid; down/feather start well but then collapse during the night; neck pillows make it hard to change position. This pillow is supportive but soft and moldable.

To make it work you're going to need to commit to a new pillow regime though- it is high-maintenance. On delivery, you unzip it and take out handfuls of the foam bits which tend to go everywhere and are challenging to retrieve. Save these!!! You may need them again. After achieving an estimated fullness, zip it up and fluff it, pinching and pulling until the foam is distributed to your preferred shape. You will need to perform a modified version of this routine every night. It's worth it for a good night's sleep and no sore neck. After a night or two to evaluate, you may need to either remove more foam OR add some back (from the foam you definitely made sure to SAVE). Occasionally you'll need to unzip it and aerate and fluff all the foam.

The beauty of this pillow is that you can make a unique, fully adapted shape to suit you. I fluff it full, then roll to have neck support, with corners slightly plumped as I'm also a side-sleeper. Mine had NO smell and I'm a super-smeller:) The only downside for me is that the pillow has a lumpy feel, which is unavoidable as the foam is in lumps, which is the whole point of the pillow. This does not bother me for sleeping but is just a little 'ick'. A thick, quilted pillow protector would alleviate this but would, in turn, make it more difficult to prepare for sleep.

Still searching for the 'perfect' pillow but not sure such a thing exists.

Das TCA QuickDry Jungen T-Shirt ist eine ausgezeichnete Wahl für junge Sportler, die Komfort und Leistung suchen.

Hier sind einige der herausragenden Merkmale:

QuickDry Technologie: Das T-Shirt besteht aus einem speziellen Material, das Feuchtigkeit schnell ableitet und dafür sorgt, dass die Haut trocken bleibt. Dies ist besonders wichtig bei intensiven sportlichen Aktivitäten wie Fußball und Training.

Atmungsaktiv: Das atmungsaktive Gewebe ermöglicht eine gute Luftzirkulation, wodurch Überhitzung vermieden wird und der Tragekomfort erhöht wird. Ideal für lange Trainingseinheiten und Spiele.

Bewegungsfreiheit: Das T-Shirt bietet eine hervorragende Passform und Bewegungsfreiheit, sodass sich die Kinder frei bewegen können, ohne eingeschränkt zu sein. Dies ist besonders wichtig für sportliche Aktivitäten.

Langlebigkeit: Die hochwertige Verarbeitung und das strapazierfähige Material sorgen dafür, dass das T-Shirt auch nach vielen Wäschen seine Form und Farbe behält. Es ist robust genug, um den Anforderungen des täglichen Trainings standzuhalten.

Stilvolles Design: Das schlichte, aber stilvolle Design in Schwarz macht das T-Shirt zu einem vielseitigen Kleidungsstück, das zu jeder Sportausrüstung passt. Es sieht nicht nur gut aus, sondern erfüllt auch seinen Zweck.

Insgesamt bietet das T-Shirt eine hervorragende Kombination aus Funktionalität, Komfort und Stil. Es ist eine lohnende Investition für jeden jungen Sportler, der auf der Suche nach einem hochwertigen Trainingsshirt ist.

- Article manquant
- Sur une même page, articles non compatibles entre eux
- Sur une même page, 2 pinces différentes qu’on a du mal à différencier quand on n’est pas un spécialiste de la gamme. Au passage, est-ce que les empreintes de sertissage sont compatibles avec les 2 pinces ?

Ich bin Mitglied des Amazon-Vine Review-Programms und erhalte manche Artikel zu für einen gewissen Zeitraum unentgeltlich zum Testen, Probieren und Bewerten.
An dieser Stelle schreibe absolut ehrliche und persönliche Bewertungen (das können positive, aber auch negative Erkenntnisse sein.)

Belle Vous Gummiseil - Packung mit 2 Spanngummi mit Haken

Ich habe von AMAZON diese Spanngummis zum Testen und Bewerten bekommen.

Als „Häusle-Besitzer“ mit PKW Anhänger bin ich öfter mal unterwegs um die verschiedensten Gegenstände zu transportieren. Je nach Situation verwende ich feste Spanngurte oder auch mal Gummiseile mit Haken.

Und hier kommen die oben genannten Gummi-Spannseile ins Spiel.
Diese flachen Belle Vous Gummiseile sind komplett anders als üblichen „runden“ Gummiseile.

Diese Belle Vous Gummiseile lassen sich in der Länge immer wieder neu den individuell gebrauchten Längen anpassen.
Die angegebene Länge von 110 cm entspricht der absolut entspannten Länge, wenn das Gummi in voller Länge locker auf dem Boden liegt.
Von 110 cm kann ICH es bis auf ca. 250cm spannen.

Aber je nach persönlicher Längeneinstellung kann man diesen Spanngurt auch schon bei einer Distanz von 30 cm verwenden.
Die kunststoffbeschichteten Stahlhaken wirken sehr widerstandsfähig und hochwertig!
Die Spannkraft ist erstaunlich hoch.

Ob das Seil wirklich wie beschrieben allen Witterungseinflüssen und UV-Strahlen handhalten kann, kann ich leider (mangels Glaskugel) nicht vorhersagen.

Ich gebe gerne eine Kaufempfehlung und 5 Sterne

PS: Um das Seil in der Länge zu verändern, braucht man >beim ERSTEN Mal< Ruhe, Geduld, Fingerspitzengefühl, ein gutes Nervenkostüm, evtl. meditative Musik??

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Two different styles (they don't mention this)
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
I know there aren't a lot of options out there these days for Pixel 5 cases. Still, buyer beware - with this product, you might end up buying a case you weren't expecting. Although not advertised as such, there are TWO DIFFERENT STYLES, and it's almost impossible to tell from the images and descriptions.

Some of the case colors have holes cut out to access the buttons, fit the phone securely, and are more protective. These are labeled "Soft Slim PROTECTIVE TPU Silicone Cover."

And some of the other case colors cover the holes (which makes them very difficult to press), and the material is very thin, bendy, and just plain cheap. These are listed as "Soft Slim METALLIC TPU Silicone Cover." This cover is *so* thin that putting one slim magnet on the inside of the case (for attaching to a car magnet-type phone holder), the phone would not sit in the case securely and kept bulging out on the sides. Also, with the metallic colors, fingerprints show up on the case like crazy. It looks greasy and gross.

It's a shame because there are so many colors, but if the one you like (for me it was "Metallic Fuschia") turns out to be the cheaper version, you might have to pick one of the matte colors to get the better version, which limits the color choices.

If you are on the fence, maybe give the "protective" version a shot. At least it's not expensive and can be returned.

Not cool that kwmobile doesn't mention that there are actually two different case styles.

Design und Material

Die Backform besteht aus hochwertigem Silikon, das flexibel und zugleich robust ist. Diese Flexibilität ermöglicht es, gebackene Speisen leicht aus der Form zu lösen, ohne dass sie an den Seiten kleben bleiben. Die Antihaftbeschichtung verstärkt diesen Effekt und sorgt dafür, dass auch ohne zusätzliches Einfetten alles reibungslos herausgelöst werden kann. Das Design der Form ist schlicht, aber funktional, und passt gut in jede Küche.

Vielseitigkeit

Mit einer Länge von 22 cm ist diese Backform ideal für kleine bis mittelgroße Kuchen, Brote und andere Backwaren. Ob ein klassisches Bananenbrot, ein saftiger Zitronenkuchen oder sogar deftige Aufläufe – die Form ist vielseitig einsetzbar und eignet sich hervorragend für verschiedene Rezepte.

Handhabung und Reinigung

Die Handhabung der GOURMEO Silikon-Backform ist sehr einfach. Durch die Flexibilität des Silikons kann die Form leicht gehandhabt und platzsparend verstaut werden. Ein weiterer großer Vorteil ist die einfache Reinigung. Die Form ist spülmaschinenfest, was den Reinigungsprozess erheblich erleichtert. Alternativ lässt sie sich auch schnell und einfach per Hand reinigen, da keine Rückstände haften bleiben.

Backergebnisse

Die Backergebnisse in dieser Silikonform sind durchweg überzeugend. Dank der Antihaftbeschichtung gelingt es mühelos, Kuchen und Brote in perfekter Form zu backen. Die gleichmäßige Hitzeverteilung sorgt dafür, dass die Backwaren gleichmäßig durchgebacken werden, was besonders bei empfindlichen Teigen wichtig ist.

Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis

Das Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis der GOURMEO Silikon-Backform ist sehr gut. Für einen relativ günstigen Preis erhält man eine langlebige und vielseitige Backform, die viele Jahre in der Küche ihren Dienst tun kann. Die hohe Qualität und Benutzerfreundlichkeit machen sie zu einer lohnenden Investition für alle Hobbybäcker und -bäckerinnen.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: The size and design that I've been looking for, and it's a good cup!
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
I'd been looking for a coffee cup that I could mostly drink out of without the lid and do so without having to deal with an awkward mouth of the cup, as well as having the option to put a lid on it and take it with me when I hit the road etc... Also, I didn’t want one of those 30 or 40 oz tumblers, as that is just too large for my personal coffee cup liking, and this cup fit the bill for what I was looking for---16 oz. is just about almost the perfect size for me!

The cup is very lightweight, as it is constructed out of plastic, /or a plastic like feeling material, yet it does a good job at keeping my coffee warm, and this observation has been with the lid off the cup. The lid is likewise constructed of a plastic like material, it has a nice sized drinking hole, and it does not leak when the attached pivoting cap is inserted into drinking hole. This pivoting cap can also be inserted into a slot on the other side of the cup, which keeps it from flopping back and forth when drinking--- a nice and simple feature. Additionally, I like the large rubber band that encircles the middle of the cup, as the band is both excellent for improving the grip, as well as it just looks nice on the cup.

In conclusion, I am very pleased and satisfied with this SassyCups coffee tumbler cup, and this is for the many reasons and observations listed previously in my review---recommended!

Das Modul hat einen 3,3 V regler und wird mit 16 MHz betrieben. lt. Datenblatt (Kap. 29.6 Maximum speed vs. VCC, S. 386 Giure 29-2) liegt dies außerhalb des sicheren Bereichs. CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Kleine Kreidetafeln – Zweckmäßig, aber mit Schwächen
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Die kleinen Kreidetafeln im 6er-Set sind auf den ersten Blick eine praktische und dekorative Lösung für kurze Notizen und kleine Botschaften. Der Holzrahmen verleiht ihnen eine gewisse Eleganz und passt gut in viele Einrichtungsstile.

Verarbeitung und Material:
Die Verarbeitung der Tafeln ist solide, die Holzrahmen liegen gut in der Hand. Allerdings besteht die Schreibfläche nicht aus Schiefer, wie man es vielleicht erwarten würde, sondern aus Kunststoff. Diese Materialwahl hat einen entscheidenden Nachteil: Die Kreide haftet nur sehr schlecht auf der Oberfläche. Die Schrift ist oft unsauber und verblasst schnell, selbst mit hochwertiger Kreide.

Zweckmäßigkeit und Funktionalität:
Die Tafeln sind in ihrer Grundfunktion als kleine Notiztafeln durchaus brauchbar. Die Größe ist handlich und die doppelseitige Ausführung ermöglicht es, schnell zwischen verschiedenen Botschaften zu wechseln. Allerdings schränkt die schlechte Haftung der Kreide die Einsatzmöglichkeiten deutlich ein.

Fazit:
Wer nach kleinen Kreidetafeln für den gelegentlichen Gebrauch sucht und Wert auf eine ansprechende Optik legt, könnte mit diesem Set zunächst zufrieden sein. Die Verarbeitung ist ordentlich und die Tafeln machen einen stabilen Eindruck. Allerdings sollte man sich bewusst sein, dass die Schreibfläche aus Kunststoff besteht und die Kreidehaftung stark zu wünschen übrig lässt. Für anspruchsvollere Aufgaben, wie etwa das Beschriften von Menükarten oder das Erstellen detaillierter Notizen, sind diese Tafeln weniger geeignet.

Das Tritart Transparentpapier in DIN A4 Größe bietet eine hervorragende Lösung für alle, die präzise und hochwertige Druckergebnisse auf transparentem Papier erzielen möchten. Mit seiner klaren und weißen Oberfläche ist es ideal zum Bedrucken mit verschiedenen Drucktechniken geeignet.

Pro:

Hochwertige Transparenz: Das Papier bietet eine exzellente Klarheit und ermöglicht es, feine Details und Texte klar darzustellen. Dies ist besonders nützlich für Projekte, die eine präzise Visualisierung erfordern.
Vielseitige Verwendung: Es eignet sich hervorragend für eine Vielzahl von Anwendungen, einschließlich technischer Zeichnungen, Architekturplänen, und kreativen Projekten, die auf transparentem Untergrund gedruckt werden müssen.
Gute Druckergebnisse: Das Papier ist speziell für den Einsatz in Druckern entwickelt, was zu gleichmäßigen und scharfen Druckergebnissen führt. Es hat eine gute Aufnahmefähigkeit für Tinte und verhindert unschöne Verschmierungen.
Contra:

Empfindlichkeit bei Feuchtigkeit: Wie bei vielen transparenten Papieren kann es bei Feuchtigkeit zu Wellenbildung oder Verformungen kommen, was die Druckqualität beeinträchtigen könnte. Es sollte daher vor direkter Feuchtigkeit geschützt werden.
Druckkompatibilität: Bei manchen Druckern oder Tintenstrahldruckern kann es erforderlich sein, die Druckeinstellungen anzupassen, um optimale Ergebnisse zu erzielen.
Fazit:
Das Tritart Transparentpapier bietet eine ausgezeichnete Qualität für alle, die auf transparentem Papier drucken möchten. Es kombiniert hohe Transparenz mit guten Druckeigenschaften und ist vielseitig einsetzbar. Ein kleiner Nachteil ist die Empfindlichkeit gegenüber Feuchtigkeit, aber insgesamt stellt es eine wertvolle Ergänzung für verschiedene Druck- und Kreativprojekte dar.

🛁 Estantería en el baño: Esta estantería metálica está diseñada específicamente para aprovechar el espacio sobre el inodoro, optimizando el almacenamiento en el baño. Con unas dimensiones de 30,5 x 15,5 x 13 cm, es perfecta para colocar diversos artículos de tocador y mantener el baño ordenado.
🏗️ Estantes duraderos: Fabricada con acero inoxidable, la estantería es resistente a los arañazos, al óxido, al agua y a la corrosión, garantizando una larga vida útil. Además, es fácil de limpiar, lo que la hace ideal para el ambiente húmedo del baño.
🔧 Fácil de montar: La instalación es muy sencilla gracias a las almohadillas de montaje autoadhesivas incluidas. No es necesario taladrar, lo que facilita la colocación y evita daños en las paredes. Este diseño permite una instalación rápida y sin complicaciones.
🌟 Multiusos: Esta estantería de baño es versátil y puede utilizarse para organizar una variedad de artículos como papel higiénico, espuma de afeitar, champú, plantas en macetas, revistas, cosméticos y otros accesorios. Mantén tu baño limpio y ordenado con esta práctica solución de almacenamiento.
🌬️ Diseño funcional: La base de malla transpirable permite una circulación de aire adecuada, lo que reduce la acumulación de polvo y humedad. Este diseño no solo es funcional, sino que también añade un toque moderno y elegante a tu baño.

Aspectos para tener en cuenta
🔍 Capacidad de carga: Es importante no sobrecargar la estantería para mantener su estabilidad y durabilidad. Verifica las especificaciones de peso máximo recomendado para asegurar un uso seguro y eficaz.
🛠️ Superficie de montaje: Aunque las almohadillas autoadhesivas facilitan la instalación, es esencial asegurarse de que la superficie de montaje esté limpia y seca para una adhesión óptima. En superficies rugosas o con textura, la adhesión podría no ser tan efectiva.

En definitiva, esta estantería de baño blanca de acero inoxidable es una excelente opción para quienes buscan una solución de almacenamiento práctica y elegante. Con su fácil instalación, durabilidad y diseño funcional, esta estantería optimiza el espacio sobre el inodoro, manteniendo el baño ordenado y estéticamente agradable. Asegúrate de no sobrecargar la estantería y de instalarla en una superficie adecuada para disfrutar de todos sus beneficios.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Pratici e funzionali per una installazione sul legno, buona organizzazione degli utensili manuali
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Cerco di organizzare sempre al meglio gli spazi del garage per gli attrezzi a motore per la manutenzione del giardino di casa, come per i più basici manuali e quando ho notato queste CLIP o GANCI A MOLLA PORTA ATTREZZI mi hanno molto incuriosito per le interessanti caratteristiche in descrittiva ed ho deciso di provarli.

Nel tempo abbiamo già applicato delle strutture per posizionare i nostri attrezzi, si sono evolute negli anni e da tempo desideravo riordinare una piccola parete del garage, questi ganci con clip a molla li ho notati proprio nel momento giusto e li ho subito voluti testare sul campo.

I SUPPORTI nel numero di 10 arrivano in una compatta, pratica e funzionale confezione a busta e non appena rimossi ho potuto apprezzare la discreta QUALITA' progettuale e costruttiva, con la scelta di materiali validi e ben assemblati, per un mix di acciaio/metallo con inserti a molla nel realizzare un supporto che mi ha trasmesso una buona sensazione di solidità.

Come mi aspettavo, all'interno della confezione ho trovato anche il necessario per la installazione, ovvero anche le VITI per la installazione su un supporto in LEGNO che ho scelto tra quelli che avevo già disponibili.

Dal punto di vista estetico ho apprezzato anche il DESIGN di questi supporti, semplici quanto funzionali con la loro forma allungata e la leva laterale da premere per innestare il manico di un utensile anche piuttosto ingombrante.

Alla prova sul campo ho deciso di riorganizzare una piccola parete del garage per riunire una decina di attrezzi che si usano raramente e solo in alcune stagioni, ma che quando servono dobbiamo trovare in ordine ed ho perciò deciso di scegliere uno dei PANNELLI in LEGNO di buono spessore che avevo già disponibile su cui fissare le 10 CLIP/GANCI a molla.

In uno spazio di circa 120 cm, sono riuscito in un tempo piuttosto rapido a fissare i 10 ganci facendo uso delle viti fornite, semplicemente misurando la distanza media da un supporto all'altro ed aiutandomi con un avvitatore a batteria per velocizzare il lavoro.

Fissati i 10 ganci a molla sul pannello ho poi agganciato il pannello al muro tramite due tasselli piuttosto lunghi e nell'arco di una ventina di minuti avevo tutto pronto per appendere i primi attrezzi manuali.

In fase di posizionamento degli attrezzi, ho riscontrato una molla in apertura di ogni gancio di sufficiente robustezza, tale da non essere eccessivamente rigida e dura per inerire l'utensile, ma comunque resistente per sostenere un manico di circa 4, 5 cm di diametro senza difficoltà, con il relativo utensile per un peso complessivo di due, tre kg massimi ognuno.

Anche in fase di apertura della clip, il movimento è risultato sempre piuttosto pratico e rapidamente riesco a rimuovere l'attrezzo dal gancio per poterlo utilizzare in giardino.

Sul nuovo panello creato con i 10 porta attrezzi a molla, ho potuto al momento inserire alcuni utensili che utilizziamo meno, come un paio di rastrelli, due raccogli foglia, una zappetta, un attrezzo potatore allungabile, una accetta, un raccogli frutti allungabile.

Dato che ho inserito tutti i 10 supporti in uno spazio relativamente contenuto, ho però dovuto fare la scelta di inserire alcuni attrezzi con testa verso l'alto ed altri verso il basso, con una alternanza che ha migliorato la fruibilità di ogni utensile.

Grazie comunque alla funzionalità del supporto con la molla, è realmente semplice sostituire periodicamente quegli utensili da conservare in ordine perchè magari meno utilizzati nella quotidianità in alcune stagioni dell'anno.

Dopo la applicazione di questo set di 10 clip porta attrezzi, mi sento di promuovere i supporti per la facilità di installazione su una base in legno, che consente con estrema facilità di organizzare al meglio le attrezzature manuali di casa, destinando quelle a motore a supporti ben più resistenti.

Il produttore suggerisce inoltre un singolo carico massimo di 5 kg per ogni cip a molla, un peso complessivamente che valuto più che sufficiente per reggere la maggior parte degli attrezzi manuali da giardinaggio casalingo.

In quanto al PREZZO di 13.99 euro a cui i 10 supporti vengono proposti al momento della recensione della prima metà di luglio 2024, ovvero circa 1.4 euro cad., si tratta di un costo che valuto equilibrato per le caratteristiche del prodotto, spedito e consegnato con la abituale efficienza da parte di Amazon.

This coffee tumbler has solved those problems. It is light weight, holds a lot, the lid SCREWS on, has a flip top to open, easy to clean, easy to drink from and I love the rubber sleeve. I like the grip it provides for my hand. No worry about a 16oz cup full of hot liquid slipping out of your hand and into your lap. I have had that happen once. Not fun. I recommend this cup and I'm thinking of getting another one in pink.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Il funghetto che scioglie i nodi
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
“Automassaggiatore” non nel senso sperato che tu gli dai un paio di indicazioni e lui parte e ti massaggia per conto suo. Nah. “Auto” nel senso che il massaggio te lo fai tu invece di pagare un massaggiatore; e volendo puoi farti aiutare da questo aggeggino, che ti viene a costare parecchio meno e non richiede appuntamenti.
🔥— È una specie di funghetto azzurro di plastica dura, che sembrerebbe prelevato dal villaggio dei Puffi. Serve a stimolare non grandi aree muscolari, ma un punto specifico, quello in cui hai una contrattura (che, maledetta, può irradiare dolore anche altrove). Con la tua collaborazione, il funghetto esercita una pressione su questo nodo teso e dolorante, il “punto trigger”. La pressione aiuta a sciogliere la tensione rilassando le fibre contratte e aumentando il flusso sanguigno locale, ma forse anche con altri trucchetti suoi più raffinati. Ad esempio, “sovrascrivendo” il segnale doloroso con un segnale più forte. Più o meno quello che succede quando hai prurito e ti gratti, e in questo modo crei un segnale tattile più intenso che interferisce con la trasmissione dei segnali del prurito. Il tuo cervello si concentra sul segnale più forte e presumibilmente più importante, e lascia perdere l’altro.
✅— La punta è arrotondata e arriva bene al nodo dolente.
✅— Questo geniale funghetto invece del gambo ha una ventosa. Così puoi attaccarlo a una superficie liscia e usarlo senza mani, premendoci sopra il muscolo direttamente e muovendoti un po’. Io ho provato ad attaccarlo ripetutamente a una parete in marmo, liscia ma non proprio a specchio; si è sempre appiccicato all’istante ed è rimasto ben saldo.
❌— Naturalmente, se ti massaggi tenendolo in mano la presa è quella che è, perché il funghetto non ha gambo. La tua mano è sempre a contatto con la ventosa, che non è lì per provvedere un’impugnatura ergonomica. Se invece il funghetto lo fissi a una superficie, dovrai staccare e riattaccare la ventosa ogni volta che vuoi massaggiare un muscolo diverso; a meno che tu non sia Tiramolla.

P. S. Scelgo cosa comprare sulla base delle recensioni altrui, e adoro gli autori di recensioni informative e oneste. Cerco quindi di contribuire, se posso, scrivendo a mia volta recensioni informative e oneste. 💚

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Dose optisch sehr gut, Montage hmm...
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Leider müssen die Bedingungen bei der Montage 100% stimmen. Ich wohne in einem Altbau mit Dosen aus den 90ern. Bei der 1. Dose konnte ich die Originalschrauben benutzen, aber da man die Kabel von oben rein stecken und von hinten festschrauben muß, ist es bei zu kurzen Kabeln eine Fummelei diese festzuziehen, da man mit dem Schraubendreher zwischen Wand und Dose fummeln muß.

Also am besten nur einen kurzen Schraubendreher verwenden, zum Glück hatte ich Einen. Bei den alten Billigdosen vorher, konnte man von vorn einen Hebel drücken und die Kabel rein schieben.

Bei der 2. Dose gab es das Problem, das in der alten Dose dort keine Schrauben vorhanden waren, diese hielt trotzdem, da diese Klammern hatte.

Leider sind die mitgelieferten Schrauben sehr lang und beim rein drehen in die Verteilerdose ist mir der Kunststoff (für die Aufnahme der Schraube) weg gebrochen (da die Dose schon sehr alt ist und Kunststoff den Weichmacher mit der Zeit verliert).

Diese Dosen hier besitzen leider keine Klammern, die sich beim festdrehen der Schrauben spreizen. Also mußte ich die alte Dose wieder montieren. Die Aufnahme ist zwar weg gebrochen, aber durch die Klammern hält die Dose.

Ergo ist es wichtig, Dosen mit Klammern zu produzieren, so das man im Ernstfall noch eine 2. Montagemöglichkeit hat.

Es bestünde zwar theoretisch die Möglichkeit am Rahmen dieser Dose hier, 4 Schrauben mit Dübel zu montieren, dafür ist der Rahmen aber zu klein, da ich nicht genug Abstand zum Innenrand der Verteilerdose habe und beim bohren mir der Putz in die Dose bröckeln würde.

Schade, optisch sieht die Dose schick, mal keine billige Plastik Optik. Der helle Rand mit der dunklen gebürsteten Optik sieht gut aus. Ich muß leider weiter suchen und hoffen das es irgendwo auf der Welt so eine ähnliche Dose mit Klammern gibt. Lieber mehr bezahlen und man hat keinen Ärger in alten Häusern.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Good value 44-50cm length necklaces, but unsure whether they contain nickel
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
I am reviewing a “120 Pack Black Waxed Polyester Necklace Cord with Chain and Lobster Clasp - 50cm/19.7 Inches”, priced £9.99 at time of ordering.

Firstly, despite the slightly confusing listing, I can confirm that the maximum length of the necklaces I received is 50cm (including the clasp and extender chain) and the minimum is 44cm. At the time of writing, the online description says “The smooth strings measure 50cm (19.7 inches) in length and have a thickness of 15mm; The durable alloy metal lobster clasps measure 1.5cm (0.6 inches) in length, whilst the chain measures 6cm (2.3 inches)” which could be taken to mean the black cord alone is 50cm, which would give a length of 51.5-57.5cm. The 44-50cm length you get is fine for me, but it is on the shorter end of what is available and may not suit everyone.

The “alloy metal” used is unnamed and since the listing does not state they are nickel-free or “hypoallergenic”, I have to assume that they are not. I plan to use these with the pendants I make and sell and customers do generally prefer items that are confirmed as suitable for sensitive skin. These necklaces look nice and feel strong, so are really good value, but I have docked one star due to the use of unknown metals.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Good siphon, great for bare bottom, but will suck up sand
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Luigi’s fish tank cleaner/siphon:
Summary: Bare bottom tank 10gal- works great, quick water change, sucks up debris.
Sanded bottom 10 gal.- don’t get too close to the sand or it will suck up the sand.

Review:
I had been using this siphon for over a year now on a 10 gallon bare bottom quarantine tank. Worked well for water changes and removing uneaten food, waste and debris. (At one point I attached a foam paintbrush onto the end of the siphon w/ a rubber band. Worked well to clean the bottom of the glass while the siphon sucked up mostly what ever the foam brush got off the bottom.)

I more recently wanted to use the 10 gal. quarantine tank as a grow out tank for Hiplisoma pandas. (I never had to treat the QT tank so i figured I would use the same supplies). After hearing from an expert cory breeder that they should grow up not being on a bare bottom to prevent bottom fin decay, I added sand to the tank when I made the conversion. This siphon still works great for water changes but not so great for trying to vacuum the sand b/c boy does it suck up sand. I know the product is made for gravel per product description. It sucks up less sand if I disturb the sand to get the debris up and keep the siphon an inch or two above the sand. Still sucks up a little but much less than trying to use the siphon to disrupt the top layer of sand.

This is a versatile hanging file storage system as it can either sit on a desk or, by adding the included wheels, it can sit on the floor. The file system comes flat packed and requires assembly, which is really easy to do without needing any tools. Each of the pieces are joined together easily using shaped clips. The instructions advise adding the wheels to the base first before assembling the sides. I put this together temporarily as the place that it is to be used permanently isn’t quite ready and, as such I didn’t add the wheels, as the picture shows. The sides of the filing system are clipped to the base first. After that each side is raised and clipped to the one next to it. I clipped the top first all the way around before clipping at the base. At present I don’t have any hanging files so the picture shows a standard A4 folder in storage. Once assembled this does feel a little flimsy and the sides move easily. I am not sure how this will stand up in usage, but, in theory, the addition of the suspended files should stabilise it more. This storage system is also very easy to dismantle for ease of storage when not in use so is ideal as a temporary storage solution.

They’re suitable for the microwave, freezer and dishwasher, but the blue lids are a disappointment. They have a four-sided locking design. I could only close three sides and the fourth wouldn’t lock. The containers came with the lids off and stacked one inside the other. What a job I had to separate them. It was like a tug-of-war with my husband to pull them apart. Needless to say, I won’t stack them like that again.

Ho acquistato la custodia kwmobile compatibile con il mio Xiaomi Redmi 9T sperando di ottenere una protezione efficace e duratura, ma la mia esperienza è stata un po' deludente.

Dal punto di vista della protezione posteriore, la custodia è eccellente. Il silicone TPU è robusto e fornisce una buona ammortizzazione contro urti e cadute. La custodia si adatta perfettamente al telefono, offrendo una protezione completa per i bordi e il retro. Tuttavia, la protezione frontale lascia a desiderare. I bordi non sono abbastanza rialzati da proteggere adeguatamente lo schermo in caso di caduta frontale, il che rende necessario l'uso di una pellicola protettiva aggiuntiva per una sicurezza completa.

Un altro problema che ho riscontrato è legato alla durata del colore della custodia. Dopo solo una settimana di utilizzo, ho notato che il colore ha iniziato a saltare via nei punti in cui tocco di più, come i bordi e il retro. Questo rende la custodia meno estetica e dà un'impressione di usura precoce.

In sintesi, la custodia kwmobile offre una buona protezione per il retro e i lati del telefono, ma presenta alcuni difetti significativi. La protezione frontale è insufficiente e la durabilità del colore è deludente. Se cercate una custodia che protegga efficacemente il vostro smartphone e mantenga un aspetto estetico a lungo, potreste voler considerare altre opzioni.

These are listed both as shoe covers AND as overshoes. They are NOT the same thing.

Shoe covers cover only the upper part of the shoe, whereas overshoes cover the entire shoe. And we have perfectly good English words for both types of protective wear.

• Overshoes are called 'galoshes'. Yes, it's rare to hear such a term these days, but it's still a perfectly useful, and necessary, word.

• Shoe covers are called 'gaiters'.

This particular product misrepresents itself with the strong implication of being galoshes, whereas it is actually a pair of gaiters.

Here endeth today's lesson.

These are basically as described - a large pack of 50cm long necklace cords. Planning on using these to hold all the chain-less pendants I have a terrible habit of buying! Great value for money at £9.99.

Do note that the stated length includes the clasp and extension chain - if you're clasping at the base of the extension chain rather than at the end, that takes about 5.5cm off the length. Still, they fit around the neck just fine. (Really not sure what the other reviewer is talking about. 45-50cm is a perfectly fine necklace length that ends up with the pendant hanging a little below your collarbones!)

The clasp is relatively large, and so are the rings on the extension chain, but I actually prefer that, as it makes it easier to clasp. If you absolutely cannot get a pendant on one of these, I would recommend getting some jewelry pliers (a set with multiples is very inexpensive), opening the jump ring that connects the clasp to the cord, taking it off, sliding the pendant onto the cord, and then putting the clasp back on and closing the jump ring. I'm sure there's tutorials on the internet on how to open jump rings if you're unsure, and if you ruin one of the cords experimenting... well, there's 120 of them.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Awkward to adjust and a bit too stretchy
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
One of the main issues I have with these straps is the difficulty in adjusting the length. Because they double back on themselves it's a bit of a nuisance to pull some of the strap through then loosen it again to take up the slack. This would not be a problem if you decided to use these for just one job but this issue makes them a lot less versatile.

The other main issue is the integrity of the plastic moulded assembly that holds the steel part of the hook to the strap. The collar can easily be slid back and then the hook can detach from the fold in the elastic. However, it is unlikely to become detached in normal use, unless the collar becomes trapped or you manually pull it back and unhook it.

Unfortunately, although they seem very sturdy, the straps are actually very stretchy so I don't feel inclined to rely on them for anything other than very light-duty jobs.

The mug itself is quite large but due to the pattern/design and the fact that it is "double-walled" the drinking volume is not all that high. This can be a good or a bad thing. Personally I dabble with herbal teas and the like and as such this (relatively) small volume mug actually suits me for such purposes. Of course if you want to drink half a litre of Builder's tea at breakfast or lunch then this is not the mug for you, no matter how cute it is!

It is cute, yes, but before we get to design let me also point out that the 'double-walled' aspect I pointed out earlier actually helps keep your liquid (in my case herbal tea!) warmer for longer. This is a real thing by the way, not just empty promises. My drink earlier today was noticeably warmer for longer. It insulates better than your average mug, that's for sure.

I like it and I am quite chuffed with it. I am a cat person and like the design also, although I leave that until last because taste is subjective in that regard. The mug also comes with a spoon that is a decent size similar to a regular teaspoon, but it has a cute "paw" design on the business end. Whether or not you like the cup design is up to you, but I defy you to not find the paw spoon cute! Happy here.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Caja con un amplio surtido de tornillos avellanados en acero inoxidable. Tenemos medidas que van desde métrica 2 hasta métrica 5 con diferentes longitudes e incluyendo tuercas y arandelas.

Los tornillos vienen muy bien presentados en una caja donde se indica la métrica y medida de cada una de las posiciones de la caja organizadora.
Los acabados de los tornillos y tuercas son excelentes, y solamente he encontrado algún fallito en alguna arandela. Efectivamente están fabricados en acero inoxidable porque cuando acerco un imán muy potente apenas son atraídos.

Junto con la caja se incluyen llaves Allen muy básicas y unas pinzas. Las pinzas la verdad es que son bastante útiles para pillar los tornillos y arandelas de métrica 2 o 3 que cuestan de pillar con el dedo.

En resumen, un kit bastante completo y de calidad para tener en casa y que nos saque de algún apuro, con el seguro de que estos tornillos no se oxidarán al estar fabricados en acero inoxidable.

Die Hülle schmeichelt der Hand, es gibt ein angenehmes Haltegefühl (irgendwie seidig). Der Ständer ist praktisch und lässt sich leicht klappen. Aber angetan haben es mir vor allem die Farben der Hülle einfach schön.

Nun ich hätte besser messen sollen. Keine meiner Trinkflaschen für das Rad ist schmaler als der Halter, auf Maximum eingestellt, aufnehmen kann. Sogar 5mm schmaler als mein fest montierter am Rad. Dieser trägt, mittels federndem Material, Flaschen von 3,5 bis 8 cm.
Man sollte also unbedingt vorher mesen gehen. Die gesamte Einstellungsmöglichkeit ist für eine normale Trinkflasche überflüssig. Ich hatte eigentlich erwartet dort mehr als üblich nutzen zu können. Dafür kann aber der Halter nichts. Meine Erwartung war falsch. Hätte ich gemesen wäre dies vorher klar gewesen.

Der Halter ist gut verarbeitet. Er macht einen stabilen Eindruck und ist, abgesehen von der Befestigungsmöglichkeit, ganz normal wenn er auf Max gestellt ist.

Die Befestigungsmöglichkeit sollte man aber nicht unterschätzen. Es ist ein Unterschied ob eine Trinkflasche im Sichtbereich angebracht ist oder unten am Rahmen. Im ersten Fall behalte ich den Verkehr immer im Auge. Im anderen nicht.

Da der Halter nichts dafür kann, daß ich nicht nachgemesen habe, gebe ich dafür 3 Sterne.
Einen habe ich abgezogen , da ich keinerlei Sinn erkennen kann an einer Verstellmöglichkeit für die keine üblichen Flaschen vorhanden sind. Wäre man weiter auf 9,5 cm gegangen, dann hätte es sogar 5 Sterne gegeben. Flaschenhalter für 1,5L und 1L Flaschen sind selten.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Easy to assemble and reasonable sturdy
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
This mesh file box comes in pieces and you need to assemble it yourself.

It’s very simple to put together in a few minutes and technically doesn’t require any tools. The wheels just attach to the bottom with a nut which can be tightened by hand, but it’s better to use a wrench or spanner to get it properly tightened.

The panels clip together with some little black clips. I’m not sure if it was intentional, but I had an extra clip at the end. Maybe they included a spare.

Once assembled, it’s a little “loose” feeling. The clips hold onto the panels securely, but there is some play between them and I feel the would probably unclip if one of the sides is tugged when the box is fully loaded (it says it has a weight capacity of 15kg). I’m a little more cautious when I move it about than when moving the ones that are welded together. But that’s the sacrifice for something that can be easily flat-packed.

The wheels are basic castors and move about and rotate easily on smooth surfaces. None of the wheels have breaks, so you can’t lock the box in place.

Overall, it’s a nice little box that can be used for all kinds of household/office equipment.

I own several other BelleVous storage solutions, and after a lot of use, they are still as good as the day I bought them. So when I saw this set of four storage boxes, I had an inkling that they would be worth getting. And I wasn't disappointed.

I'm very impressed: they are well-constructed and sturdy, and great for storing my yarn stash. The clear windows make it easy to see the contents, too. Best of all though, is that they fit perfectly in my Kallax unit, and the bright colours look fantastic!

All in all, I am extremely happy with these boxes, and will be purchasing more in the very near future.

**Versatility:**
These socks are not just for lounging; they’re great for wearing around the house during the day or even as a cozy layer inside boots during colder weather. They’re incredibly versatile and cater to various needs.

**Conclusion:**
Overall, the SNOOG Fleece Lined Socks are a fantastic addition to any cozy wardrobe. They provide comfort, warmth, and style, all while ensuring safety with their non-slip design. If you’re looking for the perfect gift for yourself or a loved one, I highly recommend these slipper socks!

If you've baked pizza or bread, you know how it is. You make your dough, you separate it into portions, you set it aside to proof, and even if you have it in the fridge and it's wrapped in three layers of clingfilm... in the immortal words of Ian Malcom, life finds a way. And then you have dough everywhere and the outside of it has dried up and it's just not pleasant.

These little boxes do solve that, to an extent. Of course, once the dough rises enough, it will start pushing on the inside of the lid, and eventually pop it off. But that'll take time, and by when it gets to that point, you'll be wanting to use it, anyway.

Because they seal so well, these boxes are also helpful for other things around the kitchen. I've used them to hold small quantities of leftovers, as well as half a tin of tomatoes. You can stick them in the dishwasher, in the microwave, even in the freezer. Super versatile, and I would say worth the money.

Even if your car has a Tire Pressure Monitor (TPM) system, it's a good idea to have a hand held Tire Pressure Gauge of your own. And this system from Rhino USA is simply EXCEPTIONAL in every way. It's heavy duty and even comes with its own nylon bag to store it in.

Rhino USA is a small, family owned business and I really enjoy supporting small businesses in my home country. It is designed in the US, but manufactured in China. Still, the craftsmanship and quality of parts is exceptionally high. I chose the Analog version. It may be old tech, but it doesn't require batteries and I know I can count on it to work reliably for many years.

The gauge itself and all the parts which connect to your tire pressure valve are made of brass, which will never corrode or degrade. The dial is glow in the dark, if you need to check your tire pressure at night (I'm guessing they use luminescent paint on the markings on the gauge). It has an air release valve, so you can actually push it into your tire valve and remove it and the pressure it read will remain, until you press the air release valve. And if you find your tires are overinflated, while attached, you can press the air release valve to remove air easily. This is 0 - 75 PSI, but they offer this in 0 - 60 PSI as well. I chose the 0 - 75 PSI version as our cars do have spare tires and they are always inflated to a higher PSI than the standard tires on a car. I also like the braided 14 inch hose, which makes it so much easier to take a Tire Pressure reading.

This only cost $20 and for the price you get an exceptionally made Tire Pressure Gauge, designed and tested in America and sold by a small USA Company. The quality simply can't be beat!

Ps: I actually bought two of these puppies, one for each car in our household.

Die Schmuckbänder kamen in einer Plastikhülle mit Zippverschluss. Darin kann man sie auch gut verwahren, wenn man nicht sofort alle verarbeitet. Zusammengehalten werden sie durch ein Gummiband. Das gefällt mir gut, weil sie so nicht verzottelt und geknickt sind. Das habe ich nämlich schon bei anderen Produkten erleben müssen.

Die Schmuckbänder bestehen aus einer schmalen Kordel aus Polyester, haben einen Karabiner-Verschluss und einige Glieder zur leichten Größenvariation. Sie sind einheitlich in einer Länge von 50 cm. Bei einer erwachsenen Frau ist eine 50er-Kette halsnah. Durch die Glieder kann die Nähe zum Hals variiert werden. Man kann natürlich bei dem Wunsch nach einer längeren Kette einfach Glieder mehrerer Ketten verbinden und so die Kette auch verlängern. Bei Kindern ist der Spielraum größer, je nachdem, wie alt sie sind, gehen die Ketten auch schon bis zur Brust.

Die Verarbeitung ist einfach, aber funktionell und ausreichend nicht nur im Spielbereich, sondern auch für Erwachsene, die Wert auf eine solide Verarbeitung legen. Alle Ketten sind gleichmäßig in der Verarbeitung. Es gibt keine Fehlstücke.

Ich bin begeistert von den Schmuckketten. Sie sind bestens geeignet, um Ketten, Armbänder und Fußkettchen für Kinder und Erwachsene zu erstellen oder Anhänger und Steine anzubringen, zu einem sehr guten Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis.

Die Kanne ist aus Edelstahl und relativ schwer. Der Deckel und der Ausgießer sind aus Kunststoff, machen aber auch einen wertigen Eindruck. Der Deckel lässt sich gut auf- und zuschrauben, rastet ab einem gewissen Punkt ein und lässt sich dann noch ordentlich festdrehen, bis er auch nochmal kurz "einrastet", wenn er dann richtig zu ist. Öffnen und schließen lässt sich der Ausgießer dann per Knopfdruck. Der optische Unterschied zwischen geöffnet und geschlossen ist kaum erkennbar, das hätte man vielleicht noch besser lösen können. Aber am Ende ist das auch kein wirklich störender Punkt.

Der innere Teil der Kanne ist ebenfalls aus Edelstahl und somit auch bruchsicher. Das Teesieb, welches von unten an den Deckel geschraubt wird, lag bei der Lieferung lose in der Kanne und hat daher etwas "gescheppert". Es lässt sich aber problemlos an den Deckel schrauben und hält dort auch absolut fest.

Auch wenn der Griff nur in Holzoptik gehalten, aber aus Kunststoff ist, ist die Kanne laut Aufschrift leider nicht für den Geschirrspüler geeignet, sodass hier Handwäsche angesagt ist. Dank der weiten Öffnung, kommt man aber auch gut mit einer Flaschenbürste hinein.

This kit is not small. While it was larger than I was expecting (not going to fault them or amazon for that - I never bothered to check the size as it wasn't important in my selection of this kit), it is not so large as to be oddly-sized or inconvenient (I have a few other kits and organizers of the same size). I was also nicely surprised when I discovered that Wirefy had also included a detailed, illustrated, and color-coded list of the kit contents, complete with the part numbers and quantities included. This should make it much easier to order components when the need to restock the kit arrives.
