To be honest, on reflection and after receiving this kettle, it was not one of my best choices. They say beauty is in the eye of the beholder – well, perhaps I had something in my eye when requesting this. I know it's very subjective, but I think it's quite an ugly combination of wood and metal, especially for a kettle.

To be fair, the metal parts of the kettle are very good. It feels sturdy, and the finish applied to the body of the kettle will help prevent scratching. The listing mentions it’s fast boiling, but I was actually going to comment on the lengthy waiting times experienced waiting for it to boil. The wooden mechanism that connects the button to the whistle stopper could do with some refinement. I needed to use some fine-grade sandpaper to sand down the wooden channel that’s been cut to allow the wooden components to move. Also, the edges of the channel had rough, burred edges that needed cleaning up. After these small adjustments, it worked really well.

The other issue I had with this is the removable filler cap just beneath the handle. Mine is a really tight fit and somewhat of a struggle to remove.

When it comes to the whistle – this thing is really very loud! If you happen to be in the kitchen when it starts to sound, you almost want to place your hands over your ears. No one could say that they didn’t hear this kettle boiling, that’s for sure.

All in all, if all you’re looking for is the novelty of a loud whistling kettle, then this probably fits the bill. However, after the novelty wears off, you need to ensure there is something else you like about it because it’s big and hard to miss.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Ultra light-weight for summer only. Unlikely to fit well enough for compression.
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
These arm-sleeves are made of nylon and elastane fabric just about as thin and light as could be. They are also slippery, which might help if you wanted to pull other tops on or off over them. Imo arm warmers are a great idea, but I would not rely on these in Winter. There are much thicker but still stretchy arm-warmers to be had which will do a better job at keeping out the cold, the wind (especially important on a bike) and even the rain.

TCA claim that their Arm Sleeves will give UPF 50 protection from harmful sunlight. They also suggest they offer compression, but for most people the fit will not be good enough for that. A size small enough to compress your fore-arms may well cut off the circulation in your wrists. In my case, the sleeves fit well enough until they meet my puny biceps (upper arm), where they are so loose they don't even hold up, despite the anti-slip silicone grippers at the top.

Buying online anything designed to fit closely is always a bit of a gamble, and much more so when compression is the aim. I don't think I would spend the current price of £9.99 on these arm-warmers, but if you are tempted, TCA do offer Free Returns, so you can suss them out safely.

Non c'è nulla di più fastidioso di una cover che sembra attrarre ogni impronta digitale con cui viene a contatto, ma con questa cover ho finalmente risolto questo problema. Posso godermi la bellezza del mio telefono senza dover costantemente pulirlo dalle macchie.

It does seem to help with the oiliness as my scalp does feel less greasy, the mid-lengths of my hair feel a bit less dry and I feel I can leave it a little longer between washes. It's wider than I thought it would be, but that's ok as my hair is quite long (down to my shoulder blades), so it works very well with that length and helps to dry my hair quickly. CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Nostalgic and Efficient: A Delightful Whistling Tea Kettle for Modern Kitchens
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
I've been using the Belle Vous Black Whistling Tea Kettle for a few occasions now, and it has quickly become a favourite in my kitchen. Here’s a detailed account of my experience:

Nostalgic Appeal:
This kettle brings a delightful sense of nostalgia. It’s reminiscent of the old-school kettles that you place on the stove and wait for the cheerful whistle when the water boils. Hearing it bubble and whistle really adds a charming touch to the whole tea-making experience.

Ease of Use:
Straight out of the box, it’s very straightforward to use. Simply fill it with water, place it on your stove or hob, and wait for it to start whistling. It’s a refreshing change from modern electric kettles, offering a more hands-on and traditional approach.

Performance:
The whistling feature works perfectly, giving a clear and audible signal once the water has reached boiling point. It heats up efficiently on both stovetop and induction hobs, bringing water to a boil quickly and reliably.

Design and Build Quality:
The design is sleek and stylish, with a black stainless steel finish that looks great in any kitchen setting. The build quality feels robust and durable, ensuring it will stand the test of time. The 3L capacity is ample for making multiple cups of tea or coffee in one go.

Advantages:
One of the standout benefits is the joy of using a traditional whistling kettle compared to an electric one. There’s something quite satisfying about the manual process and the anticipation of the whistle.

Drawbacks:
So far, I haven’t encountered any significant drawbacks. It’s a simple, well-made kettle that does exactly what it’s supposed to do.

Final Thoughts:
The Belle Vous Black Whistling Tea Kettle is a fantastic addition to any kitchen, especially if you appreciate a touch of nostalgia in your daily routine. It’s easy to use, works efficiently, and adds a bit of old-world charm to making your tea or coffee. If you’re looking for a reliable stovetop kettle, this one is a splendid choice.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: The solder link to measure supply might not be connected.
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Twelve voltage meters. Three each of red, green, yellow and blue.

There is a spare solder pad beside the black and red supply wires. It is actually the measurement connection and mostly is shorted to the red PSU wire via a solder link. Unless this is going in a fixed 4.5V to 16V PSU or battery or 12V powered vehicle you are best to use +5V power and remove the solder link. Then add a wire to the bare pad for measurement, 0V to maybe 30V (not checked that high). It's about 300 K Ohm input impedance so a suitable series resistor or other circuit can extend the upper voltage, but you need to mentally multiply the display or blank the decimal point for x10..

I use about 1/4 cup in a load of laundry that is heavily soiled or when there is organic soiling on clothing, etc. I use it to remove odors from towels and it returns them to like new condition.

One cup in the kitchen drain at night, followed by a quart of warm water helps dissolve grease in the drain trap and replenishes the microbiome in the septic system.

A gallon goes a long way and is a great value for the money.

Den DC-DC Wandler habe ich an meiner kleinen Inselanlage im Einsatz um eine direkte Stromversorgung des Mähroboters zu realisieren. Hierzu wird die Spannung des Ladereglers auf 20V erhöht und zusätzlich im Strom begrenzt.
Da das Modul ein Display hat und die Spannungen anzeigt ist das Einstellen der Spannung ein Kinderspiel. Die Strombegrenzung habe ich zunächst auf Minimum gedreht und dann im Betrieb angepasst. Grundsätzlich wird durch eine Linksdrehung der Strom bzw. die Spannung verringert und durch eine Drehung im Uhrzeigersinn erhöht. Im Bild habe ich es nochmal explizit aufgemalt, da dies auch nicht explizit dokumentiert ist.
Das Modul hat zwei Schalter, die unterschiedliche Funktionen haben, je nachdem ob man sie kurz oder lange drückt. Der In/Out Schalter schaltet das Display bei kurzem Druck zwischen Eingang und Ausgang um. Drückt man ihn lange, schaltet er zwischen Darstellung von Stromstärke und Leistung um.
Der On/Off Schalter schaltet bei kurzem Druck den Ausgang aus oder ein. Drückt man ihn lange, so schaltet man Zustand des Ausgangs beim Reset/Bestromen des Moduls um. Den Effekt sieht man natürlich erst nachdem man das Modul erneut bestromt.
Leider lässt sich das Display nicht abschalten! Da es bei mir in einer Box steckt, ist das nicht weiter schlimm, sollte aber für sichtbare Anwendungen berücksichtigt werden.

Ho ricevuto questo oggetto gratuitamente per poterlo provare e fare una recensione con la mia opinione sul prodotto e il suo uso.
Attrezzo multifunzione, da tenere in auto in caso di emergenza.
Fà da martello spaccavetro (NON il parabrezza anteriore, stratificato, ma i vetri laterale e posteriore)
E' un tagliacinture, e incorporata c'è una torcia elettrica frontale con 2 livelli di luminosità e una lampada laterale a luce diffusa, la base è magnetica e infine fà pure da sirena.

Per il funzionamento delle luci e della sirena saranno necessarie 3 pile AAA, le ministilo, questo fatto mi porta a pensare che il progetto di questo utensile sia datato, ormai non si trova quasi più nulla che richiede batterie esterne, ormai è (quasi) tutto ricaricabile usb.

Alla prova le luci sono poco luminose, ma è chiaramente dichiarato, 150 lumen sono proprio pochini.
La sirena da 110 Db arriva a malapena a 98 Db, (con le batterie nuove, appena messe) giusto per infastidire chi ce l'ha in mano e poco oltre: d'inverno, con i finestrini chiusi, qualche auto che passasse non la sentirebbe. Comunque la siren..etta accende anche la lampada laterale, lampeggiante di rosso intenso, questo potrebbe attirare l'attenzione più della sirena silenziosa.
Il martello spaccavetri e il tagliacinture non li ho provati, non avendo vetri temperati e cinture vecchie su cui provare.
Le funzionalità descritte ci sono, ma le prestazioni (luci e sirena) sono un pò scarse, fosse ricaricabile USB e con una torcia elettrica potente, anche senza sirena e solo la luce rossa lampeggiante, varrebbe sicuramente 5 stelle, ma così com'è non mi sento di valutare più di 3 stelle: funziona ma è limitato.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Good For Protecting The 7"s You Care About
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Collecting isn't just about the items in the collection, it's about how they're stored, arranged, organized. I own a small number of vinyl record albums, and for the past few years I've been meticulous ensuring that each 12" LP gets sleeved up in plastic for protection. Once I decided to do the same with my 7"s, I needed to buy sleeves that would fit the size and keep my precious belongings in good condition.

Big Fudge is a well-known brand in the world of record collecting, selling a variety of products to sleeve, store, clean, and protect. These 7" sleeves were just a few dollars more for the 100-pack compared to the 25-pack; even if you don't need all of them at once, I think it's better to spring for the more cost-effective option. I was satisfied that each of the 100 sleeves were defect-free. It was easy to open them up and slide in my 7"s. I used all 100 of them, and now I'm even thinking about buying more.

Overall, this is a great quality product that will protect your 7" records, keeping them clean and orderly for many years of enjoyment.

Sin embargo no le doy cinco estrellas porque el hueco que trae para el puerto de carga no encaja, lo que impide cargar el ebook con la funda puesta. Esto tampoco es un drama porque el ebook no lo cargas frecuentemente, pero yo pensé que sí que encajaría. Tampoco trae hueco para el stylus 2 (esto ya lo suponía), pero este se imanta perfectamente por fuera y no se cae. A parte de esto, al cerrar la funda el ebook entra en modo descanso.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Cuello excesivamente dado de si, coger una talla menos de la que necesites
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Juego de dos camisetas deportivas con tejido similar a las camisetas técnicas.

El tejido es cómodo, algo fino y la talla es algo mayor a la europea, yo uso habitualmente la L y con estas camisetas hubiese acertado cogiendo la M.

Un detalle que no me gusta nada y no se si es exclusivamente por la talla es la apertura del cuello, me gustan las camisetas que queden bien ajustadas al cuello y estas queda el cuello demasiado abierto, como si estuviesen dados de si.

El lavado, tal y como indica la etiqueta, no deforma ni estropea el material, queda exactas a como las he recibido, tampoco han tenido mal olor y son suaves y, como he dicho antes, cómodas.

El largo tiene un tamaño ideal para que no te tape en exceso los pantalones, desconozco si una talla menos, quedaría demasiado por encima del trasero.

La relación calidad/precio no es de mi agrado, en cuanto al precio, 25€ no es mal precio si quedaran perfectas, con lo fino del tejido y el tipo de tejido, yo no pagaría más de 8 ó 9 euros por cada una, por tanto creo que el precio es algo elevado para el tipo de producto que se suministra. Son cómodas si, pero la talla no se ajusta a la de España. Si las compras, cerciórate bien, midiéndote antes y mirando la guía de tallas.

Espero haberos ayudado. GRACIAS por leer esta reseña. Un saludo

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: I'm very impressed and happy, but a couple small things didn't make it a 5/5
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION: I was really excited to see warm winter work gloves, even though it's the summer right now LOL, but I thought I could really use these when clearing snow from my driveway and sidewalk. I have thin gloves but they're too cold, and with the thicker gloves, it's hard to grab anything small or sort through a keychain. These gloves fit nice and snugly everywhere, and the nitrile coating is more than just a surface layer that could potentially peel off, it's more like it has actually penetrated into the fibers and seems very durable. I did receive a damages glove though, one of them had a hole ripped into it on the wrist area and it has started to run and unravel. That was disappointing, but I like how they are kind of form fitting, and the wrist area is nice and long to fit up into your coat sleeve to keep out the cold. There's a nice tight hem as well to keep the air out. The only other thing I didn't like just slightly, is that the inner lining wasn't attached very securely to the outer shell. When I took the gloves off, the inner layer became detached from a couple of the fingertips and now it takes a little effort to take them off without the guts coming out, but that could be a plus if they get wet and need to dry. One finger also had a little bunch of material or threads that I could feel rubbing on my fingertip so that was a little inconvenient as well, but I'm not going to be concerned about that while I'm working, and it'll probably break in over time, so no worries. Thanks for the great gloves.

I have not yet had an opportunity to test these lightweight spikes in challenging outdoor conditions. These relatively lightweight chained cleats are NOT designed for mountaineering or prolonged travel. They DO appear to be able to provide traction in heavy sucking mud, stretches of icy trails, and off-trail approaches near waterfall bases -- situations that regular crampons are not well suited for. Pull-on micro-spikes aren’t suited for these treacherous situations either as they fall off easily in rugged conditions (micro-spikes are more appropriate for icy pavement).

Two optional 2 Velcro & buckle straps accompanied the spikes. The limited instructions gave no guidance about these but use can be deduced through the online images. Unfortunately, straps are several inches too short. The included puncture-resistant drawstring bag is easy to toss into a pack. Spikes are not sharpened the way regular crampons are…which is just as well.

I am a seasoned climber experienced in crampon use on glaciated peaks throughout the western USA, Canada, & Mexico. I ordered the “Womens Large” because I will be using these spikes with heavy boots, not trail runners. They proved a perfect fit on both my leather Vasque Talus hiking/ trail boots (Womens 8 Wide) and very heavy leather La Sportiva Makalu mountaineering boots (Womens 8). Even without the optional strap I doubt they will ever fall off. With prolonged or too-heavy use I can see how the chains might break.

If my evaluation changes during use I will post an addendum to this review. In the interim, I feel that these spikes are a near-ideal solution for intermittent hiking or ice fishing traction.

Vine Programm
Dieses Produkt wurde mir kostenlos über das Amazon Vine Programm zum Test überlassen. Dafür bin ich dankbar, aber dadurch wird keine gute Bewertung „gekauft“!
Es handelt sich um eine unabhängige Bewertung!
Ich bewerte jedes Produkt als ob ich es selbst gekauft hätte (und vergebe die „Preis/Leistung“ Wertung, nach dem aktuellen Amazon Preis bei Bestellung).
Amazon betont selbst in den Vine Richtlinien, dass man unabhängig bewerten soll und genau das mache ich. Daher vergebe ich auch schlechte Bewertungen – wenn es ein schlechtes Produkt ist!
Bei der Bewertung ist mir immer auch der Umweltaspekt wichtig. Von Verpackung, über erwartete Lebensdauer, bis hin zur Möglichkeit der Reparatur durch uns Kunden.
Ich bestelle auch keine Produkte die ich nicht selbst brauche oder die von vornherein wie billiger Wegwerfmüll aussehen.
Bei Fragen zu den Produkten oder zur Bewertung gerne melden!

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Bonita para tenerla en casa, pero no para llevarla.
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Es una botella de vidrio borosilicatado en forma cilíndrica, con una capacidad de 450ml. En la parte inferior tiene un compartimento cerrado con rosca, en el que se guardan las piedras de cuarzo rosa. Incluye también una funda para proteger la botella y mantener la temperatura, y un infusor de rejilla para preparar tés o infusiones.

Las piedras de cuarzo vienen en un saquito de tela aparte, por lo que se pueden retirar en cualquier momento de la botella y guardarlas ahí, y poner cualquier otro tipo de adorno en el compartimento, o incluso los sobres de té que se vayan a utilizar más tarde. Cuando está colocado el cuarzo, suena un poco de tintineo al mover y beber de la botella, parecido al de los cubitos de hielo. Conviene retirar el compartimento al lavar la botella, ya que de rozarse y moverse en el interior, las piedras podrían desgastarse.

La botella es muy bonita, minimalista y estética, pero no la veo apta para llevarla fuera de casa en el bolso o en la mochila. Principalmente, porque, debido a su forma cilíndrica, no tiene muy buen agarre; no tiene un cuello por el que cogerla y beber, y la boca es muy ancha. Por tanto, sería algo incómodo llevarla en el bolso para ir bebiendo sobre la marcha. Por otra parte, debido a su fragilidad, sería necesario ponerle la funda (que es bastante decepcionante, de un color gris que no hace juego con las piedras), y entonces ya se perdería el efecto estético, que es el principal atractivo de este producto. Por último, tiene menos de medio litro de capacidad, lo que a un adulto no le llega ni para media mañana.

Por estos motivos, yo la uso como botella "de casa", que tengo en mi mesa de trabajo con agua y hielo o infusiones, y me voy levantando a rellenar; me sirve como recordatorio de estirar las piernas y descansar la vista del ordenador o los libros. La recomiendo para tenerla a mano y usarla en casa, pero, como he comentado, no me parece la mejor idea sacarla de casa.

Si adatta perfettamente al mio Galaxy A10 . Materiali adatti. Era subito disponibile dal venditore e ho fatto l’acquisto,ricevendo il pacchetto in pochissimo tempo !
È un tipo di custodia elegante, a libro, solida, sottile e ultraleggera.
Bisogna evidenziare alcuni vantaggi che altri casi di questa classe non hanno:
- Per cominciare, il tablet è saldamente tenuto sulla cover posteriore, che è realizzata in plastica semirigida e traslucida. Tutti i bordi sono protetti da urti o cadute, grazie al telaio rinforzato.
- Qualcosa di importante, i fori della cover posteriore lasciano spazio libero per tutti i comandi (pulsanti, area audio, presa di ricarica, fotocamera, ecc.).
Archiviazione perfetta per il Samsung. Ottima qualità. Prodotto secondo quanto riportato nella descrizione,lo mantiene ben protetto come il mio tablet dalla caduta.
Può essere piegato in modo piramidale offrendo due posizioni per la tavoletta: 1. Inclinazione di lettura (alta) e 2. Inclinazione di scrittura (bassa).
È sicuramente un modello di qualità, ben congegnato (e realizzato).
Allego qualche foto così che possiate vedere ciò che vi arriva dopo l’ordine. Posso anche piegare e usare il coperchio senza problemi. È molto stabile e soddisfa tutte le mie esigenze per uno stand.
Sono molto soddisfatto dell'acquisto e consiglio questo prodotto a chi cerca un buon articolo con ottimo rapporto qualità/prezzo.

Ho avuto l’opportunità di provare questi manicotti con fattore di protezione 50+ durante le mie sessioni di allenamento outdoor e sono rimasto piacevolmente sorpreso dalle loro prestazioni.

Innanzitutto, la vestibilità è ottima. Si adattano bene al braccio e, grazie alla loro leggerezza, risultano comodi anche quando le temperature sono leggermente più alte. Nonostante ciò, non sono l’ideale per una corsa sotto il sole di mezzogiorno d’agosto, ma sono comunque sufficientemente freschi per la maggior parte degli allenamenti all’aperto. Il materiale utilizzato è eccellente nel mantenere le braccia asciutte durante l’attività fisica, grazie alla sua capacità di traspirare efficacemente.

Un aspetto importante da notare è che i manicotti coprono solo la parte delle braccia, senza arrivare a coprire completamente le ascelle. Questo design li rende particolarmente comodi, evitando accumuli di sudore nelle zone più sensibili.

Un piccolo inconveniente riguarda le dimensioni: per chi ha braccia particolarmente allenate o più muscolose, consiglio vivamente di optare per una misura più grande. La parte con la guaina in silicone, che serve a mantenere alta la manichetta, è infatti un po’ stretta e non molto elastica. Questo potrebbe risultare scomodo per chi ha una circonferenza del braccio maggiore.

We needed a cover to transport our new E-MTBs and after reading tons of reviews on different products, settled on the Team Obsidian cover. I have to admit, I was a little skeptical after reading about issues with ripping, zippers coming apart and material coming off on the bikes. However, we needed a cover and decided to try it.

Upon receiving the cover, it was definitely well made. Definitely a 2-person job to get it on (and off) the bikes easily. The cover fit tightly, which was great and we thought that would reduce wind cavitation issues during travel. The piece that covers the hitch could have a bit better design, but 2 bungies solved that so we didn't have material flapping in the breeze. Lots of folks in their reviews talked about needing a mesh cover, but we used the 2 long bungies provided by Obsidian and had no issues.

The tight fit, bungies on the hitch material and paying close attention to ensuring the cover was aligned properly to the bikes worked well and there were zero issues on the first trip of about 350 miles! Would recommend this product.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Comfort e Resistenza per Piccoli Atleti
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
La maglietta è leggera e confortevole, perfetta per il calcio e altre attività sportive. Il tessuto Quickdry ha mantenuto mio figlio asciutto anche durante le giornate più calde, il che è stato molto apprezzato. La vestibilità è adatta per i bambini attivi e consente un ottimo movimento senza restrizioni.

Un punto positivo è la resistenza del tessuto; non si è sbiadita né usurata anche dopo vari lavaggi, il che è importante per capi destinati ai bambini. Tuttavia, la taglia potrebbe risultare leggermente più grande rispetto alle altre marche, quindi consiglio di fare attenzione alle misure prima dell'acquisto.

Diese Türknaufe sind sehr sauber verarbeitet und funktionieren tadellos. Sie sind vollständig aus Metall. Der Knauf ist innen hohl, aber das Material ist dennoch ausreichend dickwandig, um ein gutes haptisches Gefühl zu vermitteln und auch gelegentlich eine etwas grobere Handhabung zu überstehen. Klassische Türgriffe sind oft auch hohl und dünnwandiger und halten dennoch einiges aus.

Die Knaufe eignen sich natürlich nur für Zimmertüren und sie sind nicht abschließbar. Der Umbau einer Tür mit der hierzulande üblichen Verriegelung erfordert ein Mindestmaß an handwerklichem Geschick, denn sie passen natürlich nicht 1:1, aber das Ergebnis kann sich wirklich sehen lassen.

Am Verhalten der Tür ändert sich nach dem Umbau nichts, die Verriegelung ist ebenfalls robust und funktioniert vom Prinzip her sehr ähnlich wie sie hierzulande üblich ist. Die Tür kann weiterhin einfach zu fallen und natürlich auch leicht wieder geöffnet werden, allerdings nicht mehr per Türgriff, sondern per Drehknauf.

Das Set ist vollständig, für den Umbau von 5 Türen und kostet aktuell rund 35 € - ein angemessener Preis, in Anbetracht von Lieferumfang und Qualität. Daher bekommt das Set von mir eine klare Kaufempfehlung.

Ho avuto l’opportunità di provare queste calze alla coscia con fattore di protezione 50+ durante le mie sessioni di allenamento outdoor e sono rimasto piacevolmente sorpreso dalle loro prestazioni.

Innanzitutto, la vestibilità è ottima. Si adattano bene alla gamba e, grazie alla loro leggerezza, risultano comode anche quando le temperature sono leggermente più alte. Nonostante ciò, non sono l’ideale per una corsa sotto il sole di mezzogiorno d’agosto, ma sono comunque sufficientemente fresche per la maggior parte degli allenamenti all’aperto. Il materiale utilizzato è eccellente nel mantenere le gambe asciutte durante l’attività fisica, grazie alla sua capacità di traspirare efficacemente.

Un aspetto importante da notare è che queste calze coprono solo la parte delle cosce, senza arrivare a coprire completamente le zone intime. Questo design le rende particolarmente comode, evitando accumuli di sudore nelle zone più sensibili.

Un piccolo inconveniente riguarda le dimensioni: per chi ha cosce particolarmente allenate o più muscolose, consiglio vivamente di optare per una misura più grande. La parte con la guaina in silicone, che serve a mantenere alte le calze, è infatti un po’ stretta e non molto elastica. Questo potrebbe risultare scomodo per chi ha una circonferenza della coscia maggiore.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Very Nice, Large, Glass Hurricane Lamps – Just Some Hand-Blown Consistency Issues
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
These glass hurricane lamps are very nice and made with quality. The set of three weighs just under 5½ pounds, so these are solid vases – unlike others that are made of such thin glass you’re afraid to even grab or lift them. These vases also have weighted bottoms that will help keep them in place. I also like the air bubbles strewn throughout the glass: they add nice texture and visual appeal.

My only issues have to do with consistency. These are hand-blown, so naturally they will have some variation, but in my case, that variation is noticeable. First, the largest vase has much fewer air bubbles than the two smaller vases. When displayed as a set, it looks like the largest vase “doesn’t belong.” (See close-up photos of the largest vase and one of the smaller vases.)

Second, I specifically ordered these because I have a graduated set of two Halloween hurricane lamps that I wanted to place within each of the two larger vases to add another “layer” to the effect. Bottom line: as long as you don’t mind the more rustic (i.e., inconsistent, hand-blown) nature of these hurricane lamps, they are very nice (see a few photos).

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Buon contenitore per il cibo dei nostri amici a 4 zampe!
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Ho avuto l'opportunità di provare il contenitore per crocchette Navaris grazie al programma Amazon Vine e posso dire che si è rivelato un prodotto molto pratico e funzionale. La sua ampia capacità di 14 litri è stata una caratteristica particolarmente apprezzata, permettendomi di conservare una grande quantità di cibo per il mio cane senza doverlo ricaricare frequentemente.
La comodità e praticità di questo contenitore sono evidenti. Il coperchio ermetico mantiene il cibo fresco a lungo, evitando che si secchi o perda di fragranza. Questa caratteristica è fondamentale per garantire che il mio cane possa gustare sempre crocchette di qualità. Inoltre, la facilità di pulizia del contenitore semplifica notevolmente la gestione quotidiana del cibo.
Dal punto di vista della robustezza, il contenitore Navaris non delude. È costruito con materiali solidi e resistenti, capaci di sopportare l'uso quotidiano senza problemi. La trasparenza del contenitore è un ulteriore vantaggio, in quanto permette di monitorare facilmente il livello delle crocchette e sapere quando è il momento di riempirlo nuovamente.
Un altro aspetto positivo è la funzione di regolazione delle porzioni. Il dosatore incluso permette di servire sempre la giusta quantità di cibo, assicurando che il mio cane riceva le porzioni adeguate alla sua dieta. Questo è particolarmente utile per mantenere sotto controllo l'alimentazione del mio animale e prevenire problemi di sovralimentazione.
Nel complesso, il contenitore per crocchette Navaris si è dimostrato un ottimo acquisto. Ad un prezzo di 38.99€ al momento di questa recensione, offre una combinazione di capacità, praticità e robustezza che lo rendono un accessorio indispensabile per chiunque abbia un cane. Sono molto soddisfatto del mio acquisto e lo raccomando vivamente a tutti i proprietari di animali che cercano un modo efficiente e conveniente per gestire il cibo del loro amico a quattro zampe.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Warnung: Versand erfolgt in Plastikhülle und nicht im Karton. Produkt kommt daher zerknickt an.
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Das Produkt an sich ist erstklassig und den Preis wert.

Allerdings verschickt dieser Verkäufer nicht selbst, sondern nutzt ein Amazon-Fullfilment-Center für den Versand. Das Problem dabei ist leider, dass Amazon die Hüllen in bloß in einer Versandtüte verschickt, nicht in einem stabilen Karton. Und folglich kamen die Hüllen verknickt bei mir an.

Abgesehen davon, dass eine verknickte Hülle nicht schön aussieht, passt sie auch verknickt nicht ohne Probleme in ein enges Platten-Sleeve, ohne dieses zu weiten.

Der Verkäufer findet, das sei nicht sein Problem und ich solle mich an Amazon wenden. Und Amazon ist halt Amazon und die sagen nur, ich solle die Hüllen zurückschicken und neu bestellen –  und im Zweifel erfolgt dann der Versand wieder in einer Tüte statt in einem Karton.

Schade, denn diese Hüllen sind preislich für die sehr gute Qualität tatsächlich top. Und Protected & Co. bieten alle derzeit keine Innenhüllen mit runden Ecken und ohne Innenfutter an.

Würde der Verkäufer sich um einen guten Versand im Karton kümmern, wäre dieses Produkt tatsächlich etwas, was ich regelmäßig kaufen würde (ich besitze über 12.000 Schallplatten und kaufe jedes Jahr hunderte Innenhüllen). Solange der Verkäufer aber eben sich darum nicht kümmert und jede Hilfe ablehnt, kann ich – leider – nicht empfehlen, bei diesem Verkäufer dieses Produkt zu kaufen.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Buona maglietta correlato al prezzo, asciuga il sudore velocemente
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Ho avuto l'opportunità di testare la maglietta Quickdry per ragazzi grazie al programma Amazon Vine e posso dire che è una scelta eccellente per i bambini attivi.

Design e Vestibilità
La maglietta si presenta con un design semplice e funzionale, perfetto per chi non ama fronzoli inutili. La vestibilità è comoda e fedele alla taglia, anche se ho notato che può risultare leggermente piccola per alcuni bambini. Nel mio caso, ho ordinato due taglie in più per mio figlio di 9 anni e, sebbene inizialmente sembrasse grande, è stata una scelta saggia per garantirne l'uso prolungato. La consiglio a chi ha bambini in fase di crescita rapida o preferisce una vestibilità più ampia.

Qualità del Materiale
Il tessuto è leggero e traspirante, ideale per le attività sportive. Mio figlio l'ha indossata per gli allenamenti di calcio e ha trovato che la maglietta lo mantiene fresco e comodo anche durante le sessioni più intense. La Quickdry, come suggerisce il nome, si asciuga rapidamente, il che è un grande vantaggio durante le giornate calde e sudate o dopo un lavaggio.

Performance e Utilità
Questa t-shirt è perfetta per le attività all'aperto, come il calcio e la corsa, grazie alla sua capacità di mantenere i bambini freschi e asciutti. È particolarmente utile nei mesi estivi quando le temperature sono elevate e si cerca un capo che possa offrire comfort senza compromettere le prestazioni sportive.

Durabilità
Finora, la maglietta ha mantenuto la sua forma e il colore anche dopo numerosi lavaggi, dimostrando una buona durabilità. Non ho riscontrato problemi di scolorimento o perdita di forma, il che è un ottimo segno di qualità.

Rapporto Qualità-Prezzo
Con un prezzo che si aggira intorno ai 20€, potrebbe sembrare un po' caro per un capo sportivo non di marca. Tuttavia, considerando la qualità del tessuto e la funzionalità offerta, ritengo che sia un investimento valido per i genitori che cercano abbigliamento sportivo di buona qualità per i loro figli.

Conclusione
Nel complesso, sono molto soddisfatto di questa maglietta Quickdry per ragazzi. È una scelta eccellente per i bambini attivi che necessitano di un capo sportivo comodo, resistente e performante. La consiglio vivamente a tutti i genitori che desiderano un prodotto affidabile per le attività sportive dei loro figli.

Valutazione: ★★★★☆

Pro:

Design semplice e funzionale
Materiale leggero e traspirante
Ottima per lo sport e le attività all'aperto
Buona resistenza ai lavaggi
Contro:

Taglie leggermente piccole, potrebbe essere necessario ordinare una taglia in più
Prezzo leggermente alto per un capo non di marca

Las cintas hombreras de bucle no son cosidas fijas , en la parte posterior disponen de sistema de velcro ancho, por lo que se pueden fijar a una barra sin tener que retirarla, esto hace que también se puedan fijar fácilmente en travesaños de porterías de pérgolas metálicas de barras redondas o cuadradillo , directamente a la estructura del gazebo o cenador exterior ,a cualquiera de sus soportes siempre que estén al mismo nivel (para que la cortina mantenga su forma y su caída natural).
A nivel de precio, bueno son unos 20 € , para una cortina de esta calidad, versatilidad y dimensiones está bien si encima te cuadra la medida y no tienes que estar perdiendo tiempo en recortarlas o mandarlas a ajustarlas a otras medidas. Aunque son bien largas y tienen bastante caída por su peso en exteriores donde sople mucho el aire es conveniente atarlas a un lado de la zona media o baja o ponerles peso en dobladillo o con algun sistema magnético para que el aire no las vuele por encima de la pérgola o el gazebo.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Highest load capacity for a 2 inch caster 440lbs!
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
I recently purchased a mechanics creeper that you could sit on. It was built of 1 inch square metal tubing, and m8 sized stem bolts on the 2.5 inch casters that came with it. But when I sat on it it collapsed! I mean it really collapsed --and it even bent 3 of the 4 M8 sized caster stem bolts. And they were inside of the square metal tubing when the creeper collapsed. (and yes I am fat , but come on! In what world does one inch square metal tubing, fold spindle and mutilate like a wadded up gum, wrapper???) Anyway I am going to use these heavy duty 2 inch casters to make a heavy duty creeper-style cart that I can sit on without it collapsing. At least that is the plan. I evven bought some thicker walled square tubing this time around.

These 2 inch GBL casters are very well made. fit and finish on all the metalwork is excellent. And they have the best braking system on each caster that I have ever seen on any caster of this size class. The brakes have a very positive lock, and an easy release. This turns out to be good for me, as I will probably be operating them with my fingers.

The wheels are soft, kind of like a skate board wheel, so I can run this thing around my kitchen if I want, and not hurt any floors. They are very quiet too.. Each wheel bearing, has a plastic anti dust and hair cap on each side, to keep stuff from contaminating the ball bearings. The axle of each caster is a bolt! Yes! it is an actual; machine bolt, with a hex lock nut with a nylon insert, instead of those cheap rivet-axles that are in everyone else's casters. This implies to me that the casters may even be repairable.
The stem bolt on each caster are metric M10's with 1.5mm pitch threads. The stem-bolt pivot bearing plate, is almost the same diameter as the wheel! I am sure this will provide the needed strength and support so that each caster can handle their rated load of 110lbs per caster. So far I am very happy with these casters and plan to get a couple more 'sets of 4', and I have not even built anything yet.

Die Radhose passt in S wie erwartet. Bisher hatte ich Markenhosen z.B. von Löffler, die wesentlich teurer sind.
Die TCA Radhose kommt an die Qualität von Löffler nicht heran, dennoch muss hier auch der deutlich niedrigere Preis beachtet werden und so groß wie der Preisunterschied ist, ist glücklicherweise der Tragekomfort nicht.

Die Radhose von Löffler wirft überhaupt keine Falten. Die von TCA wirft einige Falten, die aber weder dramatisch, noch störend sind.

Die Beinabschlüsse sind bei beiden Hosen rutschsicher. Es rutscht nichts hoch, es schnürt (bei meinen dünnen Beinen) nichts ein.

Vom Sitzpolster bin ich positiv überrascht. Es fühlt sich in etwa an, wie das von Löffler nach 6000km Nutzung. Bleibt zu hoffen, dass die Wirkung mit der Zeit nicht zu stark nachlässt.

Taschen braucht man eigentlich nicht an einer Radhose. Dafür hat man Taschen am Radshirt. Die Seitentaschen würde ich allenfalls für Taschentücher nutzen. Größere Dinge stören hier und könnten evtl. herausfallen. Die hintere Gesäßtasche ist allerdings sinnvoll, insofern man eine kleine Tasche benötigt. Diese hat auch einen Reißverschluß im Gegensatz zu den seitlichen Taschen.

Wo man gegenüber Löffler jedoch Abstriche machen muss ist die Länge am Rücken. Hier ist Löffler deutlich länger und schützt so besser den Nierenbereich vor Fahrtwind. Bei aufrechter Sitzposition mag es noch in Ordnung sein, bei sehr tiefer Sitzposition (z.B. Rennrad) bleibt die Frage, ob das so ausreicht. Sicherlich auch eine Frage der eigenen Figur. Hier würde ich jedoch ein Unterhemd empfehlen.

Alles in allem für den Preis eine gut gemachte Radhose, die mit einem ordentlichen Sitzpolster überrascht. Jedoch muss man Abstriche bei der Rückenlänge machen. Bei sehr warmem Wetter und einer etwas aufrechteren Sitzposition sollte das bei entsprechender schlanker Figur jedoch passen. Für kühlere Tage und tiefer Sitzposition würde ich eher etwas anderes suchen, was im Rückenbereich länger ist.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Don’t be misled by the instructions! The doohickey isn’t a n infuser basket.
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
This is a really nice insulated teapot. I hope it continues so, the last on I had in a different make suddenly lost all its insulating capacity (I still don’t understand how).
However, there’s a little mesh doohickey that screws to the underside of the lid. The instructions show tea being put *into* this doohickey to use it like an infuser. That would not work. If you put the tea in the doohickey, you won’t be able to screw the doohickey on properly. The outflow via the cap is in the centre of the bit the doohickey screws onto, If you *do* manage to screw it on you will either block the outflow, if you are using a large leaf tea, the leaves will swell so much that they will prevent you pouring, or yet all the mechanism bunged up with leaves, if you are using a finer leaf.
Since you can’t disassemble the whole mechanism, you really don’t want tiny tea leaves sitting inside it growing mould.
The doohickey is a tea strainer, not an infuser. If you are using loose leaf tea, put the leaves in the pot itself and the doohickey keeps them from blocking or clogging the outflow.
A nice feature that isn’t mentioned is that you push the top button once and the valve stays open until you press it again, rather than having to hold it down as you pour.

Ça fait plusieurs années que je pratique le yoga chaud. J'ai commencé avec un tapis méga glissant auquel j'ai ajouté des serviettes pour remédier à cette situation. Mais comme j'y allais très souvent, je trouvais que ça n'était pas une bonne option. Trop de lavage et d'achat de serviette spécial yoga. Ensuite je suis passé au liège, mais c'est un matériel que je ne pouvais pas laver à mon goût. Le b mat aussi était pas mal mais les poils de cheveux, de mes animaux ou les saletés collait dessus et la serviette ne glisse pas pour bien laver. Mon meilleur tapis j'étais incapable d'en retrouver un, mais l'image de ce tapis semblait identique. Alors j'ai décidé d'oser. Et vraiment, j'ai retrouvé mon bonheur. C'est un 5 sur 5 ce tapis. Il ne glisse pas du tout et cela même si mon tapis est mouillé par ma sueur au yoga chaud. Le fait que le fond soit pas la même couleur permet de différencier du côté sol, il se lave bien avec la serviette pour essuyer la sueur et vaporiser un nettoyant et les saletés ne colle pas dessus. Alors pour moi c'est parfait. Il est un peu plus lourd que le liège mais l'épaisseur ici est parfaite entre la confortabilité et la lourdeur. ( je voyage en autobus et à pied, donc ça compte pour moi). Mais c'est important de bien le faire sècher entre les utilisations parce que mon dernier, je l'ai jeté justement parce que j'avais mal pris soin et des petites tâches de moisi étaient apparu. Ma seule petite déception c'était que j'aurais aimé un plus grand choix de couleur. Je n'aurais sûrement pas pris rose pâle. Je cherchais un jaune poussin ou orange pour mettre de la vie dans ma pratique. Je vous recommande cette article pour ceux qui pratique le yoga chaud.

Der Navaris Balancierbalken hat sich bei uns zuhause als echter Hit erwiesen. Unsere Kinder lieben es, sich auf diesem Spielzeug auszuprobieren und dabei ihre Balance und Geschicklichkeit zu verbessern.

Das Set besteht aus 6 Balken und 6 Verbindungselementen, alles aus robustem Sperrholz und Kiefer gefertigt. Dadurch ist es nicht nur stabil, sondern auch sicher für aktive Spielstunden, sowohl drinnen als auch draußen. Die Montage war überraschend einfach und schnell erledigt, was ich besonders geschätzt habe.

Was mir besonders gefällt, ist die Vielseitigkeit dieses Balancierbalkens. Er fördert nicht nur das Gleichgewicht meiner Kinder, sondern regt auch ihre Fantasie und Kreativität an. Ob sie nun über die Balken balancieren oder sie zu neuen Konstruktionen zusammenstellen, es gibt immer etwas Neues zu entdecken und auszuprobieren.

Für mich als Elternteil ist die Sicherheit meiner Kinder oberste Priorität, und hier habe ich volles Vertrauen in die Qualität des Produkts. Die stabilen Materialien und die zuverlässige Konstruktion geben mir die Gewissheit, dass sie sicher spielen können, ohne dass ich mir Sorgen machen muss.

Zusätzlich ist das Set auch praktisch im Gebrauch. Nach dem Spiel lässt es sich leicht auseinandernehmen und platzsparend verstauen. Das macht es nicht nur für uns zuhause, sondern auch für den Transport und Einsatz an verschiedenen Orten sehr praktisch.

**Mein Fazit:**
Der Navaris Balancierbalken ist ein hervorragendes Spielzeug, um das Gleichgewicht und die Kreativität meiner Kinder zu fördern. Mit seiner robusten Konstruktion und der einfachen Handhabung ist es eine klare Empfehlung für alle Eltern, die ihren Kindern eine gesunde und aktive Spielzeit ermöglichen möchten.

Nachdem ich mit einem Panzerglas-Displayschutz wegen der damit erheblich verschlechterten Funktion des Fingerabdrucksensors auf meinem neuen Galaxy S23 nicht zufrieden war, habe ich nach einer dünneren Alternative gesucht, die dennoch vor Kratzern schützt.

Meine erste Alternative war der Versuch mit einer weichen TPU-Folie - leider eine noch schlechtere Altetnative wegen verminderter Displayhelligkeit, verfälschter Farbwidergabe und schlechter Blickwinkelstabilität.

Die hier angebotene ähnlich dünne Displayschutzfolie von "KW-Mobile" ist eine echte Alternative. Endlich eine gute Displayfolie für's S23 !

Was ist damit besser gegenüber Panzerglas oder TPU-Folie:
+Der Fingerabdrucksensors funktioniert in der Praxis gut ;

+Schnelles scrollen u. Wischen auf dem Display durch
glatte Oberfläche ;

+keine Beeinträchtigung der Farbwiedergabe u. Displayhelligkeit (wie z.B. durch abgedunkelte TPU-Folien) ;

+gute seitl. Blickwinkelstabilität beim Ablesen des Displayinhalts ;

Was ist besonders bei der KW-Mobile-Folie:
++Das sehr gute Preis-Leistungsverhältnis - 6 Folien in der Qualität für 6,99 € - top !

Neutral:
= Mit etwas Geschick u. Geduld bekommt man diese Folie mittig u. blasenfrei auf's Display. (Bei mir klappte es leider erst nach dem 3. Versuch perfekt)

=Fingerabdrücke werden befriedigend absorbiert ,

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: pantaloncini per fare sport in materiale tecnico
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Ho acquistato questi pantaloncini da calcio neri TCA per mio figlio di 9 anni, taglia 10-12 anni, perchè vorrei che gli andassero bene anche l'anno prossimo.

Punti positivi:
Tessuto: Il tessuto è tecnico, elasticizzato e traspirante. Sembra abbastanza resistente e dovrebbe durare nel tempo.
Tasche: I pantaloncini hanno due tasche laterali con cerniera, che sono perfette per riporre piccoli oggetti come chiavi o monete.
Colore: Il nero è un colore versatile che si abbina a qualsiasi maglia.
Freschezza: Il materiale è fresco e leggero, perfetto per le giornate calde.

Punti negativi:
Vestibilità: I pantaloncini sono un po' goffi e gonfi sul davanti. Mio figlio li trova un po' scomodi da indossare.
Elastico solo nella parte davanti: non ho capito questa soluzione tecnica.

Conclusione:
Nel complesso, questi pantaloncini da calcio TCA sono un buon prodotto, ma la vestibilità un po' goffa li rende meno confortevoli di quanto potrebbero essere. Se state cercando dei pantaloncini da calcio neri per il vostro bambino, vi consiglio di provare una taglia più piccola o di cercare un altro modello con una vestibilità più aderente.

Altri dettagli:
Taglia: 10-12 anni
Colore: Nero
Materiale: Tessuto tecnico elasticizzato
Prezzo: Circa 20 euro

This set of shelves arrive in a plain brown cardboard box measuring approx 33cm x 33cm x 9cm.

Inside the box, the shelves are ready assembled and stacked inside each other ready to hang.

The distressed finish looks just like the product images, but I have painted them to fit better in the room I got them to use in.

Each of the 4 shelves is the same depth but a slightly different size.
Smallest shelf is 7cm deep x 18.5cm x 18.5cm (outer dimensions, inner dimensions are 17cm x 17cm)
Next one up is 7cm deep x 22.5cm x 22.5cm (inner dimensions 20.5cm x 20.5cm)
Next one up is 7cm deep x 26.5cm x 26.5cm (inner dimensions 24.5cm x 24.5cm)
Largest is 7cm deep x 30.5cm x 30.5cm (inner dimensions 38.5cm x 38.5cm).

The rope used to hang them from is fairly bitty, but strong enough to hang these easily and has a nice rustic look to it.

Easy to hang (they will just hang off a screw) but not made for anything with much weight to it.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Preiswertes Ersatzteil, nicht ganz so ausgeführt wie das Original
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Nachdem ich bereits die Ohrpolster meines HyperX Cloud Alpha ersetzen musste, ist nun das Kopfpolster fällig gewesen. Äußerlich ist das Ersatzteil kaum vom originalen Kopfpolster zu unterscheiden.

Achtung: Es liegt keine Anleitung bei!
Man muss die zwei Schrauben pro Seite lösen. Vorsicht: Ein kleines schwarzes Plastikteil kann sich dabei lösen und herunterfallen. Es gehört an die Unterseite der beiden verschraubten Kunststoffteile, so dass man den weißen Höhenversteller nicht sieht und er gehalten wird.
Der Bügel ist an den Seiten offen und wird lediglich eingeklemmt. Im Inneren des Bügels befindet sich ein schwarzer Metallbügel mit Schraublöchern für die Stabilität und ein durchsichtiger Kunststoffstreifen, der zusammen mit dem rückseitig auf dem Polster angebrachten Kunststoffstreifen dafür sorgt, dass die rote Metall-Ohrmuschelhalterung reibungsfrei dazwischen hoch und runter flutschen kann. Dieser schwarze Metallbügel ist in dem Ersatzteil NICHT enthalten, man muss ihn also ausfädeln und im Ersatzteil einsetzen!
Darüber hinaus hatte ich das Gefühl, dass das blaue Polster des Ersatzbügels etwas weniger gut polsterte als das Original, so dass ich die Polster ebenfalls (vorsichtig) getauscht habe. Und den Kunststoffstreifen gleich mit, denn auch dieser war im Original wesentlich dicker ausgeführt. Aus dieser Erfahrung bin ich etwas skeptisch gegenüber dem Kunstleder und hoffe einfach, dass wenigstens das genauso "gut" gemacht ist wie das Original und nicht schon nach einem Jahr das Zeitliche segnet. Daher auch erst mal nur solide 4 Sterne dafür.

Das Verbindungskabel der beiden Ohrmuscheln ist im Bügel geführt und lässt sich leider nicht einfach lösen. Ich wollte dann aber nicht auch noch die Ohrmuschel aufschrauben und rumlöten, daher liegt es jetzt einfach außen. Es stört bisher überhaupt nicht, ansonsten nehme ich irgendwann Nadel und Faden und werde es grob an der Außenseite des Bügels annähen.

Als Alternative kann man auch eine Art Sleeve / Hülle für das Kopfpolster kaufen, wo dann auch das Kabel mit reinpasst (der Link ist nur ein Beispiel, da gibt es viele Möglichkeiten).

Der Vollständigkeit halber noch die Historie meines Headsets zur Einschätzung der Haltbarkeit:
Kauf des Headsets (66€): 01/20
Ersatz Splittingkabel (Garantie): 01/21
Ersatz Ohrpolster (8€): 10/21
Ersatz Kopfpolster (9€): 06/24

Grundsätzlich bin ich aber super zufrieden damit; ich habe mehrere Headsets im Preisbereich bis 100€ ausprobiert und das HyperX Cloud Alpha war für mich mit das beste, um bei FPS-Spielen Gegner und deren Schritte zu orten.

Bellissima questa patella, realizzata con materiali di ottima qualità, che si differenzia dai classici modelli per via del suo fondo, composto da tre strati, uno centrale in alluminio, posto tra due in acciaio inox. Questa composizione permette di sfruttare la migliore conduttività dell’alluminio, mentendo però i vantaggi dell’antiaderenza data dall’acciaio inox.

Già a tenerla in mano si percepisce la qualità dell’oggetto. Ha un peso notevole, dato dallo spessore del fondo, e presenta una superficie con una texture molto bella, che protegge la padella dai graffi. Comodo anche il manico in acciaio, con una forma ergonomica e pratica da impugnare.

Sono rimasto molto soddisfatto dal suo utilizzo, ottenendo una perfetta cottura sia con carne, pesce e verdure. Gli alimenti vengono cotti in maniera uniforme su tutta la superficie e non si attaccano mai sul fondo.

La scheda di sviluppo ESP32 NodeMCU di AZDelivery è un componente che ho valutato attentamente, utilizzandolo in vari progetti di elettronica e programmazione compatibili con Arduino. Ecco le mie impressioni dettagliate.

Rapporto Qualità-Prezzo: 5/5
La scheda offre un eccellente rapporto qualità-prezzo. Con prestazioni affidabili e un costo accessibile, si posiziona come una scelta vantaggiosa per hobbisti e professionisti che lavorano su progetti IoT o di automazione domestica.

Versatilità: 5/5
La versatilità di questa scheda è stata una piacevole conferma. Grazie alla sua compatibilità con l'ambiente di sviluppo Arduino e la varietà di librerie disponibili, ho potuto esplorare una vasta gamma di applicazioni, dai semplici progetti di sensoristica a complessi prototipi IoT.

Comodità d'Uso: 4/5

Connettività: 5/5
La connettività WiFi integrata è un punto di forza dell'ESP32. La facilità con cui si connette e comunica con altri dispositivi e servizi online amplifica il suo potenziale d'uso in una varietà di scenari.

Supporto e Documentazione: 5/5
La documentazione fornita da AZDelivery e la community online sono risorse preziose. Ho trovato molte guide e forum di supporto che mi hanno aiutato a risolvere dubbi e a implementare funzionalità più avanzate.

In conclusione, la scheda di sviluppo ESP32 NodeMCU di AZDelivery si è rivelata un'ottima scelta per i miei progetti di elettronica e programmazione. La consiglio vivamente per il suo valore, le sue capacità e la facilità con cui si integra in diversi contesti di sviluppo.

En resumen, estas piedras decorativas de BELLE VOUS son una excelente elección para cualquier persona que busque mejorar su espacio con un toque de elegancia y funcionalidad. Definitivamente recomendaría este producto a otros y estoy muy contento con mi compra.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Volume is a bit too small, but it's sleek, transportable, and very light.
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
I received this small thermos to review.

I've found myself using this thermos quite a bit since receiving it, taking it out with me on walks, bike rides, and occasionally in the car when I don't have time to finish my pot of coffee at home.

This entire thermos will hold (as demonstrated in the attached video) just about 380ml of liquid. In the video, I poured into an unusually large mug, and the thermos holds probably a touch over a standard mug's worth of liquid (my normal one holds about 320ml, compared to this thermos' 380ml).

This leads to a bit of a dilemma for me. On the one hand, I really like how compact, sleek, and transportable it is, but if you're ultimately only able to carry a single cup of tea or coffee, is that really worth a thermos style device rather than an insulated coffee mug?

I do like the push-button to pour liquid out, and I haven't noticed any leakages so far. This is despite the lid not sitting quite flush with the thermos, as I have tried to demonstrate in an attached image.

It keeps your drinks lovely and hot though, even through a cold winter walk. I did some testing at the end of January and found that this little thermos kept my drinks nice and hot about as well as my expensive 1L Stanley thermos did. And this thing is wonderfully light, coming in at just over 280g when empty.

I'm not entirely convinced by the four little mugs that come with this though. They hold a very small amount of liquid, and if you were to divide your 380ml between your four friends, you'd have less than 100ml between you. Perhaps enough for an espresso, but next to useless on a long walk. No, this works much better as an individual thermos, and I've found it works very well in that respect. Perhaps they could have made the cups a little deeper?

Overall, I really like this. I feel it could have been made slightly bigger to incorporate more liquid, but it more than functions as a one-person thermos for walks and hikes. I would give it a try.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Nice hammock for a lighter person
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
This is a great little hammock for use in the garden. I am looking forward to getting it set up in the summer.

The hammock has flexible hoops that holds the insect net up which remind me of those used in a pop tent and as a result there is a bit of a knack to fold it up small enough to get it back in the carry bag but nothing too challenging.

The material is a very lightweight parachute type material. It was plenty strong enough to hold my son and I think it would be fine for a smaller adult but I was not sure I would trust it with my weight (being 6ft and definitely heavier than I would like to admit :) ) - so I would stick with the 65 kg weight stated in the description. Having said all that, it was well made and probably would take a little bit more if you wanted to risk it. The carabiners that come with it are also well made and sturdy.

The hammock is great for a garden. Not really designed or intended for heavy duty use but with the included webbing straps, it is quick to put up and doesn't damage the trees you might attach it to so it would be fine for taking on a hike or a family camp if you can find some good trees to attach it to.

Overall, I would recommend it and mine will likely mainly be used in the garden on nice warm sunny days.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Schöne Gläser für Overnight-Oats und mehr
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Im Rahmen des Vine-Programms bekamen wir kostenlos zum Testen einen 3 er Set Glas Behälter zur Aufbewahrung von Lebensmitteln der Fa. "BELLE VOUS" zur Verfügung gestellt. Wie von Amazon gewohnt erfolgte eine schnelle Lieferung.

Die 3 Gläser kamen sehr gut verpackt an, ich brauchte einige Zeit um sie aus den Aussparungen zu "friemeln".

Optisch gefallen sie uns wegen den Vintage-Aussehen sehr. Der Bambusdeckel mit dem Griff aus Metall, die Rillen am etwas dunklen Glas sehen sehr schön aus.

Die Verarbeitung ist gut, alles ist glatt, keine Splitter etc. aufgefunden. Durch den Gummiring schließen die Deckel hermetisch.

Die Rillen sind im inneren des Glases, so dass es von außen leicht zu reinigen ist. Wenn wir feuchte Lebensmittel (z. B. Haferflocken mit Joghurt) drin hatten, so ließen wir die Reste nicht antrocknen, so dass das Reinigen auch hier einfach ist.

Die Griffe am Deckel sind nur zur Zierde, die als Transportgriffe zu verwenden rate ich von ab. Die Löffel sind, weil sie breiter und mit kürzerem Stil sind, gewöhnungsbedürftig. Wir nehmen daher lieber unsere gewohnten. Ein Glas nutzen wir zur Lagerung von Sojaflocken, einen Löffel zum Dosieren.

Was schade ist, dass sich kein Hinweis über Mikrowellentauglichkeit der Gläser findet. Ich esse Haferflocken, auch als Overnight-Oats, sehr gerne warm. Im Internet fand ich auf der Seite "mikrowellen.net" den Hinweis, dass Borosilikatglas häufig als Koch- oder Backgeschirr verwendet wird. Allerdings dann nur das Glas (ohne Deckel) und sicherheitshalber erwärme ich die eingeweichten Haferflocken nur.

Summa summarum von uns 5 Sterne für die schönen Vintage-Gläser.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Left a horrible gluey residue and damaged my guitar
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION: These stickers are meant to help memorize the fretboard, not be permanent, obviously. I had these on my brand new $600 electric guitar for less than 24 hours and tried to remove them. They left a horrible sticky, gluey, sappy residue all over the fretboard and neck. In one area where the sticker wrapped around the back of the neck, the end of the sticker pulled off a small piece of the top clearcoat and some wood layers, leaving a notch of bare wood exposed to the elements. My brand new inspected to be perfect by SweetWater, beautiful instrument immediately damaged by stupid cheap stickers that are probably 2 decades old, maybe causing the adhesive to break down like this. And to get my measly $9 or whatever back I have to print out a label myself and mail the torn sticker remnants back to Europe? I spent a day scrubbing my fretboard with damp soap and water solution and magic eraser, removing all the oil from the unfinished wood, an awful sight to see on a beautiful piece of art, then reoiling the fretboard and restringing the guitar. F this seller. What a GD disaster.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Loved these until I tried to remove them
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION: Let's start with the good - the grip is super strong. Ultimately, this is the main selling feature of this product as alternate products on the market (e.g. suction ones) tend to fall off rather quickly. When I removed the soap holder from the clips to give it a good clean, one of the clips broke off and another cracked (but stayed on). Not ideal but the dish still clipped back in. I don't recommend trying to remove it at all or you risk cracking the little hooks. I am moving soon and needed to remove this for the next owner. That was the really bad bit. Though the product sticks/adheres VERY well, which I loved, that is also the part that I hated because I needed to remove it. It isn't as simple as "apply heat with a blowdryer and it will peel off". It took me 2 full hours to try to get this off the tile. Knowing what I know now about removal, I would only recommend this product if you know for certain that you will never try to peel it off, or else you'll be cursing the world as I was. That said, great product but man that removal was brutal.

Squats, whether performed weighted or as "air squats", are one of the most important resistance exercises. If you're like me, however, the squat motion can feel awkward and uncomfortable, particularly at the lowest point of each rep. Tenere tutto ordinato potrebbe sembrare una cosa semplice, ma non lo è affatto se si è sempre di fretta o se si è la classica persona che trova un proprio ordine nel caotico disordine. In particolar modo per quanto riguarda gli oggetti personali, non è raro sparpagliarli per casa, venendo poi assaliti dal senso di smarrimento quando si vanno a ricercare. Per questo penso che oggetti come questo organizzatore di effetti personali, possa dare concettualmente un grande contributo a tenere tutto in ordine e a portata di mano.
Il prodotto arriva tutto smontato in tutte le sue componenti, le quali vanno incastrate tra loro e fissate con delle viti date in dotazione. Per le persone più avvezze e pratiche nell'assemblaggio di oggetti e piccoli mobili, potrebbe essere un gioco da ragazzi, mentre potrebbe essere più complesso per persone meno esperte. Quanto detto deriva dal fatto che nella confezione risultano del tutto assenti le istruzioni di montaggio, costringendo quindi ad andare a intuito con il rischio di montare i pezzi in modo errato.

Il materiale, in base a una minima esperienza nella conoscenza dei legni, viene dichiarato come legno di pino, ma presentandosi troppo leggero, fa dubitare di esserlo. Credo sia più un legno di balsa scurito con un impregnante che ricorda il colore del mogano (marrone/rossiccio).
Al tatto non si avverte una convincente consistenza e robustezza, dando l'impressione che se dovesse cadere a terra, potrebbe facilmente rompersi.

Le dimensioni sono ottimali per poter riporre tutto quello che si vuole. Ho potuto riporre lo smartphone, il portafogli, l'anello, airpod, orologi, ecc in modo abbastanza organizzato e comodo. La cosa che invece ho trovato certamente scomoda è la presenza dei 2 fori nella parte destra della base, che dovrebbero essere alloggiamenti per 2 penne, perché ho notato che in quella posizione sono più un intralcio che un componente funzionale dell'organizzazione, obbligandomi a rimuovere le penne, per poter afferrare agevolmente gli oggetti situati dietro esse.

Esteticamente si presenta bene e si potrebbe integrare facilmente con qualsiasi tipo di arredamento. Su questo nulla da eccepire.

Tirando le somme, questo prodotto è sicuramente un oggetto pratico, dalla bella estetica ma carente soprattutto nella sua struttura e nel montaggio. Non posso quindi valutare questo organizer a punteggio pieno.

Grazie per la lettura.

Not only are these tubs simple, sleek and stylish, they also have an airtight seal, making them perfect for food storage! I love to use tubs and containers to store my food, as not only does it make it more aesthetically pleasing, it also helps with space efficient storage and organisation in my kitchen.

The tubs are of a good size (approx. 10cm x 30 cm), and have a good capacity. The indents in the lids of the tubs are perfect for measuring spaghetti portions, and I find this a really useful feature of the tubs.

However, I am quite disappointed with one aspect of these tubs. No matter what way I put the lid on the tubs, I could never get them to stack properly! Every time the corner piece would just be a milometer too big, meaning the tubs could not stack and be flush with one another. It is quite a shame as I had hoped to use these tubs to stack the different pastas in my cupboard!

Despite this, I have managed to find other uses for these tubs in different areas of my home where I don't require them to stack. I've got one storing stationary in my home office, in the kitchen storing spaghetti and the other in my bathroom holding cleaning tablets. If anything, they're proving to be quite versatile now!

Overall, I do find these tubs useful (even if they're not being used for their intended purpose), but I do find them a little overpriced at 3 plastic tubs for £16.49.

If they were to ever come on sale, then I'd recommend!

Der Thermobecher kommt sauber verpackt, die Optik des Thermobechers ist schon mal sehr gut, tolle Farben und sauber verarbeitet. Der Clou ist natürlich die Temperaturanzeige, braucht man die? Nein, aber es ist cool.
Die Haptik des Thermobechers finde ich persönlich sehr angenehm, er hat eine sehr angenehme rutschfeste Oberfläche und eine angenehme Größe.
Der Thermobecher hatte keinen starken Geruch von irgendwelchen Weichmachern oder ähnlichem.
Ich habe den Becher direkt von Hand gespült, natürlich habe ich beim Deckel aufgepasst, aufgrund der eingebauten Technik wollte ich den Deckel nicht komplett ins Wasser tauchen.
Als erstes wollte ich sehen, wie genau die Anzeige, die Dichtigkeit und die Isolierung des Bechers ist. Dazu habe ich den Becher zunächst mit kochendem Wasser gefüllt.
Ich habe mit einem Fleischthermometer gemessen (das auf +-1 Grad genau ist), die Temperatur betrug 75 Grad, der Becher zeigte nach ein paar Minuten 70 Grad an, das ist zwar ein Unterschied, aber da die Temperatur des Bechers nicht direkt in der Flüssigkeit gemessen wird, ist das völlig in Ordnung.
Nach ca. 2h hatte das Wasser immer noch eine Temperatur von knapp 62 Grad, super.
Danach habe ich noch die Dichtigkeit getestet, es kam kein Tropfen raus, top.
Was mir nach mehrmaligem Gebrauch aufgefallen ist, ist der enorme Mehraufwand beim Reinigen des Deckels.
Es stört mich nicht, dass man den Deckel nicht in die Spülmaschine stecken kann, aber durch die kleinen Ecken und Winkel muss man schon fast mit einem Zahnstocher in die kleinen Ecken und Ritzen gehen, um wirklich die letzten Reste des eingetrockneten Getränks zu entfernen.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: All metal with rubber wheel, 8M threads 20mm screw length
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION: I rearranged my computer desk for my new very comfortable recliner chair. Had to switch to a lower extra desk because the recliner was lower than desk height. I'm using an "overbed" or hospital table with height adjustment to hold my mouse and keyboard table (lowest height is 26"). This arrangement works for me but the castors that came on the bed table I chose were junky plastic ones, got these to replace them. M8-1.25 is apparently a very common thread/screw length for small tables and chairs and because I wanted to keep the table low 1" was the highest I wanted to go, this particular set has 20mm instead of 25mm thread length which is fine for the table I have (the 25mm are a bit long but still work). These roll so much smoother than the plastic castors that came with the table, I was happy before these just made it better. Two of the castors have brakes and two do not have brakes. I believe they are also sold as a set with no brakes. If you buy the set with brakes be sure to install one castor with a break on each side of the table. You will need two box wrenches to install these 14 &15 mm. If you do not have "thin jawed" wrenches of the proper size you'll need a needle nosed plyers or adjustable wrench with thin jaws to finish tightening the screw because there will be a point that the regular box wrench can no longer fit in the gap anymore. These were very easy to install. I always use thread lock medium or strong on castors as they have a tendency to remove themselves from the table with use. Thread lock is easy to use, just squeeze a little on the threads before you screw it in, it's available at home improvement stores and amazon probably also carries it as well.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Set di barattolini versatili con un ottimo rapporto qualità-prezzo.
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Il prodotto arriva ben imballato nella sua scatola originale ed è costituito da un set composto da 8 barattoli in vetro. Nello specifico abbiamo 8 barattolini in vetro color marrone/ambra completi di coperchi a vite di colore nero, adatti a contenere prodotti cosmetici e non solo. Innanzitutto devo dire che si presentano benissimo ed il colore mi piace molto. La colorazione non è soltanto un fattore estetico ma anche funzionale perché una tonalità così scura riesce a proteggere il contenuto dai raggi del sole e quindi a mantenere inalterate le sue proprietà e qualità. I coperchi sono basici ma carini e si abbinano perfettamente al vetro scuro chiudendosi perfettamente. Questo tipo di barattolini è ottimo per creme ed oli essenziali ma anche per creare dei soprammobili o semplicemente conservare erbe e spezie. Io li ho presi principalmente per quest'ultimo motivo ma sono talmente belli che un paio li userò sicuramente come vasetti da fiori/pot pourri mettendo dei nastrini boho attorno. In ogni caso, sono di ottima fattura ed hanno tantissime possibilità di utilizzo.

In definitiva consiglio l'acquisto di questo set di barattolini perché sono davvero versatili e ben fatti, neutri e allo stesso tempo particolari tanto da essere adoperati in tantissimi modi diversi. Ottimo rapporto qualità-prezzo per questa tipologia di prodotto.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Gut für Elektronik Bastel Projekte - Modellrennbahn
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Ich benötige die Teile für kleine Elektronik-Projekte. Die ersten sind im Einsatz, um eine Carrera Modell Rennbahn damit steuern. Konkret ein Rundenzähler mit vielen Funktion, der mit IR Sensoren und einem ESP32 Board realisiert wird.

Für den Zweck sind die Relais genau passend, da sie maximal 20 Volt und maximal 5 Ampere schalten sollen.

Die beiden Relais sind galvanisch getrennt von der Steuerungselektronik. Sie können mit einem 3,6 Volt oder 5 Volt Steuersignal ausgelöst. Somit laufen sie mit Arduinos und mit ESP32 Technik. Sie brauchen zwar eine Versorgungsspannung von 5 Volt, die kann man aber direkt von einem ESP32 Dev Board abgreifen, das man per USB mit Strom versorgt. Der Stromverbrauch hält sich dabei in Grenzen, so dass der Regler auf dem ESP32 Board das aushält und man das Ganze noch mit einem einfachen USB Ladegerät betreiben kann.

Ich habe habe viele Langzeittests gemacht, die Wärmeentwicklung hält sich auch in Grenzen.

Das Projekt ist auf YouTube "electronics unmessed" zu finden.

Schönes Produkt zum Basteln.

Die Wiederverwendbarkeit der Dosen macht sie umweltfreundlich und nachhaltig. Das klare Design der Dosen passt gut in jede Küchen- oder Bastelumgebung.
Die Größe der Dosen ist ideal für den täglichen Gebrauch und ermöglicht eine Platzierung in Schränken, Regalen oder der Speisekammer.

Zusammengefasst ist das 12-teilige Set transparenter Plastikdosen mit Deckel, Etiketten & Stift eine praktische Lösung für alle, die Wert auf Ordnung und Frische in ihren Vorräten legen. Die Vielseitigkeit und das mitgelieferte Zubehör machen dieses Set zu einer sinnvollen Ergänzung für jede Küche oder Bastelwerkstatt.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Endlich Ordnung - oder: jeder Topf findet seinen Deckel
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Vorab: Ich durfte das Produkt auf Herz und Nieren testen. Hier erfahrt Ihr, was mir dabei aufgefallen ist:

--> Versand und Verpackung:
Das Produkt wurde schnell und gut verpackt geliefert.

--> Meine Erfahrungen zum Produkt und zur Qualität:
Meist ist es eine mühsame Tetris-Arbeit im Schrank, die vielen Pfannen und Töpfe so zu stapeln, dass man a, schnell drankommt und b, die Schranktür zu bekommt.
Also sollte eine Lösung her, um die Ablage so zu gestalten, dass vom vorhandenen Raum mehr genutzt wird und dir Organisation verbessert wird.

Mit den Kunststoffträgern kann durch Bekleben z.B. an der Schrankinnenseite eine Halterung vertikal aufgesetzt werden. Dazu muss man durch Abziehen der Klebestreifen die Rückseite an einer glatten Stelle anbringen, die, wenn sie einmal festgeklebt sind und nach einem Tag ausgehärtet sind, bombenfest halten.
Man sollte jedoch durch Probeöffnungen der Schranktür genau simulieren, wie der restliche Innenraum gelegen ist, damit man nicht z.B. am Türrahmen oder an andere Stellen damit im Schrank anstößt.

--> Mein Fazit:
Sehr hilfreiches Set. Praktisch, einfach zu nutzen und sehr solide konstruiert.

--> Wie sieht es mit einer Empfehlung aus:
Klares Ja!

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Worked on the first try on a problem bathroom sink
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
I live with a person with intellectual disabilities who uses toothpaste rather aggressively, leading to a very slow draining bathroom sink that's hard to keep up with. It's been extremely slow for a few weeks now - tried another plunger without success and drain cleaner didn't do a thing. First attempt with this thing and it pulled up blockages I don't want to think about and now the sink drains like it's brand new. Highly recommend on any drain where it's possible to get a clean suction.

I saw several comments about it not working on tubs with an overflow - as a tip, if you can remove the cover on your overflow, shove a hand towel into a zip lock or disposable grocery bag, and force it into the opening to block it, then plunge. I've run into that with our older model bathtub a few times and it worked like a charm when I found that tip on YouTube. Blocking the overflow valve with the towel alone didn't work, but using the bag let it create a decent seal.

Be aware that when you order this 1) it doesn't come with any cups included and 2) the cups it can hold are small (it's only suitable for cups with a diameter of 7.6cm or 3 inches diameter or less).

That said it's a decent little product.

It's very basic (which I like), serviceable and well made, feeling pretty solid and compact enough for a home kitchen, bathroom or small office. Indeed the 140 cup capacity is more than enough to last any small office a good few weeks / months. I got this for an Airbnb property I own and 140 cups will likely last the rest of the year.

It's also very easy to install and a very simple process of sticking some adhesive tabs to the wall and slotting the cup holder onto it. I found the tabs were excellent and more than capable of taking the weight of the little plastic cups I bought to go with this. It's best to install this on tiles for best results though.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Good overall, but needs a stronger pull force.
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION: In general, I will say that these are fair for their performance and price-point fairness. Overall design is nice, with holes on the sides and magnets are level with the surface, making it ideal for narrow spaces. Overall, I'm quite satisfied with my purchase & would even recommend them to others, but my only nagging point is that the magnetic pull force isn't as strong as I would like, and if you try to magnetize any particular 'big' item to these, it'll most likely suffer to keep a strong connection or just fall off all together. Either use multiple magnet racks together (more magnetic surface area) or only use small & lite weight items on these magnetic racks. "Heavy Duty"?...No, sadly, but still effective for various other things.

I have to say, this is the first planner I've seen that has the daily section laid out vertically rather than horizontally. I LOVE this design feature. It means instead of having to just have a daily "to-do" list, you can actually schedule out your full day by time periods
(i.e.
7 a.m. Wake Up
8 a.m. Commute
9-10 a.m. Class
etc.)

There's still space for a few daily to-dos and notes. This method of formatting truly maximizes a planner and is *perfect* for someone busy who needs to map out each day. Can't say enough how I love this feature and I'm shocked more planners don't do this.

The only reasons for 4 stars vs 5 are 1) the edges came slightly bent. I think this is a matter of shipping packaging, which could be Amazon's fault but I'd recommend the company put a hard cover or some sort of notebook protection. Color from another item in my package bled onto the notebook a bit too; again not the company's fault, but a plastic cover or some packaging protection would solve that. (I was able to get the color out with some micellar water). 2) I wish there were more design options. The rose gold is nice, but I'd love some brighter colors too. Having a slightly sturdier cover would also be great.

Overall, if you really utilize planners to plan out your monthly, weekly, and daily schedules, this is an awesome design. Will definitely be looking at them again for 2025 planners.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Rolling Smoothly Towards Efficiency: My Review of GBL Heavy Duty Caster Wheels
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
As a crafting business owner and jeweler, my workspace is constantly evolving. The need for flexibility and mobility within my studio led me to invest in the GBL 4" Heavy Duty Caster Wheels, a decision that has significantly enhanced the functionality and flow of my creative space. Here's why these caster wheels have become an indispensable addition to my studio.

**Unmatched Durability and Strength:** The first thing that impressed me about these caster wheels was their robust construction. Capable of supporting up to 1320 lbs when combined, they easily accommodate my heavy crafting tables and storage units. This high weight capacity has provided me with the freedom to reorganize my studio without worrying about the wheels buckling under pressure.

**Silence and Smoothness:** The transition to using these wheels has been noticeably serene. Their silent swivel action has made moving equipment around a noiseless affair, ensuring that my creative process remains uninterrupted by the clatter that typically accompanies lesser-quality wheels. The smooth glide has also been a boon, allowing me to effortlessly reposition my workstations and display units with minimal effort.

**Floor Protection:** One of my initial concerns was the potential for these heavy-duty wheels to mark or damage my studio's flooring. Thankfully, these fears were unfounded. The rubberized coating on the wheels not only provides excellent grip and stability but also ensures that my floors remain pristine, free from scratches and scuff marks.

**Braking System:** The inclusion of brakes on each wheel has been a game-changer. With a simple press, I can lock my furniture in place, providing a stable and secure foundation for delicate jewelry-making tasks or when using heavy machinery. This feature has added an extra layer of safety and convenience to my studio setup.

**Ease of Installation:** The caster wheels came with all the necessary screws for installation, making the setup process straightforward. I was able to quickly equip my furniture with these wheels, transforming my studio into a more dynamic and adaptable workspace in no time.

**Aesthetic Appeal:** Beyond their practical benefits, these caster wheels have a sleek, silver finish that adds a touch of professionalism to my studio. They blend seamlessly with my existing furniture, contributing to a clean and cohesive look.

**Final Thoughts:**

The GBL 4" Heavy Duty Caster Wheels have proven to be a valuable asset to my crafting business and jewelry studio. They offer a perfect blend of strength, mobility, and aesthetic appeal, making my workspace more adaptable and efficient. Whether I'm rearranging the studio for workshops, accommodating new machinery, or simply optimizing the space for better workflow, these wheels handle it all with ease. For fellow crafters and business owners looking to enhance their work environment, I cannot recommend these caster wheels highly enough. They're not just tools; they're investments in the functionality and potential of your creative space.
