CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Cool Looking Hand Grenade Water Bottle
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
This is a really cool looking expandable water bottle, designed to resemble a hand grenade when compressed.
Made entirely from a soft silicon material with a camouflage design, it's very lightweight and flexible.
It's 13cm at its smallest and will expand in several usable stages to reach 22cm at its maximum height.
As advertised it holds up to 500ml of liquid, both hot and cold, although it does get a bit warm to hold when filled with hot liquid as it has no thermal protection.
Also when filled with liquid, as the bottle is entirely silicon, it feels quite flimsy in your hand, especially when more liquid is drunk, but it can then be compressed several stages to compensate so it's really not too bad.
The lid is a solid screw on design (like a hot water bottle) and the liquid is accessed by pulling out the small folding straw section, which also allows air inside the bottle.
There were no leaks evident when filled up and shook about, so all good there.
When first using it there is quite a strong rubber smell, so I would recommend a good wash inside before using.
Due to the cool grenade design this would make a great Boys Toy, which is both unique looking and practical at the same time.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Title: Fairly disappointing for an average-sized head
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
I recently purchased the Slouchy Beanie Hat with high hopes of staying warm and stylish during the colder months. Sadly, my joy quickly turned to disappointment as soon as I tried to control it.

The main issue with this beanie is its size – it’s too small for a regular sized adult head, especially men. While using it, I found the insert to be uncomfortably tight, which caused the hat to constantly slip or press against my head uncomfortably. It’s safe to say the promise of a slouchy, relaxed fit wasn’t entirely true.

The disappointment is compounded by the fact that I tried the product and cannot return it. Not only does this keep me stuck with a beanie that doesn’t serve its purpose, but it also raises hygiene concerns, because returning a damaged item is generally not hygienic

While the beanie’s materials and design both seem promising, the major flaw in the size overshadows any positives. I would strongly caution potential buyers, especially those with average sized heads, to consider other options until this size issue is addressed by the manufacturer. Unfortunately, my experience with this Slouchy Beanie Hat was far from disappointing, and I cannot recommend it to others who are looking for a cute and well-fitting winter accessory.

Non ho un bambino piccolo, ma un gatto: il che può essere anche peggio, soprattutto quando ha il vizio, come il mio, di aprire in continuazione le antine dei mobili per infilarsi dentro.

Avevo quindi bisogno di una soluzione per tenerli chiusi senza il nastro adesivo, scomodo e inutile in quanto il gatto aveva pure capito che doveva strapparli per riuscire ad aprire, e mi sono ricordata di aver visto, sul programma di Amazon Vine, questo tipo di blocca ante.

Li ho cercati e li ho acquistati subito a un prezzo ragionevolissimo (5 euro), ricevendo un utilissimo set da 6 pezzi che ha immediatamente risolto il problema: l'applicazione è molto facile, basta prendere la misura e rimuovere la protezione per l'adesivo dopo aver pulito bene la superficie, quindi farlo aderire per un po'.

Il fermo si apre con molta facilità, un solo piccolo gesto che non fa perdere più tempo del dovuto nell'aprire e chiudere ripetutamente. Il mio gatto ogni tanto prova ancora ad aprire, ma finalmente desiste. Quindi, la soluzione è stata definitiva.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Matcha Green Tea is Very Different from Regular Green Tea
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION: I've always loved green tea. I drink it plain with no sweetener or cream. What I didn't realize was that Matcha green tea is processed very differently than regular green tea. My first surprise with Matcha green tea was that it was actually... green! Regular green teas are almost brown or even black in color. The next surprise was that there are, basically, two grades of Matcha: one is called "cullinary," the other "ceremonial." I use a different brand of Matcha than Encha brand (a cullinary grade) in my yogurt, and I love it, but when I tried to drink it as tea, much to my surprise, I found it exceedingly bitter! I learned that this is because cullinary grade uses older leaves and is processed differently than "ceremonial grade." So, I decided to give "Encha Ceremonial Grade" Matcha a try. I used it to make tea because I knew that in yogurt, any bitterness would be masked by the dairy. I found the taste absolutely amazing: distinctive and almost crisp, but with absolutely no bitterness. Because I love the sour taste of unsweetened Greek yogurt, as well as how cullinary-grade Matcha tastes when combined with it, I'll continue using the other brand for things like yogurt or smoothies, but now that I've discovered Encha Ceremonial Grade matcha, I'm done with drinking ordinary datk-colored "green tea" and am making the switch to Encha brand! I must also mention that I recently quit coffee and find that Matcha (as well as regular green tea) offers a better, safer, and more enjoyable energy source for me.

Ich hatte kürzlich eine Thermosflasche beurteilt in der ich genau das Thema kurz angeschrieben habe, sobald nämlich die Thermosflasche leer getrunken ist, trägt man einen Gegenstand mit sich herum der irgendwie dann unbewusst "störend" ist oder besser gesagt "nutzlos" erscheint...irgendwie zum "Balast" wird, - so geht es zumindest mir so....
Die Wahrscheinlichkeit sowas dann irgendwo unterwegs liegen zu lassen oder unterwegs zu vergessen ist doch irgendwie da - mir ist dies schon mehrmals passiert....mit Regenschirmen, Handschuhen, Sonnenbrillen usw.

Und diese Flasche geht dieses "Konsumentenproblem" geradewegs an.
Irgendwie schaut man sich diese Flasche auch gerne an, nimmt sie gerne in die Hand in Form, Farbe und Materialbeschaffung - ob voll oder leer...

Der Faltmechanismus ist einzigartig und erinnert irgendwie an Kinderspielzeug, die Silikon- Materialbeschaffenheit ist gummiert, weich und elastisch - Irgendwie hat man da einen weichen Gegegenstand in der Hand der am "wackeln" und am "zappeln" ist, man kann es drücken - Material gibt nach und kehrt sofort wieder in seine Form zurück....
Als Stressabbau auf z.B. Reisen, im Zug, Bus o.ä., wunderbar geeignet...ich brauch eigentlich keinen Gummiball mehr in meiner Hand...ich habe diese Flasche !
Und als Blickfang, in schwarz, sowieso ein Hingucker wert - wirk irgendwie "anders"....

Zur Funktionalität: 1 A !
Ist absolut dicht und läuft nichts aus, egal in welcher Position.
Für kalte und heisse/warme Getränke gut geeignet, insbesonders heisse Getränke bleiben lang auf hoher, angenehm trinkbare Temperatur erhalten.

Steht stabil, als Flasche, auf glatten Oberflächen auch bei leichten Erschütterungen, z.B. im Zug, Bus u.ä.
- wackelt eben nur ein wenig...;-)

Der Verschluss ist handlich, leichter zielstrebiger Zug nach links und die Flasche ist dicht.

Der kleine Karabienerhacken ist nützlich und sieht auch irgendwie stylisch und sportlich aus.

500ml reichen eigentlich auch für 2 Personen aus für kleinere Ausflüge, Picknick u.ä.

Auch in der Jackentasche o.ä. transportierbar, und wenn es leer ist, zusammendrücken und man hat nur noch die halbe Größe.

Ich schreib es nochmal, irgendwie "Spielzeug-like", es macht Spass mit der Flasche zu hantieren, seinen
Weg und seinen Alltag mit ihr zu bewältigen ! :-)
Auch in meiner kleinen Küche schnell verstaubar.

Erster Eindruck und Verarbeitung
Bereits beim Auspacken macht die Belle Vous Dunkelbraune Docking Station keinen hochwertigen Eindruck. Das lackierte Holz ist stabil aber schlecht lackiert (Kein Punkt Abzug/ Hersteller Bild sieht auch so aus). Eine Aufbauanleitung sucht man vergebens! Punkt Abzug!

Installation/Aufbau
Der Zusammenbau ist ziemlich simpel. Das Produktbild bei Amazon half mir dabei und in 5min Stand das gute Teil auf meinem Tisch. Eine Schraube der Handyablage ist zu lang gewählt worden, diese schaut ein Stück raus/ Punktabzug. Die Schrauben „versenken“ sich beim einschrauben nicht ganz im Holz, daher habe ich unten auf dem Boden Filz geklebt (Schont die Möbel). Punkt Abzug

Nutzen
Ja, hier werde ich die volle Punktzahl vergeben und rettet für mich die Docking Station. Endlich einen Ort gefunden wo ich alle meine lieben Sachen verstaue, wenn es ins Bett geht.

Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis
Angesichts der gebotenen Qualität und Leistung ist der Preis für die Belle Vous Docking Station gerade noch so gerechtfertigt.

Fazit
Weil mir persönlich die Docking Station vom Nutzen her so gefällt, sehe ich über die oben Angesprochenen Fehler gerne hinweg. Wer ein sehr gutes verarbeitetes Produkt sucht, wird nicht glücklich damit.

Belle Vous Graue Thermosflasche aus Edelstahl
Ich brauchte eine Thermoskanne mit Becher, und an dieser fand ich den Trinkverschluss gut, sowie die Farbe. Das Material ist Edelstahl und BPA-freies Plastik, d.h. kein gesundheitsschädliches Bispenol A wurde verwendet. Sogar spülmaschinenfest ist die Flasche, das ist bei wenigen meiner Flaschen so.
Man kann den Verschluss entweder per Knopfdruck öffnen um einen kleinen Strahl zum Eingießen zu haben, oder einfach komplett abschrauben. Einen Filter in Form eines kleinen Gitters hatte ich auch bisher in keiner Flasche.
Auch die Handschlaufe ist praktisch, z.B. um dadurch die Flasche gegen Herausfallen zu sichern.
Die Flasche hielt lange warm, und hatte keinen unangenehmen Nebengeschmack. Das Format sollte in die meisten Wanderrucksäcke passen.
Update 29.02.2024: Achtung, falls man in den Deckel Flüssigkeit einfüllt werden die Teile die nicht grün sind heiß.
Retour immédiat, n'aimante absolument pas. Aucun intérêt donc.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Navaris Paddle Brush: My Go-To Hair Hero for Smooth and Tangle-Free Locks!
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Let me share my experience with the Navaris Paddle Brush - it's truly been a lifesaver for my hair! This brush has become my go-to tool for achieving smooth, tangle-free locks, and here's why I love it.

First off, the design is fantastic. The large paddle shape and flexible bristles make detangling a breeze, even on thick or unruly hair. Whether I'm styling my hair straight or adding some waves, this brush effortlessly glides through my strands without pulling or snagging.

What's great is that it works for all hair types. Whether you have curly, straight, thick, or thin hair, this brush delivers fantastic results. It's versatile enough to use on wet or dry hair, making it a staple in my daily haircare routine.

The conforming comfort grip is another standout feature. It fits comfortably in my hand, allowing for precise control and reducing hand fatigue during extended styling sessions.

I also appreciate the durability of this brush. It's made of high-quality materials that hold up well to regular use, and the bristles stay intact even after repeated brushing.

Overall, the Navaris Paddle Brush has exceeded my expectations. It's efficient, comfortable to use, and leaves my hair looking smooth and shiny every time. If you're in need of a reliable hairbrush that gets the job done without any fuss, I highly recommend giving this one a try!

The instructions on this product description are all you get, but they are enough to get you up and running with this. I've set up a short length of it to a tap in the house as we're midwinter here and I can't set it up outside at the moment. The green connector that goes from the hose end to the tap is not included in the kit. That said, the pieces are sturdy. The hose is good quality. The individual shut-off valves work well. The little pegs that keep the drip valves in place are also good quality and seem to hold very well. I've not had any leaks from the extra drip feed I added and closed down to see if they'd leak. I've had no leaks from the connection joints. I wouldn't want to run it at high flow though, it isn't designed for that. It is a drip system. It would also be easy to tailor this to any length you want, and even split it to set up individual systems running from more than one tap. You could also add a second set to it to extend it to cover a greater area. I would have liked to see the connection to the tap in the kit.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Falsche Versprechen. Für batteriebetriebene Anwendung nutzlos.
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
1) Der GPIO5 kann nicht an Masse gelegt werden, weil ansonsten der ganze Chip resetet. Ihr deklariert hier ganz klar 6 multifunktionale GPIOs. Da GPIO5 resetet ist er für keine Anwendung geeignet, die Masse benötigt (also so gut wie keine).
Das ist also ein falsches Versprechen.
Ihr liefert 5 GPIOs und einen Reset-Pin.

UPDATE: Zwei von den Analog Pins kann man ebenfalls nicht als Analog Pin verwenden, Namhaft ADC1 und ADC3, weil sonst die Teilerwiderstände ein vielfaches von dem Verbrauchen, was der Controller verbraucht. Dann brauche ich dieses Gerät auch nicht. Den ADC2 habe ich hinbekommen, aber ich bekomme ihn nur auf ca. 3.6V hoch, weil er so viel schluckt, dass er den Teiler runterzieht.

2) Die Dokumentation ist lückenhaft. Nirgendwo steht die maximale Spannung für die Pins, im Netz lese ich Unterschiede wie schwarz und weis. Die maximalen Ströme sind nicht angegeben. Die KI schickt mich auf eine ungesicherte Seite, die nicht antwortet.

3) Solche Schnitzer macht AZ-Delivery nocht nur bei diesem Produkt. Beim D1 Mini Esp32 war es genauso. Ihr zählt einfach die Pins und alles was keine 3.3, 5, oder 0V , Vin, Vout ist zählt ihr als GPIO. Wenn man dann was zusammenbaut und versucht die pins auch als GPIO zu benutzen, wundert man sich, dass alles blinkt, obwohl alles ruhig sein sollte.
z.B. UART. Wenn ich den als GPIO benutze, dann flimmert alles, weil der Pegel vom USB beeinflusst wird und digitalWrite ignoriert.

Hört einfach mal auf, bei euren Produktbeschreibungen undetaillierte Falschinformationen zu verwenden. Gebt wirklich alle relevanten Details an und seid ehrlich.
Wenn ich direkt von einem Anbieter bestelle, der viele Q,X in seinem Namen hat, dann erwarte ich, dass gar nichts oder nur die Hälfte stimmt, aus Erfahrung. Ihr malt eine Deutschland-Flagge in eure Website und werbt mit Qualität von deutschen Experten. Da darf ich mehr erwarten. Stimmige VOLLSTÄNDIGE Doku und keine Abstriche in der versprochenen Hardware.
Ich habe mal Support bei euch erbeten, weil ich Schwierigkeiten wegen genau sowas hatte. Ihr habt wörtlich geschrieben ihr könntet nicht supporten und mir eine Erstattung angeboten. Mal ehrlich ihr seid höchstens bei Customer Relations Experten. Das halte ich von eurem Marketing. Ich hätte gerne Mal, dass euer Marketing sich hinsetzt und mit eurem Produkt was baut. Und dann könnt ihr in den Spiegel schauen, wie euer Gesicht zusammenfällt, weil ihr feststellt, es funktioniert gar nicht so wie ihr das bewerbt. Weil ihr nichts anständig dokumentiert und alles als GPIO deklariert muss man jeden Pin ausprobieren um herauszufinden ob es Konflikte gibt. Dann weiß man erst, ob er für die Anwendung überhaupt benutzbar ist.

Wenn eure Chips nicht grundsätzlich gut funktionieren würden und das irgendwie klappen würde, verlässlich, nach viel Arbeit, dann würde ich nicht bei euch kaufen.
Wenn ich den 6. Pin des Digispark bräuchte, würde ich euch den Mist an eure Tür nageln.
Das ist einfach eine Bodenlose Frechheit. 6GPIOs versprechen und nur 5 sind verwendbar.

Ansonsten kann ich sagen, ein RX480 Empfänger für 433.92mHz funktioniert mit dem Digispark, aber man muss steckverbinder für alle und ich meine alle Kontakte des RX480 vorsehen, weil der USB den Digispark nicht erkennt, wenn irgendein Kontakt mit dem RX480 verbunden ist. Also muss der jedes mal abgesteckt werden wenn ein Programm geladen oder geändert werden soll. Das halte ich euch nicht vor. Das war nur eine Information für eure Kunden, die müssen ja selbst supporten.

Aja... und nur so: Wenn ich erstmal einen Treiber auf JEDEM GERÄT installieren muss, wo ich den Digispark als "intelligente Tastatur" verwenden will ist das doch irgendwie witzlos, oder?

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: When disappointment simmers gently on the stove...
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
It is essential to provide a detailed and precise evaluation of the product: 30cm Flat-Bottom Carbon Steel Wok with Wooden Handle. This analysis takes into account several aspects, including manufacturing quality, cooking performance, and user-friendliness of the tool.

1. Manufacturing Quality:
The first point to note is the thickness of the metal, which is a positive aspect. This can ensure even heat distribution and increased durability of the product. However, this positive feature is unfortunately overshadowed by several significant flaws.

2. Wooden Handle and its Attachment:
The wooden handle, while visually appealing, has shortcomings in terms of quality and design. The attachment of the handle is a major concern, as it appears to be held in place by a cheap plastic end cap. This method of attachment seems flimsy and not durable, which may pose safety issues in the long run.

3. Seasoning and Metal Reaction:
Another disappointing aspect is the seasoning process of the wok. Despite efforts to season the wok five times, the metal failed to blue uniformly. This uneven reaction can be concerning as it suggests inconsistent metal quality or an ineffective seasoning procedure. Additionally, although oil has penetrated the metal, the wok remains sticky like Teflon after seasoning, requiring additional time to achieve the desired smooth texture.

4. After-sales:
As for the manufacturer's after-sales service, I don't know.

In summary, this 30cm Flat-Bottom Carbon Steel Wok with Wooden Handle has some positives, such as its metal thickness. However, these advantages are largely overshadowed by major flaws such as the poor quality of the handle and its unreliable attachment, as well as issues encountered during the seasoning process and the persistent sticky texture of the metal. Consequently, despite its potential, this product does not meet the high standards expected of a wok, and consumers are advised to explore other options in the market.

Diese Boxen sind universell einsetzbar. Für den Keller, für Vorräte (Tütensuppen, Gewürzbeutel, Teebeutel etc.), fürs Büro (Umschläge, Stifte, Tacker, Locher usw.), für den Garten (Sämereien, Handschuhe, Gartenscheren), im Bad (Kosmetik, Haarbürsten, Haarspangen, Hygieneartikel), im Kinderzimmer (Bastelzeugs, Mal-Utensilien, Puppenkleider, Matchbox-Autos) - mir fällt jetzt nichts ein, was man in diesen Boxen nicht aufheben, ordnen und verstauen kann.

Ich nutze sie für meine Wollvorräte, die jetzt nicht mehr kunterbunt durch die Schubladen kugeln, sondern, nach Farben und Material sortiert, in diesen Boxen verstaut sind. Die Boxen lassen sich gut und kippsicher stapeln, was ich sehr praktisch finde. Bisher hatte ich drei Schubladen voll mit Wolle, jetzt also vier Boxen, die in der hinteren Ecke des Schrankes ordentlich aufeinander stehen.

Die Boxen sind leicht konisch geformt. Unten haben sie eine Länge von 23cm und sind 17,5cm breit. Oben, am Rand, da wo der Deckel draufkommt, sind sie 25,5cm lang und 20cm breit. Die Höhe einer Box incl. Deckel beträgt 11,5cm.

Sonderlich hochwertig sind die Boxen nicht, weil sie schlicht aus Kunststoff bestehen. Aber sie sind leicht, gut zu reinigen (einfach unters Wasser halten und wieder abtrocknen), sie sind funktionell, praktisch und hübsch.

Ich kann sie gut gebrauchen und empfehle sie gerne weiter.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Perfect if you need lots of room
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
This is the perfect calendar for me. I particularly need lots and lots of room for each day, so this is the one. I'll be back next fall for a couple more. I can't imagine a better arrangement, for my purposes.

I know 15.5 by 12 inches doesn't sound especially generous, for a calendar -- that's exactly what I thought when I first saw it, too. But those measurements refer to the closed up calendar. Once you open it up, it's twice that big. And instead of those glossy photos hogging half the available monthly space, this one gives you all that extra space to write in! Each square is like 2.5 by 4 inches! Love it!

The thing is, several years ago I started giving my kids a calendar on New Year's Day. To help them stay organized. To make it more of a fun gift, I would mark the weirdest, funniest, or strangest holidays I could find in the calendars. At least a few for every month. It's a tradition, now, and I find new ones every year.

I like to add stickers or little pictures, (a pie for 'Pie Day', popcorn for 'Popcorn Day', and like that.) Which means I sometimes need the extra room this calendar provides. (Like for 'Gorilla Suit Day' or 'Talk Like A Pirate Day''. (Seriously. Both real. Google it.) )

So this is just exactly the calendar for me! The squares for the individual days are generous enough to fit all my little notes and stickers. The paper is nice and sturdy, and the simple line of staples in the middle means I don't have to work around a spiral thingy. And the whole thing's only a foot wide! It would fit nearly anywhere!

I love this calendar, and will certainly be ordering another couple, next fall. It's fun for us all, and it makes my kids smile all year long. Great product. 10 out of 10. Will buy again.

Die beiden Schlüsselanhänger sind eigentlich echt prima, nur muss man sehr behutsam damit umgehen, also wie in meinem Fall bloß nicht fallen lassen oder oft nutzen. Klar war ich bei einem Stück selber schuld,
beim Abnehmen von der Hose fiel mir der Anhänger auf den Teppichboden und zersprang in seine sämtlichen Einzelteile. Da die Kunststiffstifte abgebrochen waren, war ein Zusammenbau unmöglich. Schade, es hing lediglich ein Schlüssel dran und ich hätte nicht gedacht dass es beim Sturz auf einen Teppich schon so auseinander fällt. Der zweite Anhänger hat nach paar Wochen etwas gestockt, zur Zeit geht es wieder, aber immer wieder hängt der Mechanismus. Ansonsten ist er sehr schön und praktisch gewesen. Kundenservice meinte beim kaputten Anhänger lediglich, dass passiert halt, wenn man es runter fallen lässt.

Ich habe mir bei diesem Artikel gedacht, dass es gut in meinem Arbeitszimmer passen würde. Ich lebe in einem Fachwerkhaus und versuche hier viel mit Holz zuarbeiten. Da ich damit die Balken, die im gesamten Haus verlaufen, hervorheben möchte und es damit auch im allgemeine gemütlicher empfinde.

Die Montage ist sehr simpel gewesen, da hier mit einer Art Steck-System gearbeitet wird. Hier einfach die Materialien an der richtigen Stelle eingesteckt und damit soll es dann halten und fertig sein.

Optisch sieht es sehr schick aus und passt farblich zum Rest meines Arbeitszimmers. Auch riecht man deutlich den Geruch nach Holz, was mir persönlich gut gefällt.
Aber, ich musste bei allem, was ich in die entsprechende Vorrichtung gesteckt habe, mit Holzleim arbeiten, da die dafür ausgestanzten Vorrichtungen leider viel zu breit vorbereitet wurden, und somit immer wieder alles auseinander gefallen ist. Hier konnte ich weder entspannt mein Smartphone einstecken, noch auf dem kleinen ,,Regal“ irgendwas drauflegen, da es immer wieder heruntergefallen ist.

Die Rückseite ist ebenfalls nicht detailliert ausgestanzt worden, sodass auch diese immer wieder in sich zusammen gefallen ist.
Also mein persönlicher Tipp: Wirklich direkt Holzleim während der Montage zur Hand haben, dann hält das Konstrukt auch.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Funcionales pero más caros que otros similares
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
En Jun 2022 compré un pack de 4 topes para puerta de marca Schramm. Resultaron una compra mejor de lo esperado, pues no sólo los puedo colocar "delante" de la puerta para evitar que se cierren con el aire, sino que también puedo colocarlos "detrás" de la puerta para evitar que la manivela de la puerta golpee la pared.

No necesito dos topes en todas las puertas, por lo que en vez de 4 topes, esta vez necesitaba sólo 2. Schramm no vende packs de 2, por lo que solicité éstos de la marca Belle Vous.

Visualmente, son exactamente iguales a los Schramm, por lo que no desentonan con los topes que ya tenía. Funcionalmente, cumplen con su cometido, así que ninguna queja en ese sentido.
Como se ve en la fotos, el tope Belle Vous es ligeramente más "chato" que el Schramm, pero debe ser cosa de medio centímetro y es prácticamente inapreciable vistos desde arriba.

La única pega es que en el pack de Belle Vous (17.49) cada tope sale a 8.75eur, mientras que en el pack de 4 de Schramm (24.90eur) cada tope sale a 6.20eur; es decir, cada tope Belle Vous cuesta 2.5 euros más que el equivalente de Schramm... Así que en cuenta a relación cantidad/precio, recomendaría los Schramm.

La teiera è adatta per un litro giusto di tisana con un coperchio a tenuta stagna e realizzato in bambù. È dotata di un beccuccio aerodinamico che impedisce gli sgocciolamenti che sono spesso fastidiosi quando si versa la tisana nella tazza.
La teiera è resistente ad una temperatura che parte da un minimo di -20 ad un massimo di 120°. È leggera e facile da pulire, adatta anche per il piano cottura elettrica (non gas, attenzione) o per riscaldare la tisana dentro il microonde.
Esteticamente è molto elegante ed è adatta anche per gli infusi in estate per bere le bevande fresche con qualche fetta di frutta e foglie alla menta fresca.
Bellissimo e consigliato anche come idea regalo per gli amanti delle tisane.

- Review for BELLE VOUS 2 Pack of Hanging Bedside Organiser Pockets - Felt Bed Storage Caddies with 4 Pockets for Home Bed Rails, Bunk/Hospital Beds, Sofa or Dorm - Store Remote, Phone, Glasses, Magazines & Books -

I've had my eye on beside pockets for ages and am so happy I went for these ones. They are simple and extremely useful. Well made of a felt-like fabric, with multiple pockets that could be used in so many ways. I've put one in the sofa, which now holds all my remotes and any bits and pieces I need within close reach.

The other, randomly, I have attached to the radiator next to the toilet. There is no shelf or storage in there and it turns out that this pocket is a great place to keep wipes, toilet rolls etc. It also happens to be perfect for shoving my phone so it doesn't fall out of my jeans pocket (I hate that I am admitting this, but I know there must be other women out there who can relate!)

One of the best things about these is that there are multiple ways to attach them. They have straps with buckles that you can loop over, eyelets (which I've attached to the radiator using cable ties), a large panel that sits under something heavy such as a mattress, and two velcro strips so you can loop the panel over a sofa arm and it stays secure. Note that success with the velcro alone will likely depend on the fabric that it's attached to. My sofa arms are quite short so it tucks down the inner side between the arm and the cushion, making it more secure than the velcro would be alone.

I am very happy with these, highly recommended.

Hinweise:
Dieser Artikel wurde mir durch das Amazon-Vine Programm kostenlos zur Verfügung gestellt.
Dies hat keinen Einfluss auf die Bewertung!

Kaufgrund:
Der PC Monitor musste näher an die Wand, da er zu viel Platz auf dem Tisch belegt hat.

Lieferumfang:
- Monitorhalterung
-- Wandplatte
-- Geräteplatte
- Befestigungsmaterial

Erster Eindruck:
Geliefert wird die Halterung in einem relativ unscheinbaren Zip-Beutel. In diesem befindet sich (fast) alles was für die Montage benötigt wird.

Qualität:
Die Halterung ist aus etwa 1mm starken Stahlblech gefertigt. Das ist zwar dünn, aber sehr stabil.
Erst muss die kleine Wandplatte am Monitor ausgerichtet werden, denn ab und zu kommt es vor das die VESA-Löcher nicht 100%in der Mitte des Monitors sind.
Anschließend an die Wand angebracht. Die mitgelieferten Dübel sind wie gewohnt von unterster Qualität, es empfiehlt sich vom Baumarkt ein paar stabilere zu besorgen.
Die mitgelieferten VESA-Schrauben sind sehr kurz, ein blick vor der Montage sollte geworfen werden, ob diese auch passen oder auch hierfür der Baumarkt konsultiert werden muss.
Ansonsten ist das Thema schnell erledigt.
Den Monitor mit der Geräteplatte von oben in die Wandplatte einführen, fertig.

Endbewertung:
Von den Dübeln und den kurzen Schrauben abgesehen ist das Set sehr gut. Man sollte vorher schauen, ob die Anschlüsse am Monitor nach hinten, unten oder zur Seite abgehen. Da zwischen Monitor und Wann kaum noch Platz übrig ist, kann im schlimmsten Fall nur noch mit Winkeladaptern gearbeitet werden.
Für die ~7€ kann man dem Set gerne eine Chance geben.

Overall this is a great squat wedge that will work well for most people. The angle is great and the markings indicating the angle of your feet are fantastic additions so that you can be sure your feet are equally angled.

The material it is made out of is basically a high density foam. While this is great for a carrying weight, it does pose a small problem if you intend on using heavy weights with it. The foam can be depressed when loaded heavy enough. This isn’t ideal compared to a completely solid foundation. Those who want to go heavy will probably be better suited to metal squat wedges.

The other potential problem is that it isn’t super wide. Again, for most people this won’t pose an issue because it will be wide enough for most squat stances. However, if you intend on squatting with a wide stance on it, it may not work for that.

I really like that it has decent width, has a great angle, is light enough to be very portable, and has angle markings for reference. It will be a great fit for most people!

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Progetto e materiali migliorabili. Non universale
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Ho preso queste rotelle per box doccia per sostituire quelle vecchie (singole) del mio box Samo, e soprattutto perché quelle inferiori dispongono di un pulsante che consente il distacco momentaneo del vetro dal binario inferiore per effettuare la pulizia di un'area altrimenti normalmente inaccessibile.
Ebbene, a dispetto della descrizione dell'articolo come "universale", non si adatta al mio box.
A parte questo, ravvedo due difetti:
1) il meno grave è che certe parti sono realizzate in plastica, in particolare la copertura dell'area da smontare ed avviatare, il che non promette longevità soprattutto in considerazione dell'utilizzo di prodotti di pulizia.
2) quello più grave, ma può essere riferito a come il mio box è progettato (ma non credo) è che la vite di collegamento del "sandwich" (parte interna ed esterna) si trova dalla parte del binario e non in quella interna. Questo costringe a smontare tutto il vetro, cosa che può diventare fastidiosa e non realizzabile da solo, visto che spesso i bagni si trovano in spazi anche angusti. Per cui questo mi ha impedito anche di provare a montarli. In ogni caso, ad una presentazione approssimativa, la mia impressione è che non sarebbe stato comunque possibile montarli per incompatibilità di misure.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: NOT magnetic, but does stick to magnetic things. there's a difference.
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
the headline really is the main story of this product. the product description clearly states magnetic stainless steel (of which only certain types of Stainless steel are magnetic) but then confesses in the product information that it is not magnetic itself but will hold magnetised objects that stick themselves to it.

so yes the product title is misleading but the product listing is not dishonest.

the one disappointment for me though is a magnetised board that you can stick any metallic object to is a great deal more versatile than a sheet of metal that only works with magnetised objects.

with all that said however, if you want to put magnetised stuff up on your wall this notice board is nicely made with a clean finish and decent edges and mounting holes. wall installation takes a couple of minutes at the most if you know which way to point the bit on your drill.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Keine Cover-Hüllen für LPs, sondern dickes Papier - schade
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION: Für den Plattenliebhaber gibt es drei Hüllen, die er benötigt: eine transparente Kunststoffaußenhülle, eine stabile Cover-Hülle und eine antistatische Innenhülle - jede Schicht erfüllt eine andere Aufgabe - wobei die stabile Cover-Hülle i.d.R. ab Werk aufwendig gestaltet mitgeliefert wird. So aber nicht bei Schellack-Platten oder wo die Hülle einfach verloren ging. Dann muss Ersatz her. Die Coverhülle besteht aus einem dünnen Karton, so in der 350gr. Klasse, damit er einerseits die Platte stützt und mechanisch stützt, aber auch der Innen- und Außenhülle Stand gibt. Die hier gelieferte Ware ließ bei 25,95 / 25 Stück vermuten, dass es sich um die übliche und schwere Qualität handelt, jedoch dürfte die Dicke bei ca. 160gr. Papierqualität liegen. Für den Schutz von Platten unzureichend - daher wieder retoure und nur wenig Sterne - schade, denn der Verkäufer gab sich im Verkaufstext richtig Mühe, eine anderen Eindruck zu erwecken oder hat wenig Ahnung davon, wie Plattencover aussehen.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Its okay. Nice, but has its flaws
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
A few things about this:

1) The balaclava looks great. Dry fitting it, it also feels good. It's not thick and not the thinnest one either, but maybe more on the slightly thinner side. Putting on a hat or a helmet would not be an issue. When putting it on, it's comfortable. The lower part easily comes up and can be put down under the chin due to the stitching design. Other masks I've tried become too tight when I try to put it down under my chin, but not this one.

2) The head piece is odd to me. When I put the balaclava on, I feel like I need to pull it down to stop just above my eyes, or else its way up my forehead. But, when I do this, the mask goes up a bit in the back, feels a bit weird, but manageable. Not that bad. But I feel like over time it would inch back up ever so slowly. So you may need to pull it down a tad every bit. So, the fit is a bit more on the smaller end I would say.

3) The ventilation holes on the mask is nice, but I also think its not the best. When I had the balaclava on, and a pair of sunglasses, it instantly fogged up on the first breath. Would it be better with ski goggles? Not sure. With glasses, it was horrid. BUT, what did stop the fogging was by fixing where the holes in the mask were placed on your face. The holes are a bit too low, about 1/2-1" too low. I had to roll the top part of the mask higher up on my nose. When doing this, the air coming out of my nose or mouth released through the holes better, instead of partially though the fabric and the holes, which caused fogging. So, to stop the fogging, I rolled the top portion of the nose covering to prevent this. Basically, brining the nose/mouth holes up a bit higher. Unfortunately, you cant just put it up higher as it then covers your eyes, so you have to roll/fold over the top part. It looks weid from someone elses perspective, but stopped the fogging in my glasses.

So, its hard to say if I like this or not. I dont hate it as it is one of the better designs I've used, but a bit annoyed with the nose/mouth hole designs. The head piece is manageable as I just pull it down a bit, and its fine, but the breathing holes are a bit more of an issue to me. Maybe Ill just keep rolling it up and deal with it, unless I find an alternative, or modify it a bit somehow

Che ai gatti piacciono le scatole non è un mistero, né che adorano “rifarsi” le unghie su mobili o divani. Questo prodotto è la soluzione a entrambe le esigenze. Ammetto di essere stata scettica circa l’utilità di una scatola del genere: i miei gatti mano rintanarsi in tutto ciò che lontanamente assomiglia a una scatola, ma sull’uso “tiragraffi” ero davvero perplessa.
Si tratta, infatti, di una scatola-tiragraffi pensata per accogliere il nostro amico a quattro zampe e permettergli di giocarci dentro e affilarsi le unghie. All’interno della confezione esterna, infatti, troviamo 5 fogli di cartone ideale per le sue zampine: il materiale utilizzato è atossico, si presenta come ondulato. Se si hanno più gatti gli altri cartoni possono essere utilizzati fuori della scatola che li contiene, facendo felici tutti. Se una faccia del cartone è più usurata… beh, si gira e si sfrutta anche da quel lato.
La scatola esterna misura 23x30 cm circa, mentre i 5 pannelli all’interno 24x33 cm circa.
Il prodotto è pensato per durare nel tempo e nella descrizione si legge che dovrebbe reggere a strappi per un periodo più lungo del normale. È chiaro che stiamo parlando comunque di cartone, resistente certo, ma sempre molto “consumabile”. Sicuramente è ancora presto per dare un giudizio sulla durata, avendo la gatta preso possesso della scatola e dei cartoni solo da poco. Li usa entrambi, il che è un bene per la mobilia. Appena ha visto la scatola ci si è fiondata dentro, affilandosi le unghie.
Sul prezzo… diciamo che spendere più di 20 euro per dei cartoni mi lasciava perplessa. Visto l’entusiasmo iniziale, visto che già lo usa energicamente devo rivedere la mia opinione iniziale: può essere visto come un investimento a lungo termine.

Arrivata oggi, questa pratica custodia della KWMobile era letteralmente l'unica opzione su Amazon per proteggere le mie cuffiette che avesse un minimo di "carattere", le altre erano praticamente identiche ma senza una faccina incaxxata, faccina che devo dire poteva essere stampata magari più grandicella ma è ok.
La custodia NON si tiene senza il supporto dei due adesivi interni, (tra l'altro adesivi 3M quindi bravi per la qualità), quindi occhio a quando la installate, fate prima qualche prova e solo POI installate definitivamente il tutto, perché altrimenti rischiate non solo di danneggiare il dispositivo ma anche di rovinare gli adesivi e di conseguenza vi tocca procurarvi del nastro biadesivo e fare da soli.

Punti Positivi:
- In generale si presenta bene, il silicone è soffice e quasi vellutato al tocco, per niente "sticky", tende un pochino a raccogliere polvere questo sì, ma si sposa bene con il materiale esterno del case delle cuffie, praticamente al tocco sono quasi identici.

- La clip di aggancio è di alluminio, sembra molto solida e per niente facile a staccarsi, la stessa giuntura in silicone è bella spessa e non credo sarà facile si spezzi in un uso quotidiano. Bisogna vedere in estate o nel tempo se tiene.

- Ottimo il tappino copri slot di ricarica, fa un po' fatica a tenersi inserito dentro, ma fa comunque il suo dovere. Magari dargli uno spessore maggiore avrebbe consentito un fit più solido all'interno del comparto.

- Pur essendo una cover non dà l'idea di essere molto spessa, quindi il ridotto spessore mantiene comunque la sensazione di avere un prodotto di qualità tra le mani e non una cinesata.

- La cover PERMETTE tranquillamente la ricarica wireless

Punti Negativi:

- La polvere si accumula facilmente se tenuta in tasca, tipo nei jeans, ma di positivo c'è il fatto che si toglie altrettanto facilmente quindi è un 50/50

- Come dicevo il tappino protettivo per lo slot di ricarica tende facilmente a togliersi, nulla di grave sia chiaro, non è che penzola, ma non è neanche ben fisso all'interno

- Il montaggio non è stato dei più semplici devo ammetterlo, ci vuole un po' di attenzione e pazienza ma in 5 minuti ci si riesce

- La cover non copre tutto il dispositivo, come da foto nei lati rimane un gap che per un occhio attento può dare fastidio

Per il resto spero di essere stato utile, la cover l'ho comprata coi miei soldi sia chiaro, non vedendo recensioni mi sembrava giusto farne una io, tutto qui!

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Works as a but is not of the quality I would expect at this price point
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
I've got a few problems with the product, the main one of which was sort of resolved by the manufacturer, but I can't recommend this bicycle generally. Here are my problems:

1. It's generally made from low-cost and low-quality materials and it doesn't seem like they did tolerance analysis on the critical interfaces (clamp + handlebar + fork). In attaching the handlebars to the fork I snapped the bolt before I had enough friction to get the handlebars and fork to move as one. Unrelated to that, it uses plastic bushing at the handlebar and form, which is maybe fine for a bike like this, but it's not what I would expect for 100+ dollar balance bike that doesn't have other expensive mechanisms like pedals or a crank.
2. I broke the wrench it came with (See comment in 1 about low quality materials). It also only comes with one wrench when you need 2 at a minimum to get the job done. Don't buy this if you're not handy and do not have your own tools. Two wrenches at a minimum. Ratchet + socket improves assembly substantially.

3. After snapping the handlebar clamp bolt, I had to go to Lowes to buy replacement parts to get the job done. Their documentation doesn't say what size the bolts (5/16-18 x 1.5 inches BTW) are, so I had to figure that out at Lowe's. After doing this, I was able to get the assembly to work. A bit of a tangent -- a lot of these problems could be resolved if they added a simple key feature between the fork and handlebars.

All that out of the way, the good things...

3. It's claim of being lightweight is accurate.

Final score: Cannot recommend generally, but not the worst purchase if you're willing to put in the extra effort to fix the design issues and complain to customer service when you run into a problem (or need a refund...).

Dear Amazon,
this Kindle cover has a fabrication error. It turns off the eBook as soon as one folds the cover fully backwards, i.e. in reading position.
We found out that the magnet is mounted wrongly. One can easily see this comparing an old cover with this new model. When facing the open cover the magnet should be visible (it is embedded in a little open slit) and the back of the cover should be a completely solid closed surface.
In this new model, when facing the open cover the magnet is solidly embedded behind the plastic cover and the open slit is on the back of the cover. As this "opening" has been thoroughly covered with a thin leather layer one can only see this fabrication error when carefully peeling off the leather.
The eBook works well without the new Kindle cover and of course with the old Kindle cover. However the new one is sold by Amazon with this fabrication error. This is a great disappointment. I bought it in May and offered it for Christmas. I would have send it back if it was not too late or maybe it's not. However, I do not have the packaging anymore. Regards.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Kokoserde – Die perfekte Basis für gesundes Pflanzenwachstum
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Die Kokoserde hat sich als unschätzbarer Bestandteil meines Substratmixes erwiesen, der in Verbindung mit dem Knauf Gartenbau Perlite Perligran und Kohle meine Pflanzenpflege revolutioniert hat.

Umweltfreundliche Alternative:
Was mir besonders an der Kokoserde gefällt, ist ihre Umweltfreundlichkeit. Die Humusziegel sind nachhaltig produziert und bieten eine ökologische Alternative zu herkömmlichen Erden. Ein beruhigender Gedanke für umweltbewusste Gärtner.

Leichte Handhabung:
Die Humusziegel sind kompakt verpackt und entfalten sich leicht, wenn Wasser hinzugefügt wird. Dies macht die Kokoserde äußerst einfach zu handhaben, besonders bei der Vorbereitung meines individuellen Substratmixes.

Nährstoffreiche Grundlage:
Die Humusziegel Kokoserde bietet eine nährstoffreiche Basis für meine Pflanzen. Mit dieser Erde haben meine Pflanzen Zugang zu wichtigen Nährstoffen, die für ein gesundes und kräftiges Wachstum entscheidend sind.

Gesundes Pflanzenwachstum:
In Kombination mit der verbesserten Bodenbelüftung durch mein Perlite schafft die Kokoserde optimale Bedingungen für gesundes Pflanzenwachstum.

**Fazit:**
Die Humusziegel Kokoserde ist für mich zu einer unverzichtbaren Komponente meines Substratmixes geworden. Ihre Umweltfreundlichkeit, leichte Handhabung und die Förderung von gesundem Pflanzenwachstum machen sie zu einer klaren Empfehlung für jeden, der nach einer qualitativ hochwertigen Kokoserde sucht.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Documenti e appunti sempre in ordine! Una cartellina coi fiocchi!
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
In ufficio o per lavoro durante i meeting mi ritrovo con decine di fogli e appunti che tenere in ordine risulta veramente un'impresa!

Grazie ad Amazon ho potuto testare queste cartelline A4 prodotte da BELLE VOUS e da allora tutto è in ordine al suo posto!

Inoltre non sono semplici cartelline ma nascondono delle funzioni veramente particolari!

Le cartelline arrivano in una confezione da ben 6 Unità, imbustate singolarmente, così da poter proteggere la finitura lucida durante il trasporto.

Sono in Policarbonato trasparente, utile ad esempio se dobbiamo copiare degli appunti e non abbiamo molto spazio di appoggio. Il fermaglio per i fogli è ben regolato, ne troppo lento, ne troppo difficile da tirare e con i terminali in gomma tiene ben saldi i fogli.

La cartellina ha incise anche due scale di misurazione, una in pollici e una in centimetri, cosa che in ambito professionale, specialemente per Architetti, Ingegneri e Geometri è sempre un plus veramente gradito, cosi da poter misurare ed annotare la misura senza dover poggiare continuamente la cartellina.

Dulcis in fundo una feature veramente inaspettata ma molto, molto gradita è la piccola attaccaglia a scomparsa che, con il suo foro, ci permetterà di appendere la nostra cartellina ad un chiodino o ad un gancetto e poter avere sempre sotto occhio più documenti o ad esempio prendere delle firme.

Veramente un bell'oggetto che mi ha facilitato la vita in veramente tante occasioni e anche il mio rendimento lavorativo è migliorato ora che non perdo più nemmeno un foglio!

This works well but it won't fit many dumbbells, dumbbell handles, and plate combinations you may have and/or want to use. The good news first is that it does work. It's not super easy to get on and off; in fact, it's a little annoying at first working the plastic buckle in a tight space, but once you get it on it seems to be on there. I didn't load it up super-heavy or anything, but I did some easy swings and other moves to try it out. The handle is generously apportioned so you can get a variety of one- and two-handed grips with it.

As for the handle fitting, I'll give a rundown:

I have a pair of cast iron 8 pounders. The handles are too thick on them, so the PowerPress doesn't fit.
I have another pair of handles that have long threaded shafts. But they also have plastic overlays on the grips - PowerPress doesn't fit.
I have two other pairs of adjustables, but the PowerPress only fits on one of them because the hand area on the one is too short and the part that stops the plates is too thick. On the other pair it works. The problem then is that you can only fit plates with small diameters. Five pounders (standard, 1" plates) fit but not perfectly. Bottom line is that it will be tough to make heavy kettlebells with these.

Der wirlich formschöne Freßnapf besteht aus einem sehr festen Kunststoff unter dem 5 kleine Silikonfüßchen gegen eventuelles verrutschen befestigt sind. Die leichte Schräge in Verbindung mit dem erhöhten Stand erleichtert wirklich das Herankommen an das Futter, bei älteren Hunden ein gutes Kaufargument. Beim Kauf sollte man vorher die Maße mit der eigenen Schüssel überprüfen, für große Hunde ist der Napf nach meiner Meinung zu klein.
Warum der eine Stern Abzug:
Die angegebenen 470 ml Inhalt beziehen sich auf die Schüssel wenn sie waagerecht steht, im angeschrägten Ständer sind nur max. ca. 300 ml möglich. Wenn man die Schale als Trinknapf verwendet ist das nicht unerheblich. Der Silikonring an der Edelstahlschüssel hat sich nach 1x im Geschirrspüler gelöst und ist nicht mehr zu befestigen, jetzt klappert die Schüssel etwas in der Kunststoffhalterung.

I’ve been trying to unblock my kitchen sink unsuccessfully for 3 days which I won’t get back!
I tried Mr M gel several times, rodding with drain snakes, 2 litre bottles of cola, baking soda with white vinegar, salt with boiling water, a hand water pump and the blockage persisted.
My partner suggested the Luigi plunger after reading all the good reviews. I was slightly sceptical that it would work after my previous failed attempts.
After filling the sink with backed up water and covering the other sink hole (or overflow) with a rubber plug I began pumping like a lunatic. To my surprise it produced very good suction and cleared the blockage immediately!
I then used it in the bathroom clearing out gunk and a small beards worth of hair. It even sucked out a small plastic toy that had somehow gone down there also.
This really does work and saved me the cost of getting a plumber (possibly Mario) so I’m really impressed.
So I suggest you take the plunge and buy Luigi’s even if you don’t have a fully blocked drain pipe as I’m sure you’d be surprised how much is trapped down there without even knowing!
I hope this helps you.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Un Kit que Nebuliza en Lugar de Gotear: Riego Automático, Pero con un Giro
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Este Kit de Riego Automático por Goteo es como el estudiante que estudia para la prueba equivocada: tiene buenas intenciones, pero no acierta en el objetivo. Con 3/5 estrellas, este kit tiene algunos puntos fuertes, pero un error fundamental.

La manguera de 10 metros y los conectores son resistentes y fáciles de ensamblar, lo cual es un punto positivo. La calidad de construcción parece bastante robusta, y las boquillas y bridas incluidas son útiles para personalizar el sistema según las necesidades de tu huerto, jardín o invernadero.

Sin embargo, el gran fallo radica en la descripción del producto. Este kit no es realmente para el riego por goteo, como indica su nombre, sino más bien para la nebulización. Si esperas gotas refrescantes en tus plantas, este no es el kit que buscas. La salida es más como una fina bruma, lo cual puede no ser ideal para todas las plantas.

En resumen, si buscas un sistema de nebulización para mantener frescas tus plantas en un día caluroso, este kit podría ser una elección decente. Pero si tu corazón está puesto en el riego por goteo tradicional, es posible que quedes decepcionado. Una aclaración en la descripción del producto sería un gran paso para evitar malentendidos.

Ho preso questa pinza per poter mettere occhielli quando ne ho bisogno.
Al di la dello stato in cui era la pinza, si tratta di un oggetto molto robusto e pesante che consente di applicare occhielli su stoffe, cartoni ed altri materiali che lo consentono.
Nel sacchetto c'era la pinza "spillata" nella sua confezione originale ed in compagnia di un sacchettino con una discreta quantita' di occhielli (100) pronti ad essere usati e di un foglio di istruzioni (italiano non pervenuto).
La pinza ha una doppia capacita', cioe' quella di fare il buco di base e quella di applicare l'occhiello al buco appena prodotto.
Il perno centrale e' quello per bucare il materiale. La profondita' lungo il bordo in cui fare il buco e' regolabile tramite una vite che blocca un fermo in una determinata posizione sulla scala graduata incisa sulla pinza. Personalmente non amo il funzionamento di questa parte e di solito i buchi li faccio piu' efficacemente in altro modo, ma comunque c'e' ed e' possibile usarla.
Sulla punta della pinza c'e' la parte per l'applicazione dell'occhiello. Sull'acciaio e' incisa la sagoma di un occhiello che indica sia il lato della pinza dove metterlo, sia il verso in cui va inserito. Una volta posizionato l'occhiello sulla stoffa e sulla pinza, bisogna premere con un minimo di forza per schiacciarlo per applicarlo definitivamente.
E' piu' semplice da applicare che da descrivere.
Una cosa che non mi piace di questa pinza e' che l'impugnatura tende a scivolare via dalla presa delle mani.
Forse avrei sagomato l'impugnatura invece di metterci un semplice disegno inciso.

Me han venido muy bien para controlar remotamente la caldera o los termostatos de contacto seco. Estupendo alcance y respuesta inmediata con un consumo ínfimo y un volumen muy reducido. El ESP8266-01S que acompaña cada placa es un poco puñetero de programar, pero a base de paciencia y un poco de google he acabado construyéndome un rudimentario circuito de programación que funciona con un arduino "As ISP", o con un FT232 a USB desde el Arduino IDE.

El pin que abre (o cierra) el relé en esta configuración es el GPIO0 y no el GPIO2, que suele ser el más habitual porque está libre. El primero enciende un led azul en la placa al activarse, y el otro lo enciende en el ESP8266-01S ya que este pin corresponde al "onboard LED". En la red hay un montón de ejemplos de programas para diversos usos y también hay por ahí placas a medida para programar este dispositivo WiFi (un pelín caras).

En cuanto al hardware, compré el lote de tres y en uno el relé no se activaba. Consulté con el vendedor y, muy amablemente, me ofreció enviarme otros dos sin coste. De estos últimos, again, uno funcionaba y el otro no. Desoldé el relé de una placa de las que no funcionaban y lo probé en un breadboard. El relé se cierra y se abre sin problema con el voltaje y corriente adecuados, así que sospecho que el problema es de la placa base (¿mala soldadura?¿pistas defectuosas?¿componentes erróneos?¿bajo control de calidad?). Me pondré de nuevo en contacto con el vendedor y se lo explicaré, aunque ya no necesito que me envíe más... y tengo dos ESP8266-01S 'vírgenes' extra :)

En todo caso recomiendo la compra para proyectos inalámbricos en espacios reducidos.
Cinco estrellas por todo, menos una por los defectuosos.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Stylish, Practical Mug with scope for quality improvements
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
I recently picked up the BELLE VOUS Stainless Steel Thermal Mug in light purple, and it's been quite the mixed bag. Let's start with the positives: the color scheme is charming, striking the right note of style and subtlety. Size-wise, it's perfect - not too small, not too large, just right for daily use. Its large mouth is a standout feature, making it easy to clean, which is always a plus for on-the-go drinkware.

The mug's leakproof design and rubberized base are practical, ensuring no spills and stability on smooth surfaces. Whether hot coffee or a cold drink, this mug is versatile for all seasons, keeping liquids warm for about 6-7 hours.

However, the outer surface has a matte finish, which might not appeal to those who prefer a softer touch. The cap's quality is a bit of a letdown, with shredded ends that detract from the overall feel of the mug. Also, the plastic straw raises concerns about durability, especially with hot liquids.

Please note that this review is based on a free product received through the Vine program, and my judgment remains entirely based on personal experience.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: See through pots with clear measurements
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
I use epoxy resin for my crafts and normally use large plastic pint cups to pour my resin into but that's when it's mixed by weight. When I need to mix by volume, I didn't have any cups with measurements on so I got some silicone cups but couldn't see the measurements well enough as they were slightly opaque.
This set has 24 cups, holding up to 100ml in each one. They are a hard plastic and completely transparent so you can see when your resin is mixed properly. The measurements on the outside are very clear and easy to read so makes measuring out much easier.
They are straight edged which makes it easier for scraping the sides of the pot to make sure all the resin is mixed in.
I made up a couple of batches with alcohol ink in and it did stain the jug slightly but it cleans up well and there are plenty of pots to keep a couple of coloured ones separate.
Worth the money and really handy to have in your workshop.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Alternativa divertente al hulahoop, utile per coordinazione ed allenamento leggero
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Ammettiamolo, è uno di quegli attrezzi sportivi per “pigri” che cercano uno stimolo un po’ fantasioso per decidersi a fare movimento, perché la voglia di andare in palestra non c’è.

Questo hula hoop alternativo è ben pensato e ben realizzato, semplice al montaggio, avrete a disposizione molti pezzi per adattarlo alla vostra taglia.
Utilizzandolo si farà rumore, le rotelle che scorrono nel “cornicione” causano lo stesso rumore delle macchinine giocattolo.

Un consiglio è provarlo le prime volte lontano da parenti ed amici o da chi può farci dei video.. se invece ad utilizzarlo è un vostro familiare, fate in modo di esserci quando lo proverà!

In realtà ben presto si capirà come assecondare la forza centrifuga del pesetto, acquisendo un minimo di tecnica e di armonia dei movimenti, l’impegno muscolare c’è e viene stimolata anche la coordinazione.
Il produttore suggerisce di utilizzarlo 30 minuti al giorno, credo che utilizzandolo con costanza i risultati saranno buoni, senza affaticarsi eccessivamente, pur essendo stancante (non sottovalutatelo).
Lo trovo un attrezzo carino ed anche divertente, perlomeno per ora ho ancora voglia di utilizzarlo, quindi lo promuovo. E’ ben realizzato, quindi penso che il rapporto qualità prezzo non sia male, ora poco sopra i venti euro.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Como chubasquero cumple a la perfección
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Es un chubasquero fino, pero no tanto como los que se pliegan en una bolsa. Resulta ligero y es 100% impermeable además de cortar el aire, cumpliendo su función a la perfección.

El material utilizado es poliéster y es agradable al tacto. Su diseño incorpora dos bolsillos en los laterales y uno interior, todos ellos provistos de cremallera a prueba de lluvia. Lo mismo sucede con la cremallera que cierra el chubasquero, es a prueba de lluvia. Los tiradores de las cremalleras están revestidos de goma para una mayor comodidad y podremos manipular incluso con guantes finos.

Los puños se ajustan sin apretar, quedando un poco sueltos pero no siendo un problema. La capucha incorpora una goma interior de ajuste sobre la cabeza, sin tirar ni molestar, pero manteniendo la capucha en su sitio.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Muy práctica y de uso versátil
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Esta cesta de Belle Vous está íntegramente fabricada en acero inoxidable, con una malla robusta con aberturas de tamaño correcto y cuya cualidad principal es la de ser plegable, llegando a ocupar menos de lo que ocupa un plato. Esto la hace especialmente conveniente cuando en la cocina existen problemas de espacio.

En mi caso la pedí para sustituir la cesta vieja de una sartén freidora, ya que por sus características pensé que se acoplaría bien a ella y sería suficientemente honda. La verdad es que ha quedado perfecta y me parece mucha mejor opción que la cesta rígida que tenía antes, que limitaba la capacidad. Resulta fácil de limpiar y se puede poner en el lavavajillas.

Otra de las ventajas de esta cesta, es que permite un uso más versátil dentro de la cocina, ya que se puede utilizar para lavar frutas y vegetales y también como colador, por ejemplo de pasta de tamaño grande como pueden ser los macarrones, ravioli y tortellini entre otros. Unos usos muy interesantes y convenientes, teniendo en cuenta la aparatosidad de los coladores destinados a estos fines.

Por último queda destacar lo práctica que resulta para extraer el contenido sin necesidad de volcarlo, ya que tirando de las asas hacia afuera sobre una superficie, la cesta queda totalmente abierta facilitando que podamos coger los alimentos y servirlos.

Ho i capelli molto ricci quindi li devo spazzolare esclusivamente da bagnati e con quintali di balsamo. Stanca di strapparmi ogni volta ciocche intere di capelli ho voluto cercare una spazzola a basso costo che evitasse almeno di strappare i capelli. A primo impatto non gli davi una lira, pensavo di aver acquistato una ciofeca abbindolata dalle recensioni. Ho voluto testare prima su capelli asciutti (cosa che con altre spazzole mi è impossibile spazzolarli) ottenendo un risultato abbastanza soddisfacente ma avendo i capelli puliti ho dato poco peso al risultato. Quando poi ho testato la spazzola sotto la doccia sono rimasta completamente scioccata! Ho voluto testarla ancora di più iniziando a spazzolarli ancor prima dello shampoo e devo dire è veramente ottima! Non tira i capelli in nessun modo anzi sembra accarezzarli ma fa il lavoro di una spazzola in modo impeccabile, è talmente tanto morbida che non sembra nemmeno li stia spazzolando e i risultati ci sono eccome! Sono passata dal pulire ogni volta almeno due volte la spazzola da quanti capelli “perdevo” al pulirla a malapena visto che non rimaneva niente da togliere. Ho realizzato che per tutti questi anni è un miracolo che abbia ancora i capelli in testa visto che li ho sempre strappati

So, I was looking for an alternative to the Conair and Kitsch Bow Caps because I find them cute and wanted a few more affordable designs and options. I tried this out and it was initially really exciting. It's thick, looked good, and seemed sturdier than the Conair cap, much closer to the Kitsch style ones.

I was so disappointed after I used it. First off, it's not waterproof which is wild because that's the whole point of a shower cap. It's "debatably" water resistant because it does take some time for water to soak through it, and I imagine many people might not even realize this because most people don't take that much water directly to the cap on the daily.

Even so, this leads to another set of problems. Because it is porous but also somehow resistant it dries terribly. The cap will air out, but the water will pool inside the cap. It was a lot of fun putting on my shower cap the next day to get 2 teaspoons of water splashed on my hair and face.

So if you are expecting a conventional shower cap pass on this. It's a novelty at best. I wanted to give it a two really, but because it works fine outside of a shower or there is a technical work around I am being lenient.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Ben realizzato e anche piuttosto completo ma il packaging lascia a desiderare
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Belle Vous è un brand che proprio non conoscevo e come sempre faccio in queste circostanze, sono andato sul WB alla ricerca del “marchio perduto” ma non sono riuscito a trovare nulla; il venditore (Tinyyo Limited) risulta inglese con sede a Londra e sul suo sito vende prodotti di svariate tipologie e marchi, compreso lo sfuggente e introvabile Belle Vous.

Ma lasciando da parte il brand e venendo al prodotto specifico oggetto della mia recensione, si tratta di uno giardino Zen molto ricco di accessori che mia moglie ha adorato da subito; tempo fa ne avevamo già provato uno acquistato in una bancarella ma aldilà del buon impatto iniziale si è dimostrato molto deludente sotto l’aspetto qualitativo tanto da deteriorarsi praticamente da subito.

Il packaging è estremamente deludente visto che parliamo di una scatola anonima di cartone grezzo che potremmo definire “difficilmente presentabile” come eventuale idea regalo; la confezione è ben fornita e contiene nel dettaglio:

- 1 vassoio in legno
- 1 busta di sabbia bianca (350 grammi)
- 6 Rastrelli vari in bambù.
- 50 ciottoli di piccole dimensioni
- 3 Rocce ZEN
- 2 Rocce Muschio
- 2 Alberi di ciliegio
- 1 fiore di loto.
- 1 Cancello shintoista
- 1 Pagoda di Ceramica.
- 1 Ponte

Il set è davvero molto ben accessoriato ma purtroppo accade che molti pezzi non siano stati imbustati e protetti singolarmente e quindi aprendo la confezione te li ritrovi sparsi ovunque all’interno con il rischio di provocare anche danni a quelli più delicati; un albero di ciliegio è arrivato con la base di sughero spezzata in due e con diverse foglie colorate staccate dai rami e sparse all’interno della scatola, i ciottoli erano ovunque, le pietre ZEN (tra l’altro le più pesanti) avevano bucato la leggera confezione in plastica dove erano racchiuse e anche il leggero muschio era fuori protezione. In pratica soltanto la sabbia (fortunatamente direi altrimenti il set sarebbe stato da buttare), i rastrelli e le decorazioni sono arrivate correttamente imbustate e protette (vedi foto allegate).

Il design e la scelta dei colori per le decorazioni d’insieme è perfetto, rilassante e molto realistico; le dimensioni sono abbastanza generosa e si lasciano preferire ai mini giardini ZEN molto graziosi come soprammobili ma poi praticamente inutilizzabili; il set completo misura approssimativamente poco meno di 28 cm x 20 cm con 2 cm di spessore.

I materiali di costruzione sono ottimi visto che parliamo di vassoio in legno, rastrelli in bambù naturale, oltre alla ceramica (fate attenzione a proposito) e ad altri elementi naturali semplici.

La funzionalità è assicurata grazie ai tanti strumenti a disposizione e alla buona lunghezza del giardino che consente di rilassarsi disegnando nella sabbia molto agevolmente e componendo il set a seconda del proprio gusto e del proprio umore.

A questo proposito, visto il nutrito set di elementi decorativi a disposizione, il mio consiglio è quello di non intasare troppo il giardino ma di posizionarli gradualmente e non tutti insieme per godere del giusto spazio e di una buona facilità di manovra dei rastrelli.

Il prezzo non è competitivo, ma abbastanza commisurato al valore dell’oggetto, almeno a mio avviso; su Amazon è in vendita a 26 euro spedizione compresa, almeno al momento della pubblicazione di questa recensione (Gennaio 2024).

The fabric is very elastic which is good for flexibility when working out.

Also, the breathable mesh only covers the mouth and not the nose openings. If you only breath through your mouth it's ok but it makes breathing through the nose difficult. Also, the way the fabric curves around the nose compressed it, making breathing through the nose even harder.

The bottom part doesn't reach down into the collarbone far enough. If you're wearing a jacket that zips up around the neck up to the jaw bone it's no good.

I wore a stocking cap over the mask for added warmth and didn't have any problem with the cap staying in place.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
J'ai récemment acquis le Pierre à Aiguiser les Couteaux avec Base Antidérapante en Caoutchouc, et je suis tout simplement ravi de partager mon expérience avec cet excellent produit. En tant qu'amateur passionné de cuisine, la qualité de mes couteaux est essentielle, et ce produit a vraiment dépassé mes attentes.

Tout d'abord, la base antidérapante en caoutchouc est un ajout brillant qui garantit une stabilité optimale pendant l'aiguisage. Cela crée un environnement sûr, ce qui est particulièrement appréciable lorsque l'on travaille avec des couteaux tranchants. La sécurité est une priorité, et cette base contribue grandement à la tranquillité d'esprit.

La pierre elle-même est d'une qualité exceptionnelle. Elle offre une granulométrie idéale pour affûter mes couteaux de cuisine, leur redonnant un tranchant incroyable en peu de temps. J'ai apprécié la polyvalence des deux côtés de la pierre, chacun offrant une texture différente pour répondre à mes besoins d'aiguisage spécifiques.

De plus, la durabilité de cette pierre est impressionnante. Après plusieurs utilisations intensives, elle reste aussi efficace qu'au premier jour. C'est un investissement qui vaut vraiment la peine pour ceux qui cherchent à maintenir la qualité de leurs couteaux sur le long terme.

En résumé, le Pierre à Aiguiser les Couteaux avec Base Antidérapante en Caoutchouc est un accessoire indispensable pour tout passionné de cuisine soucieux de la qualité de ses outils. Je le recommande vivement à tous ceux qui recherchent une solution fiable et performante pour entretenir leurs couteaux avec facilité et efficacité. Bravo pour ce produit exceptionnel !

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Fantastic lot, brilliant for resin art, huge amount for excellent price! 5 Stars!
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
I received these via the Vine Programme. Here is my honest and unbiased review.

This lot arrived in a carboard box and everything is present and correct.
I am loving the jugs/beakers. Up until now I have been using silicone measuring cups, where the measurements are really hard to make out.
These plastic pots just have it all
1. Hard yet flexible plastic, making clean ups and peel offs easy and quick.
2. Excellent measurement markings, easy to see and feel.
3. Fine spout for precision pouring.
4. Very good size for mixing up small batches, or to mix in colours in several different lots of resin.

The lolly sticks are lolly sticks, good for mixing against the flat side of the pot.
5 little long neck spoons, fabulous for measuring out small amounts of glitter, mica, etc.

5 Stars! I cannot fault these, and an excellent price.

My only comment would be to have these available in smaller batches for people who are new to resin, who just want to try a few out without having to buy so many.

Originally bought for camping, we actually found them really useful in other situations, too. First of all, they are good "glasses", wine tastes lovely and they are nice to drink from. Haven't had any issues cleaning them by hand or in the dish washer.

The versatility is a bit unexpected, it is one of those things you don't know you need until you have it. They are perfect if you move house and they have indeed been handy for camping or being out in the garden, but we have also taken them to hotels when travelling.

Since everywhere now seems to give you plastic cups, I have also thrown them in my hand bag for things like going to the theatre, markets, festivals, traveling on planes/trains... I just pop them in a freezer bag each with some kitchen roll and no more plastic cups to drink from, which means the overpriced wine you get in some of those places tastes much nicer!

I had been oohing and aahing over getting them, as we already have stackable cups, but this is now one of those things we would replace in an instance if they got lost. Emphasis on "lost", as they are pretty indestructible.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Great Multi purpose furniture for the home
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION: I was looking for a folding step ladder chair for my home. since I do a bit of woodworking I thought I would make one myself. It would have cost me over $300 in wood and materials to make it and since this was less than half that cost it was a no brainer. I noticed from the reviews that assembly and assembly instructions were the main complaint. Assembly is a bit involved and the instructions are not the best. Since I already investigated making my own and since I have experience in assembling furniture . Je recommande vivement la gyrobole fitness à tous ceux qui souhaitent se remettre en forme de manière amusante et efficace !

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Praktische Belle Vous Verstellbare Hanteln: Flexibles Krafttraining
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Wer zuhause gerne flexibel trainieren möchte, ohne einen Haufen verschiedener Hanteln herumliegen zu haben, für den könnte dieses 3-in-1 Hantelset von Belle Vous interessant sein. Ich habe mir das Set zugelegt, weil mir die Idee gefiel, das Gewicht einfach anpassen zu können, und weil ich etwas für gelegentliche Kraftübungen zuhause suchte.

Das Wichtigste zuerst:
Die Hanteln liegen wirklich gut in der Hand. Das rutschfeste Material fühlt sich angenehm an und gibt auch bei schweißtreibenden Übungen sicheren Halt. Der ergonomische Griff macht es einfach, die Hanteln zu halten, und ich hatte bisher keine Probleme mit Abrutschen oder Unbequemlichkeit.

Die Gewichtsanpassung:
Die Möglichkeit, das Gewicht zu variieren, ist super praktisch. Es ist kinderleicht, die einzelnen 250g-Gewichte hinzuzufügen oder zu entfernen, was mir erlaubt, mich langsam zu steigern oder je nach Übung das Gewicht schnell zu wechseln.

Für wen eignet sich das Set?
Ich würde sagen, dass das Set besonders für Einsteiger oder Personen, die ein leichtes bis mittleres Gewicht bevorzugen, geeignet ist. Fortgeschrittene Kraftsportler werden mit dem maximalen Gewicht von 2kg pro Hantel vermutlich nicht ausgelastet sein.

Mein Fazit:
Für den Heimgebrauch und für alle, die ein leichtes, anpassbares Hantelset suchen, ist das Belle Vous Hantelset eine gute Wahl. Die Qualität ist solide, die Handhabung einfach und das Training damit effektiv. Wer allerdings auf der Suche nach schwereren Gewichten ist, sollte sich nach einem anderen Set umsehen.

Fingers crossed.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Super thin minimalist case just what I've been looking for.
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
I have been looking for a case like this forever.
I'm the kind of person who wants to see the styling and design of the handset not necessarily a case, but I'm conscious that it also needs some day to day protection. What's the point in buying a super stylish handset then disguising it in a load of rubber!

As you can see from the photos this case is super thin. I've never known one so thin. Once it's on you can barely tell its there.

The phone sits very snugly in the case and it goes on super easily. I haven't tried removing it just yet but I suspect it may be tricky as the case is rather rigid.

As others have mentioned there is absolutely no raised edge to protect the screen, but then I always have a screen protector on anyway. The cameras are nicely protected though with a little raised edge.

You can still wireless charge but there is no magsafe ring. I suppose you could stick one on but that would ruin the aesthetics.

The carbon fiber look is really nice but as for what it's made out of, I haven't the foggiest idea. I suppose you have to trust they aren't lying.

Anyway I'm happy, a case that's barely there fully protecting the back and edges of my phone. Not sure if it would absorb any impacts from dropping but then I'm not in the habit of dropping my phone.

Not super cheap but certainly cheaper than many others claiming to be made from Aramid Fiber.

Not sure about durability yet. I'll try to remember to check back in in a couple of weeks.

Hope this wee review is helpful.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Bicchieri pieghevoli in silicone con coperchio: pratici e funzionali
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Ho ricevuto questi bicchieri pieghevoli in silicone tramite il programma Amazon Vine in cambio di una recensione onesta e imparziale. Si tratta di quattro bicchieri neri con cordicelle e coperchi in plastica, che hanno una capacità di 180 ml. Sono ideali per l’uso quotidiano a lavoro per bere acqua o per attività all’aperto come escursioni e picnic.

Praticità: La loro caratteristica principale è la possibilità di piegarsi e ridurre le dimensioni, rendendoli compatti e facili da trasportare. Basta premere sul fondo e il bicchiere si ripiega su se stesso. Le cordicelle permettono di appendere i bicchieri a uno zaino o a una borsa.
Materiali: I bicchieri sono realizzati in silicone di qualità, resistente e flessibile. Il silicone è un materiale sicuro per contenere bevande, in quanto non rilascia sostanze nocive. I coperchi sono in plastica rigida e si adattano bene ai bicchieri, prevenendo le fuoriuscite.
Pulizia: L’unico aspetto negativo di questi bicchieri è che arrivano con un odore non troppo piacevole, probabilmente dovuto al materiale o al confezionamento. Consiglio di lavarli bene prima del primo utilizzo, magari con un po’ di aceto o bicarbonato, per eliminare l’odore. Dopo il lavaggio, i bicchieri sono pronti per essere usati.
In conclusione, sono molto contento di questi bicchieri pieghevoli in silicone, che trovo pratici e funzionali. Il rapporto qualità-prezzo è ottimo e il prodotto corrisponde alla descrizione. Li consiglio a chi cerca dei bicchieri portatili e riutilizzabili per le proprie bevande.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: It was a dark and rainy night trailering the bike... when a deer ran out
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
It was Friday the13th in Oct. Barely 5 mins from our destination outside of Glen Arbor.

I saw two deer on the oncoming lane, left and ahead of us.
I began braking hard while hoping they don't go into our lane.
Thinking of my bike on the UHaul behind us, I braked hard but was careful to keep the wheel straight.
Like a bad slow motion dream - the deer started moving into our lane I braked harder, on the edge of a skid on the wet roads- our luggage inside the van all shifted forward.

BUMP -

We hit the deer between 5-10 mph. It flips up off the bumper as if in slow motion, suspended inches from our windshield like a freeze-frame. Vanishing off to our right.

We stopped, found no sign of the deer except fur streaks on the pavement.
It ran off, probably with a sore hind quarter.

Only superficial damage to the van. Crunched hood, cracked headlightlight.

The Bike on the Trailer...

Perfectly held in place.
No issues at all. Rhino straps performed perfectly.

My first experience with trailering a bike.
This was my first trip with my new ratchet straps too.
I had listened to advice from friends, read all the instructions I could, and I was pleased with the results.

Didn't plan to test them like this.
10/10

Thanks Rhino!

He had to pull it mostly sideways pulling it so hard that it bent the recovery hook on the truck but the big rope just got it done and is ready for the next pull. It was my first time not using a chain but instead this sort of thing and it's 1/2" soft shackle and I'm now a fan!
